Carpooling.prescribedSample.source:
def prescribedSample {T : ℕ} (P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E)
    (t : Fin T) : E :=
  P t (fun s => prescribedSample P ⟨s.val, lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩)
termination_by t.val

Carpooling.adaptiveMatchingEvent.source:
noncomputable def adaptiveMatchingEvent {T : ℕ}
    (P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  univ.filter fun x => ∀ t, x t = P t (fun s => x ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩)

/-- Every causal prescription has exactly one matching sequence, despite
depending on previous observations. No independence assumption about P is needed. -/

Carpooling.adaptiveMatchingEvent_eq_sing.source:
theorem adaptiveMatchingEvent_eq_singleton {T : ℕ}
    (P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E) :
    adaptiveMatchingEvent P = {prescribedSample P} := by
  ext x
  simp only [adaptiveMatchingEvent,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and,mem_singleton]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hi : ∀ n (hn : n < T), x ⟨n,hn⟩ = prescribedSample P ⟨n,hn⟩ := by
      intro n
      induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h n ih =>
        intro hn
        rw [hx ⟨n,hn⟩,prescribedSample]
        congr 1
        funext s
        exact ih s.val s.isLt (lt_trans s.isLt hn)
    funext t
    exact hi t.val t.isLt
  · intro hx
    subst x
    intro t
    exact prescribedSample.eq_1 P t

/-- Adaptive edge guessing has the same exact likelihood as guessing a fixed
word: |E|^(-T). This is the local likelihood ingredient in Section 4.2. -/

Carpooling.adaptive_matching_probability.source:
theorem adaptive_matching_probability {T : ℕ}
    (P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E) :
    uniformProb (adaptiveMatchingEvent P) = 1/(Fintype.card E:ℝ)^T := by
  rw [adaptiveMatchingEvent_eq_singleton]
  simp [uniformProb,Fintype.card_fun]

/-- Complete a partially free sample, prescribing just the times in I. -/

Carpooling.completeSelected.source:
def completeSelected {T : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin T))
    (P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E)
    (free : {t : Fin T // t ∉ I} → E) (t : Fin T) : E :=
  if ht : t ∈ I then
    P t (fun s => completeSelected I P free ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩)
  else free ⟨t,ht⟩
termination_by t.val

Carpooling.selectedMatchingEvent.source:
noncomputable def selectedMatchingEvent {T : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin T))
    (P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  univ.filter fun x => ∀ t ∈ I, x t = P t (fun s => x ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩)

Carpooling.completeSelected_matches.source:
lemma completeSelected_matches {T : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin T))
    (P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E)
    (free : {t : Fin T // t ∉ I} → E) :
    completeSelected I P free ∈ selectedMatchingEvent I P := by
  apply mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨mem_univ _,?_⟩
  intro t ht
  rw [completeSelected, dif_pos ht]

Carpooling.completeSelected_unique.source:
lemma completeSelected_unique {T : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin T))
    (P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E) (x : Fin T → E)
    (hx : x ∈ selectedMatchingEvent I P) :
    completeSelected I P (fun t => x t.val) = x := by
  have hm := (mem_filter.mp hx).2
  have hi : ∀ n (hn : n < T),
      completeSelected I P (fun t => x t.val) ⟨n,hn⟩ = x ⟨n,hn⟩ := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      intro hn
      rw [completeSelected]
      split_ifs with ht
      · rw [hm ⟨n,hn⟩ ht]
        congr 1
        funext s
        exact ih s.val s.isLt (lt_trans s.isLt hn)
      · rfl
  funext t
  exact hi t.val t.isLt

/-- Even after leaving arbitrary sampling times unconstrained, causal guesses
cost exactly one factor |E| for each constrained time. In particular, separate
cliques' edge prescriptions need not be functions of their local histories alone. -/

Carpooling.selectedMatchingEvent_card.source:
theorem selectedMatchingEvent_card {T : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin T))
    (P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E) :
    (selectedMatchingEvent I P).card = Fintype.card E ^ (T-I.card) := by
  let equiv : {x // x ∈ selectedMatchingEvent I P} ≃ ({t : Fin T // t ∉ I} → E) := {
    toFun := fun x t => x.val t.val
    invFun := fun free => ⟨completeSelected I P free,completeSelected_matches I P free⟩
    left_inv := fun x => Subtype.ext (completeSelected_unique I P x.val x.property)
    right_inv := by
      intro free
      funext t
      dsimp
      rw [completeSelected,dif_neg t.property] }
  have h := Fintype.card_congr equiv
  rw [Fintype.card_fun,Fintype.card_subtype_compl] at h
  simpa only [Fintype.card_coe,Fintype.card_fin] using h

Carpooling.selected_matching_probability.source:
theorem selected_matching_probability {T : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin T))
    (P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E) :
    uniformProb (selectedMatchingEvent I P) = 1/(Fintype.card E:ℝ)^I.card := by
  have hI : I.card ≤ T := by simpa using card_le_univ I
  have hp : (Fintype.card E:ℝ)^T =
      (Fintype.card E:ℝ)^(T-I.card)*(Fintype.card E:ℝ)^I.card := by
    rw [←pow_add,Nat.sub_add_cancel hI]
  have he : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card E := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  unfold uniformProb
  rw [selectedMatchingEvent_card]
  push_cast
  rw [Fintype.card_fun,Fintype.card_fin]
  push_cast
  rw [hp]
  rw [div_mul_eq_div_div,div_self (ne_of_gt (pow_pos he _))]

end Carpooling

Carpooling.uniformMean.source: noncomputable def uniformMean (f : Ω → ℝ) : ℝ := (∑ x, f x)/(Fintype.card Ω:ℝ)

Carpooling.eventIndicator.source: noncomputable def eventIndicator (A : Finset Ω) (x : Ω) : ℝ := if x ∈ A then 1 else 0

Carpooling.uniformMean_mono.source:
lemma uniformMean_mono {f g : Ω → ℝ} (h : ∀ x, f x ≤ g x) :
    uniformMean f ≤ uniformMean g :=
  div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (sum_le_sum (fun x _ => h x)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

Carpooling.uniformMean_const.source:
@[simp] lemma uniformMean_const (c : ℝ) : uniformMean (fun _ : Ω => c) = c := by
  have hn : (Fintype.card Ω:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  simp [uniformMean,hn]

Carpooling.uniformMean_add.source:
@[simp] lemma uniformMean_add (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    uniformMean (fun x => f x+g x) = uniformMean f+uniformMean g := by
  simp only [uniformMean,sum_add_distrib,add_div]

Carpooling.uniformMean_sub.source:
@[simp] lemma uniformMean_sub (f g : Ω → ℝ) :
    uniformMean (fun x => f x-g x) = uniformMean f-uniformMean g := by
  simp only [uniformMean,sum_sub_distrib,sub_div]

Carpooling.uniformMean_const_mul.source:
@[simp] lemma uniformMean_const_mul (c : ℝ) (f : Ω → ℝ) :
    uniformMean (fun x => c*f x) = c*uniformMean f := by
  simp only [uniformMean,←mul_sum,mul_div_assoc]

Carpooling.uniformMean_mul_const.source:
@[simp] lemma uniformMean_mul_const (f : Ω → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    uniformMean (fun x => f x*c) = uniformMean f*c := by
  simp only [uniformMean,←sum_mul,div_mul_eq_mul_div]

Carpooling.uniformMean_sum.source:
@[simp] lemma uniformMean_sum (f : J → Ω → ℝ) :
    uniformMean (fun x => ∑ j, f j x) = ∑ j, uniformMean (f j) := by
  simp only [uniformMean,←sum_div]
  rw [sum_comm]

Carpooling.uniformMean_indicator.source:
@[simp] lemma uniformMean_indicator (A : Finset Ω) :
    uniformMean (eventIndicator A) = uniformProb A := by
  simp [uniformMean,eventIndicator,uniformProb]

Carpooling.eventIndicator_mul.source:
lemma eventIndicator_mul (A B : Finset Ω) :
    (fun x => eventIndicator A x*eventIndicator B x) = eventIndicator (A ∩ B) := by
  funext x
  by_cases ha : x ∈ A <;> by_cases hb : x ∈ B <;> simp [eventIndicator,ha,hb]

Carpooling.noHitEvent.source:
noncomputable def noHitEvent (A : J → Finset Ω) : Finset Ω :=
  univ.filter fun x => ∀ j, x ∉ A j

/-- Pairwise intersection probabilities suffice; mutual independence is not
assumed. This is useful when each prescription uses the full global history. -/

Carpooling.pairwise_event_amplification.source:
theorem pairwise_event_amplification (A : J → Finset Ω) {p : ℝ}
    (hp : 0 < p) (hJ : 0 < Fintype.card J)
    (hfirst : ∀ j, uniformProb (A j) = p)
    (hsecond : ∀ j k, j ≠ k → uniformProb (A j ∩ A k) = p^2) :
    uniformProb (noHitEvent A) ≤ 1/((Fintype.card J:ℝ)*p) := by
  let μ : ℝ := (Fintype.card J:ℝ)*p
  have hμ : 0 < μ := mul_pos (by exact_mod_cast hJ) hp
  have hmoment : ∀ j k,
      uniformMean (fun x => (eventIndicator (A j) x-p)*(eventIndicator (A k) x-p)) =
        if j = k then p*(1-p) else 0 := by
    intro j k
    have hexpand : (fun x => (eventIndicator (A j) x-p)*(eventIndicator (A k) x-p)) =
        (fun x => eventIndicator (A j) x*eventIndicator (A k) x -
          p*eventIndicator (A j) x - p*eventIndicator (A k) x + p*p) := by
      funext x; ring
    rw [hexpand]
    simp only [uniformMean_add,uniformMean_sub,uniformMean_const_mul,
      eventIndicator_mul,uniformMean_indicator,uniformMean_const,hfirst]
    by_cases hjk : j = k
    · subst k
      simp [hfirst]
      <;> ring
    · rw [if_neg hjk,hsecond j k hjk]
      ring
  let Z : Ω → ℝ := fun x => ∑ j, (eventIndicator (A j) x-p)
  have hvariance : uniformMean (fun x => (Z x)^2) = μ*(1-p) := by
    have he : (fun x => (Z x)^2) =
        (fun x => ∑ j, ∑ k, (eventIndicator (A j) x-p)*(eventIndicator (A k) x-p)) := by
      funext x
      simp only [Z,pow_two,sum_mul_sum]
    rw [he,uniformMean_sum]
    simp_rw [uniformMean_sum,hmoment]
    simp [μ,mul_assoc]
  have hpoint : ∀ x, eventIndicator (noHitEvent A) x*μ^2 ≤ (Z x)^2 := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : ∀ j, x ∉ A j
    · have hz : Z x = -μ := by simp [Z,eventIndicator,hx,μ] <;> ring
      simp [eventIndicator,noHitEvent,hx,hz]
    · simp [eventIndicator,noHitEvent,hx,sq_nonneg]
  have hbound := uniformMean_mono hpoint
  rw [uniformMean_mul_const,uniformMean_indicator,hvariance] at hbound
  have hbound' : uniformProb (noHitEvent A)*μ^2 ≤ μ := by
    nlinarith [mul_pos hμ hp]
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hμ).mpr
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hμ).mp
  nlinarith [hbound']

section Adaptive
variable {E : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]

Carpooling.selectedMatchingEvent_union.source:
lemma selectedMatchingEvent_union {T : ℕ} (I H : Finset (Fin T))
    (P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E) :
    selectedMatchingEvent (I ∪ H) P = selectedMatchingEvent I P ∩ selectedMatchingEvent H P := by
  ext x
  simp only [selectedMatchingEvent,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and,mem_inter]
  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨fun t ht => hx t (mem_union_left _ ht),fun t ht => hx t (mem_union_right _ ht)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hI,hH⟩ t ht
    rcases mem_union.mp ht with ht | ht
    · exact hI t ht
    · exact hH t ht

/-- Amplification of adaptive edge prescriptions on disjoint sets of times.
P may use every earlier sample, including samples assigned to other cliques.
The probability that all K prescriptions fail is at most |E|^L/K. -/

Carpooling.adaptive_prescription_amplifi.source:
theorem adaptive_prescription_amplification {T L : ℕ}
    (I : J → Finset (Fin T)) (hJ : 0 < Fintype.card J)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ j k, j ≠ k → Disjoint (I j) (I k))
    (hsize : ∀ j, (I j).card = L)
    (P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E) :
    uniformProb (noHitEvent (fun j => selectedMatchingEvent (I j) P)) ≤
      (Fintype.card E:ℝ)^L/(Fintype.card J:ℝ) := by
  let p : ℝ := 1/(Fintype.card E:ℝ)^L
  have hE : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card E := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hp : 0 < p := by dsimp [p]; positivity
  have hfirst : ∀ j, uniformProb (selectedMatchingEvent (I j) P) = p := by
    intro j
    rw [selected_matching_probability,hsize j]
  have hsecond : ∀ j k, j ≠ k →
      uniformProb (selectedMatchingEvent (I j) P ∩ selectedMatchingEvent (I k) P) = p^2 := by
    intro j k hjk
    rw [←selectedMatchingEvent_union,selected_matching_probability,
      card_union_of_disjoint (hdisjoint j k hjk),hsize j,hsize k,pow_add]
    dsimp [p]
    ring
  have hb := pairwise_event_amplification (fun j => selectedMatchingEvent (I j) P)
    hp hJ hfirst hsecond
  have hJe : (Fintype.card J:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt hJ
  have hEe : (Fintype.card E:ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hE
  have heq : 1/((Fintype.card J:ℝ)*p) = (Fintype.card E:ℝ)^L/(Fintype.card J:ℝ) := by
    dsimp [p]
    field_simp
  exact hb.trans_eq heq

end Adaptive
end Carpooling

Carpooling.Move.source:
structure Move (x y : V → ℝ) where
  u : V
  v : V
  distinct : u ≠ v
  weight : ℝ
  weight_nonneg : 0 ≤ weight
  weight_le_one : weight ≤ 1
  ordered : x u ≤ x v
  update : ∀ k, y k = x k + (if k = u then weight else 0) -
    (if k = v then weight else 0)

Carpooling.Move.at_u.source:
lemma Move.at_u {x y : V → ℝ} (e : Move x y) :
    y e.u = x e.u + e.weight := by
  simpa [e.distinct] using e.update e.u

omit [Fintype V] in

Carpooling.Move.at_v.source:
lemma Move.at_v {x y : V → ℝ} (e : Move x y) :
    y e.v = x e.v - e.weight := by
  simpa [Ne.symm e.distinct] using e.update e.v

omit [Fintype V] in

Carpooling.Move.sum_update.source:
lemma Move.sum_update {x y : V → ℝ} (e : Move x y) (R : Finset V) :
    ∑ k ∈ R, y k = (∑ k ∈ R, x k) +
      (if e.u ∈ R then e.weight else 0) -
      (if e.v ∈ R then e.weight else 0) := by
  simp_rw [e.update, sum_sub_distrib, sum_add_distrib]
  simp

Carpooling.Move.sum_preserved.source:
lemma Move.sum_preserved {x y : V → ℝ} (e : Move x y) :
    ∑ k, y k = ∑ k, x k := by
  simpa using e.sum_update univ

/-- A finite legal run. No assumption about an adversary or future edges is needed. -/

Carpooling.Run.source:
structure Run (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (T : ℕ) where
  d : ℕ → V → ℝ
  step : ∀ t, t < T → Move (d t) (d (t+1))

Carpooling.expandingCount.source:
noncomputable def expandingCount {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (t : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  by
    classical
    exact ((range t).filter fun s => ∃ h : s < T, (R.step s h).Expanding).card

Carpooling.Move.neg.source:
def Move.neg {x y : V → ℝ} (e : Move x y) : Move (fun k => -x k) (fun k => -y k) where
  u := e.v
  v := e.u
  distinct := Ne.symm e.distinct
  weight := e.weight
  weight_nonneg := e.weight_nonneg
  weight_le_one := e.weight_le_one
  ordered := neg_le_neg e.ordered
  update := by
    intro k
    rw [e.update]
    by_cases hu : k = e.u <;> by_cases hv : k = e.v <;> simp [hu, hv] <;> ring

Carpooling.Run.neg.source:
def Run.neg {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) : Run V T where
  d := fun t k => -R.d t k
  step := fun t ht => (R.step t ht).neg

Carpooling.Run.prefix.source:
def Run.prefix {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (t : ℕ) (ht : t ≤ T) : Run V t where
  d := R.d
  step := fun s hs => R.step s (lt_of_lt_of_le hs ht)

Carpooling.expandingCount_le.source:
lemma expandingCount_le {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (t : ℕ) : expandingCount R t ≤ t := by
  exact le_trans (card_filter_le _ _) (by simp)

Carpooling.expandingCount_neg.source:
lemma expandingCount_neg {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (t : ℕ) :
    expandingCount R.neg t = expandingCount R t := by
  unfold expandingCount
  congr 1
  apply filter_congr
  intro s _
  apply exists_congr
  intro hs
  change (-R.d s (R.step s hs).u < -R.d s (R.step s hs).v + (R.step s hs).weight) ↔
    R.d s (R.step s hs).v < R.d s (R.step s hs).u + (R.step s hs).weight
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

end Carpooling

Carpooling.badBatchEvent.source:
noncomputable def badBatchEvent (N : V → Finset V) (g : E → Sym2 V) (K B L : ℕ) :
    Finset (Fin K → Fin B → E) :=
  univ.biUnion fun j => evaluationEvent (badDiscrepancyEvent N g B L) j

/-- The probability estimate for any fixed number of subcritical batches.
Taking a constant K permits a linear total number K*B of requests. -/

Carpooling.stochastic_batched_high_proba.source:
theorem stochastic_batched_high_probability (N : V → Finset V) {Δ : ℕ}
    (hΔ : ∀ v, (N v).card ≤ Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (hsymm : ∀ {u v}, v ∈ N u → u ∈ N v)
    (g : E → Sym2 V) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (hbalance : 2 * Fintype.card E = Fintype.card V * Δ)
    (K B : ℕ) (hB : 16*B ≤ Fintype.card V) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card V) :
    uniformProb (badBatchEvent N g K B (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))) ≤
      (K : ℝ) / Fintype.card V := by
  have h := batch_failure_bound (K := K)
    (badDiscrepancyEvent N g B (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V)))
  have hp := stochastic_basic_high_probability N hΔ hpos hsymm g hg hbalance B hB hn
  calc
    _ ≤ (K : ℝ) * uniformProb (badDiscrepancyEvent N g B (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))) := h
    _ ≤ (K : ℝ) * (1/(Fintype.card V : ℝ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Global discrepancies add over completed batches and the current batch.
Every chronological prefix is represented by cutoffs: B for completed batches,
the current position for one batch, and zero for the future batches. -/

Carpooling.aggregate_bound_outside_bad_e.source:
theorem aggregate_bound_outside_bad_event {K B L : ℕ} (N : V → Finset V) (g : E → Sym2 V)
    (x : Fin K → Fin B → E) (hx : x ∉ badBatchEvent N g K B L)
    (R : Fin K → Run V B)
    (hi : ∀ j k, (R j).d 0 k = 0)
    (hAdj : ∀ j s (hs : s < B), ((R j).step s hs).v ∈ N ((R j).step s hs).u)
    (hbag : ∀ j, (R j).edgeBag B = sampleBag g (x j))
    (cutoff : Fin K → ℕ) (hcut : ∀ j, cutoff j ≤ B) (k : V) :
    |∑ j, (R j).d (cutoff j) k| ≤ (K : ℝ) * (4*(L : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3)) := by
  have hlocal : ∀ j, |(R j).d (cutoff j) k| ≤ 4*(L : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) := by
    intro j
    by_contra hn
    have hjbad : x j ∈ badDiscrepancyEvent N g B L := by
      apply mem_filter.mpr
      exact ⟨mem_univ _, R j, hi j, hAdj j, hbag j, cutoff j, hcut j, k, lt_of_not_ge hn⟩
    apply hx
    apply mem_biUnion.mpr
    exact ⟨j, mem_univ _, mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, hjbad⟩⟩
  calc
    |∑ j, (R j).d (cutoff j) k| ≤ ∑ j, |(R j).d (cutoff j) k| := abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin K, 4*(L : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) := sum_le_sum fun j _ => hlocal j
    _ = _ := by simp

end Carpooling

Carpooling.charged_potential_lower_bound.source:
theorem charged_potential_lower_bound {T h : ℕ}
    (d : ℕ → Fin (2*h+2) → ℤ) (I : Finset (Fin T))
    (hi : ∀ v, d 0 v = 0)
    (hchange : ∀ t : Fin T, (∀ v, |d t.val v| < (h:ℤ)) →
      integerPotential (d (t.val+1)) - integerPotential (d t.val) =
        if t ∈ I then 2 else 0)
    (hT : ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(I.card:ℤ)) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, ∃ v, (h:ℤ) ≤ |d t v| := by
  by_contra hn
  have hb : ∀ t, t ≤ T → ∀ v, |d t v| < (h:ℤ) := by
    intro t ht v
    by_contra hv
    exact hn ⟨t,ht,v,le_of_not_gt hv⟩
  have hsum := sum_congr (s₁ := (univ : Finset (Fin T))) rfl
    (fun t _ => hchange t (hb t.val (le_of_lt t.isLt)))
  have htel : (∑ t : Fin T, (integerPotential (d (t.val+1))-integerPotential (d t.val))) =
      integerPotential (d T) - integerPotential (d 0) := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun t => integerPotential (d (t+1))-integerPotential (d t)) T]
    exact sum_range_sub (fun t => integerPotential (d t)) T
  have hpot : integerPotential (d T) = 2*(I.card:ℤ) := by
    rw [htel] at hsum
    simpa [integerPotential,hi,mul_comm] using hsum
  have hsq : ∀ v, d T v ^ 2 ≤ (h:ℤ)^2 := by
    intro v
    have hv := le_of_lt (hb T (le_refl T) v)
    nlinarith [sq_abs (d T v),abs_nonneg (d T v)]
  have hbound := sum_le_sum (s := (univ : Finset (Fin (2*h+2)))) (fun v _ => hsq v)
  have hbound' : integerPotential (d T) ≤ ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 := by
    simpa [integerPotential] using hbound
  omega

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

Carpooling.UnitMove.embedded_potential_c.source:
lemma UnitMove.embedded_potential_change {h : ℕ} {x y : V → ℤ}
    (e : UnitMove x y) (f : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ V) (a b : Fin (2*h+2))
    (hedge : s(e.u,e.v) = s(f a,f b)) (hequal : x (f a) = x (f b)) :
    integerPotential (fun i => y (f i)) - integerPotential (fun i => x (f i)) = 2 := by
  rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp hedge with ⟨hu,hv⟩ | ⟨hu,hv⟩
  · have he := (e.pullback f a b hu.symm hv.symm).potential_change
    change integerPotential (fun i => y (f i)) = integerPotential (fun i => x (f i)) +
      2*(x (f a)-x (f b))+2 at he
    rw [hequal] at he
    omega
  · have he := (e.pullback f b a hu.symm hv.symm).potential_change
    change integerPotential (fun i => y (f i)) = integerPotential (fun i => x (f i)) +
      2*(x (f b)-x (f a))+2 at he
    rw [hequal] at he
    omega

end Carpooling

Carpooling.Clusters.source:
structure Clusters (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] where
  block : V → Finset V
  self_mem : ∀ k, k ∈ block k
  coherent : ∀ i j, j ∈ block i → block j = block i

Carpooling.Clusters.ext.source:
lemma Clusters.ext {P Q : Clusters V} (h : P.block = Q.block) : P = Q := by
  cases P; cases Q; cases h; rfl

Carpooling.Clusters.mem_iff.source:
lemma Clusters.mem_iff {P : Clusters V} {i j : V} :
    j ∈ P.block i ↔ P.block j = P.block i := by
  constructor
  · exact P.coherent i j
  · intro h; rw [← h]; exact P.self_mem j

Carpooling.Clusters.mem_symm.source:
lemma Clusters.mem_symm {P : Clusters V} {i j : V} (h : j ∈ P.block i) :
    i ∈ P.block j := by rw [P.coherent i j h]; exact P.self_mem i

Carpooling.Clusters.singletons.source:
def Clusters.singletons : Clusters V where
  block := singleton
  self_mem := by simp
  coherent := by intro i j h; simpa using (mem_singleton.mp h)

Carpooling.Clusters.outside.source:
lemma Clusters.outside {P : Clusters V} {u v i : V}
    (hi : i ∉ P.block u ∪ P.block v) {j : V} (hj : j ∈ P.block i) :
    j ∉ P.block u ∪ P.block v := by
  intro h
  rcases mem_union.mp h with h | h
  · have heq := (P.coherent u j h).symm.trans (P.coherent i j hj)
    exact hi (mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (by rw [heq]; exact P.self_mem i)))
  · have heq := (P.coherent v j h).symm.trans (P.coherent i j hj)
    exact hi (mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (by rw [heq]; exact P.self_mem i)))

Carpooling.Clusters.merge.source:
noncomputable def Clusters.merge (P : Clusters V) (u v : V) : Clusters V where
  block := fun k => if k ∈ P.block u ∪ P.block v then P.block u ∪ P.block v else P.block k
  self_mem := by intro k; split_ifs with h; exact h; exact P.self_mem k
  coherent := by
    intro i j h
    by_cases hi : i ∈ P.block u ∪ P.block v
    · simp only [if_pos hi] at h
      simp [h, hi]
    · simp only [if_neg hi] at h
      have hj := P.outside hi h
      simp only [if_neg hi, if_neg hj]
      exact P.coherent i j h

Carpooling.Clusters.merge_comm.source:
lemma Clusters.merge_comm (P : Clusters V) (u v : V) : P.merge u v = P.merge v u := by
  apply Clusters.ext
  funext k
  simp only [Clusters.merge, union_comm]

Carpooling.Clusters.subset_merge.source:
lemma Clusters.subset_merge (P : Clusters V) (u v k : V) :
    P.block k ⊆ (P.merge u v).block k := by
  intro j hj
  by_cases hk : k ∈ P.block u ∪ P.block v
  · simp only [Clusters.merge, if_pos hk]
    rcases mem_union.mp hk with hk | hk
    · exact mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (by rwa [← P.coherent u k hk]))
    · exact mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (by rwa [← P.coherent v k hk]))
  · simpa only [Clusters.merge, if_neg hk] using hj

Carpooling.Clusters.merge_at_u.source:
@[simp] lemma Clusters.merge_at_u (P : Clusters V) (u v : V) :
    (P.merge u v).block u = P.block u ∪ P.block v := by
  simp [Clusters.merge, P.self_mem]

Carpooling.Clusters.merge_at_v.source:
@[simp] lemma Clusters.merge_at_v (P : Clusters V) (u v : V) :
    (P.merge u v).block v = P.block u ∪ P.block v := by
  simp [Clusters.merge, P.self_mem]

Carpooling.Clusters.merge_same.source:
lemma Clusters.merge_same (P : Clusters V) {u v : V} (h : P.block u = P.block v) :
    P.merge u v = P := by
  apply Clusters.ext
  funext k
  change (if k ∈ P.block u ∪ P.block v then P.block u ∪ P.block v else P.block k) = P.block k
  rw [h, union_self]
  split_ifs with hk
  · exact (P.coherent v k hk).symm
  · rfl

Carpooling.Clusters.disjoint.source:
lemma Clusters.disjoint {P : Clusters V} {u v : V} (h : P.block u ≠ P.block v) :
    Disjoint (P.block u) (P.block v) := by
  apply disjoint_left.mpr
  intro k hu hv
  exact h ((P.coherent u k hu).symm.trans (P.coherent v k hv))

Carpooling.Clusters.parts.source: noncomputable def Clusters.parts (P : Clusters V) : Finset (Finset V) := univ.image P.block

Carpooling.Clusters.mem_parts.source:
lemma Clusters.mem_parts (P : Clusters V) (k : V) : P.block k ∈ P.parts :=
  mem_image.mpr ⟨k, mem_univ k, rfl⟩

Carpooling.Clusters.parts_merge.source:
lemma Clusters.parts_merge (P : Clusters V) (u v : V) :
    (P.merge u v).parts = insert (P.block u ∪ P.block v)
      ((P.parts.erase (P.block u)).erase (P.block v)) := by
  ext S
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨k, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp h
    by_cases hk : k ∈ P.block u ∪ P.block v
    · exact mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl (by simp only [Clusters.merge, if_pos hk]))
    · apply mem_insert.mpr; right
      have ha : P.block k ≠ P.block u := by
        intro h; exact hk (mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (by rw [← h]; exact P.self_mem k)))
      have hb : P.block k ≠ P.block v := by
        intro h; exact hk (mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (by rw [← h]; exact P.self_mem k)))
      change (if k ∈ P.block u ∪ P.block v then P.block u ∪ P.block v else P.block k) ∈ _
      rw [if_neg hk]
      exact mem_erase.mpr ⟨hb, mem_erase.mpr ⟨ha, P.mem_parts k⟩⟩
  · intro h
    rcases mem_insert.mp h with h | h
    · subst S
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨u, mem_univ u, P.merge_at_u u v⟩
    · obtain ⟨hb, ha, hS⟩ := by simpa [mem_erase] using h
      obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := mem_image.mp hS
      have hku : k ∉ P.block u := by
        intro h; exact ha (hk ▸ (P.coherent u k h))
      have hkv : k ∉ P.block v := by
        intro h; exact hb (hk ▸ (P.coherent v k h))
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨k, mem_univ k, by simpa [Clusters.merge, hku, hkv] using hk⟩

Carpooling.Clusters.parts_merge_card.source:
lemma Clusters.parts_merge_card (P : Clusters V) {u v : V}
    (h : P.block u ≠ P.block v) : (P.merge u v).parts.card + 1 = P.parts.card := by
  have hu := P.mem_parts u
  have hv := P.mem_parts v
  have hunion : P.block u ∪ P.block v ∉ P.parts := by
    intro hm
    obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := mem_image.mp hm
    have hmu : u ∈ P.block k := by rw [hk]; simp [P.self_mem]
    have hmv : v ∈ P.block k := by rw [hk]; simp [P.self_mem]
    exact h ((P.coherent k u hmu).trans (P.coherent k v hmv).symm)
  rw [P.parts_merge]
  have hnot : P.block u ∪ P.block v ∉ (P.parts.erase (P.block u)).erase (P.block v) := by
    intro hh; exact hunion (mem_of_mem_erase (mem_of_mem_erase hh))
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem hnot, card_erase_of_mem (by simp [hv, Ne.symm h]), card_erase_of_mem hu]
  have htwo : 2 ≤ P.parts.card := by
    have hs : ({P.block u, P.block v} : Finset (Finset V)) ⊆ P.parts := by
      intro S hS; rcases mem_insert.mp hS with rfl | hh
      · exact hu
      · have hh := mem_singleton.mp hh
        subst S
        exact hv
    simpa [h] using card_le_card hs
  omega

end Carpooling

Carpooling.Run.mask.source:
noncomputable def Run.mask {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (C : Finset V)
    (hC : R.Closed C) : Run V T where
  d := fun t k => if k ∈ C then R.d t k else 0
  step := fun t ht => by
    let e := R.step t ht
    have hc : e.u ∈ C ↔ e.v ∈ C := hC t ht
    refine ⟨e.u, e.v, e.distinct, if e.u ∈ C then e.weight else 0, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · split_ifs <;> linarith [e.weight_nonneg]
    · split_ifs <;> linarith [e.weight_le_one]
    · by_cases hu : e.u ∈ C
      · simp only [if_pos hu, if_pos (hc.mp hu)]; exact e.ordered
      · have hv : e.v ∉ C := fun hv => hu (hc.mpr hv)
        simp [hu, hv]
    · intro k
      by_cases hu : e.u ∈ C
      · have hv := hc.mp hu
        by_cases hk : k ∈ C
        · simp only [if_pos hu, if_pos hk]; exact e.update k
        · have hku : k ≠ e.u := fun h => hk (h ▸ hu)
          have hkv : k ≠ e.v := fun h => hk (h ▸ hv)
          simp [hk, hku, hkv]
      · have hv : e.v ∉ C := fun h => hu (hc.mpr h)
        by_cases hk : k ∈ C
        · have hku : k ≠ e.u := fun h => hu (h ▸ hk)
          have hkv : k ≠ e.v := fun h => hv (h ▸ hk)
          simp only [if_pos hk, if_neg hu]
          simpa [hku, hkv] using e.update k
        · simp [hk, hu]

Carpooling.internalCount.source:
noncomputable def internalCount {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (C : Finset V) (t : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((range t).filter fun s => ∃ h : s < T, (R.step s h).u ∈ C).card

Carpooling.mask_expandingCount_le.source:
lemma mask_expandingCount_le {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (C : Finset V)
    (hC : R.Closed C) (t : ℕ) :
    expandingCount (R.mask C hC) t ≤ internalCount R C t := by
  apply card_le_card
  intro s hs
  obtain ⟨hsrange, h, he⟩ := mem_filter.mp hs
  apply mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨hsrange, h, ?_⟩
  by_contra hu
  have hv : (R.step s h).v ∉ C := fun hv => hu ((hC s h).mpr hv)
  have : ¬((R.mask C hC).step s h).Expanding := by
    simp [Move.Expanding, Run.mask, hu, hv]
  exact this he

/-- Deterministic ingredient of Theorem 1.2: only arrivals in a closed component count.
No random-graph estimate is assumed to have been proved by this theorem. -/

Carpooling.closed_component_bound.source:
theorem closed_component_bound {T L : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (C : Finset V)
    (hC : R.Closed C) (hinit : ∀ k, R.d 0 k = 0)
    (hL : internalCount R C T ≤ L) {i : V} (hi : i ∈ C) :
    |R.d T i| ≤ 4 * (L : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) := by
  let M := R.mask C hC
  have hm : ∀ k, M.d 0 k = 0 := by intro k; simp [M, Run.mask, hinit]
  have hcube := abs_cube_bound_expanding M hm i
  have hcount : (expandingCount M T : ℝ) ≤ L := by
    exact_mod_cast le_trans (mask_expandingCount_le R C hC T) hL
  have hd : M.d T i = R.d T i := by simp [M, Run.mask, hi]
  rw [hd] at hcube
  apply le_four_cuberoot (abs_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  linarith

end Carpooling

Carpooling.populated.source:
noncomputable def populated (c : Ω → J → ℕ) (L : ℕ) (x : Ω) : Finset J :=
  univ.filter fun j => L ≤ c x j

Carpooling.lowCountEvent.source:
noncomputable def lowCountEvent (c : Ω → J → ℕ) (L : ℕ) (j : J) : Finset Ω :=
  univ.filter fun x => c x j < L

Carpooling.lowCount_probability.source:
lemma lowCount_probability (c : Ω → J → ℕ) {N L : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hL : 2*L ≤ N)
    (hv : ∀ j, uniformMean (fun x => ((c x j:ℝ)-N)^2) ≤ (N:ℝ)) (j : J) :
    uniformProb (lowCountEvent c L j) ≤ 4/(N:ℝ) := by
  have hpoint : ∀ x, eventIndicator (lowCountEvent c L j) x*(N:ℝ)^2 ≤ 4*((c x j:ℝ)-N)^2 := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : c x j < L
    · have hlow : 2*(c x j:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 2*c x j ≤ N)
      have hn : (0:ℝ) ≤ c x j := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      simp only [eventIndicator,lowCountEvent,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and,if_pos hx]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((N:ℝ)-2*(c x j:ℝ))]
    · simp [eventIndicator,lowCountEvent,hx,sq_nonneg]
  have hb := uniformMean_mono hpoint
  rw [uniformMean_mul_const,uniformMean_indicator,uniformMean_const_mul] at hb
  have hNR : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hNR).mpr
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hNR).mp
  nlinarith [hv j]

Carpooling.fewPopulated.source:
noncomputable def fewPopulated (c : Ω → J → ℕ) (L : ℕ) : Finset Ω :=
  univ.filter fun x => 2*(populated c L x).card < Fintype.card J

Carpooling.fewPopulated_probability.source:
theorem fewPopulated_probability (c : Ω → J → ℕ) {N L : ℕ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hL : 2*L ≤ N)
    (hv : ∀ j, uniformMean (fun x => ((c x j:ℝ)-N)^2) ≤ (N:ℝ)) :
    uniformProb (fewPopulated c L) ≤ 8/(N:ℝ) := by
  have hbadcount : ∀ x, (∑ j, eventIndicator (lowCountEvent c L j) x) =
      (Fintype.card J:ℝ)-(populated c L x).card := by
    intro x
    have hcomp : (univ.filter fun j => c x j < L) = univ \ populated c L x := by
      ext j; simp [populated,not_le]
    have hcard : (populated c L x).card ≤ Fintype.card J := card_le_univ _
    simp only [eventIndicator,lowCountEvent,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and]
    rw [sum_boole,hcomp,card_sdiff]
    simp [Nat.cast_sub hcard]
  have hpoint : ∀ x, eventIndicator (fewPopulated c L) x*(Fintype.card J:ℝ) ≤
      2*∑ j, eventIndicator (lowCountEvent c L j) x := by
    intro x
    rw [hbadcount]
    by_cases hx : 2*(populated c L x).card < Fintype.card J
    · have hxR : 2*((populated c L x).card:ℝ) < (Fintype.card J:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
      simp only [eventIndicator,fewPopulated,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and,if_pos hx]
      linarith
    · have hcard : ((populated c L x).card:ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card J:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast card_le_univ (populated c L x)
      simp only [eventIndicator,fewPopulated,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and,if_neg hx,zero_mul]
      linarith
  have hb := uniformMean_mono hpoint
  rw [uniformMean_mul_const,uniformMean_indicator,uniformMean_const_mul,uniformMean_sum] at hb
  simp only [uniformMean_indicator] at hb
  have hs : (∑ j, uniformProb (lowCountEvent c L j)) ≤ (Fintype.card J:ℝ)*(4/(N:ℝ)) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _j : J, (4/(N:ℝ)) := sum_le_sum (fun j _ => lowCount_probability c hN hL hv j)
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hM : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card J := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hM).mp
  calc
    _ ≤ 2*∑ j, uniformProb (lowCountEvent c L j) := by simpa only [mul_comm] using hb
    _ ≤ 2*((Fintype.card J:ℝ)*(4/(N:ℝ))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (by norm_num)
    _ = _ := by ring

end Carpooling

Carpooling.topSum_sq_le.source:
lemma topSum_sq_le {x : V → ℝ} {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ Fintype.card V)
    (hs : 0 ≤ topSum x r) : (topSum x r)^2 ≤ (r : ℝ) * potential x := by
  let A := topSet x r
  have hc : A.card = r := (topSet_spec x hr).1
  have hsum : topSum x r ≤ ∑ k ∈ A, max (x k) 0 :=
    sum_le_sum fun k _ => le_max_left _ _
  have hcs := sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq A (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (fun k => max (x k) 0)
  simp only [one_mul, one_pow, sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one, hc] at hcs
  have hsub : (∑ k ∈ A, (max (x k) 0)^2) ≤ potential x := by
    apply sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg (subset_univ A)
    intro k _ _; exact sq_nonneg _
  have hsq : (topSum x r)^2 ≤ (∑ k ∈ A, max (x k) 0)^2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ hs hsum 2
  exact hsq.trans (hcs.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsub (Nat.cast_nonneg r)))

Carpooling.Run.total_nonpos.source:
lemma Run.total_nonpos {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (hinit : ∀ k, R.d 0 k ≤ 0)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T) : (∑ k, R.d t k) ≤ 0 := by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact sum_nonpos fun k _ => hinit k
  | succ t ih => rw [(R.step t (by omega)).sum_preserved]; exact ih (by omega)

/-- The n part of Lemma 3.1. -/

Carpooling.position_le_card.source:
theorem position_le_card {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (hinit : ∀ k, R.d 0 k ≤ 0)
    (i : V) : R.d T i ≤ Fintype.card V := by
  by_contra hn
  have hnD : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) < R.d T i := lt_of_not_ge hn
  have hnpos : 1 ≤ Fintype.card V := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨i⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hspread⟩ := spreadness R hinit (le_refl (R.d T i)) hnpos
    (le_refl (Fintype.card V)) (le_of_lt hnD)
  rw [topSum_all] at hspread
  have hsum := R.total_nonpos hinit ht
  have hcast : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card V := by exact_mod_cast hnpos
  have hprod : 0 < (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * (R.d T i - Fintype.card V + 1) :=
    mul_pos hcast (by linarith)
  linarith

Carpooling.expandingCount_mono.source:
lemma expandingCount_mono {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) {s t : ℕ} (hst : s ≤ t) :
    expandingCount R s ≤ expandingCount R t := by
  classical
  apply card_le_card
  exact filter_subset_filter _ (range_mono hst)

/-- Lemma 3.1 in polynomial form: equivalent to the stated cube-root bound.
The exact count of expanding moves, rather than T, appears on the right. -/

Carpooling.positive_cube_bound.source:
theorem positive_cube_bound {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T)
    (hinit : ∀ k, R.d 0 k ≤ 0) (i : V) :
    (max (R.d T i) 0)^3 ≤ 64 * (expandingCount R T : ℝ) := by
  let D := R.d T i
  let p := expandingCount R T
  change (max D 0)^3 ≤ 64 * (p : ℝ)
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  by_cases hD : D ≤ 0
  · simp only [max_eq_right hD, zero_pow (by decide : 3 ≠ 0)]
    positivity
  rw [max_eq_left (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hD))]
  have hDpos : 0 < D := lt_of_not_ge hD
  have hpot := potential_bound R hinit (le_refl T)
  have hone : posSq D ≤ potential (R.d T) :=
    single_le_sum (f := fun k => posSq (R.d T k)) (fun k _ => posSq_nonneg _) (mem_univ i)
  have hp_pos : 0 < p := by
    by_contra hn
    have hpzero : p = 0 := by omega
    have hs : posSq D = D^2 := by simp [posSq, max_eq_left (le_of_lt hDpos)]
    change potential (R.d T) ≤ 2 * (p : ℝ) at hpot
    rw [hpzero, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero] at hpot
    nlinarith
  have hp_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp_pos
  by_cases hsmall : D < 2
  · have hDsq : D^2 < 4 := by nlinarith
    have hmul : D^2 * D < 4 * 2 :=
      mul_lt_mul hDsq hsmall.le hDpos (by norm_num)
    nlinarith
  have hDtwo : 2 ≤ D := le_of_not_gt hsmall
  let r := ⌊D/2⌋₊ + 1
  have hr : 1 ≤ r := by omega
  have hfloor := Nat.floor_le (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ D/2)
  have hfloorlt := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (D/2)
  have hrlo : D/2 ≤ (r : ℝ) := by exact le_of_lt (by simpa [r] using hfloorlt)
  have hrhi : (r : ℝ) ≤ D/2+1 := by dsimp [r]; push_cast; linarith
  have hrD : (r : ℝ) ≤ D := by linarith
  have hDn : D ≤ Fintype.card V := position_le_card R hinit i
  have hrn : r ≤ Fintype.card V := by exact_mod_cast (le_trans hrD hDn)
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hspread⟩ := spreadness R hinit (le_refl D) hr hrn hrD
  have hB : D/2 ≤ D - (r : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
  have hSpos : 0 ≤ topSum (R.d t) r := by
    have : 0 ≤ (r : ℝ) * (D-r+1) := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hcs := topSum_sq_le hrn hSpos
  have henergy := potential_bound R hinit ht
  have hcount : (expandingCount R t : ℝ) ≤ p := by
    exact_mod_cast expandingCount_mono R ht
  have hrpos : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hSsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg r) (by linarith : 0 ≤ D-r+1)) hspread 2
  have hcancel : (r : ℝ) * (D-r+1)^2 ≤ 2*(p : ℝ) := by
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hrpos).mp
    nlinarith
  have hBsq : (D/2)^2 ≤ (D-(r : ℝ)+1)^2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hB 2
  have hlower : (D/2)*(D/2)^2 ≤ (r : ℝ)*(D-r+1)^2 :=
    mul_le_mul hrlo hBsq (sq_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  nlinarith

/-- Two-sided expanding-move version, from a zero initial state. -/

Carpooling.abs_cube_bound_expanding.source:
theorem abs_cube_bound_expanding {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T)
    (hinit : ∀ k, R.d 0 k = 0) (i : V) :
    |R.d T i|^3 ≤ 64 * (expandingCount R T : ℝ) := by
  by_cases h : 0 ≤ R.d T i
  · have hp := positive_cube_bound R (fun k => le_of_eq (hinit k)) i
    simpa [abs_of_nonneg h, max_eq_left h] using hp
  · have hn := positive_cube_bound R.neg (by intro k; simp [Run.neg, hinit]) i
    rw [expandingCount_neg] at hn
    simpa [Run.neg, abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge h), max_eq_left (by linarith : 0 ≤ -R.d T i)] using hn

/-- Theorem 1.1, polynomial form, at every prefix and for every vertex. -/

Carpooling.deterministic_upper_bound.source:
theorem deterministic_upper_bound {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T)
    (hinit : ∀ k, R.d 0 k = 0) {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T) (i : V) :
    |R.d t i|^3 ≤ 64 * (t : ℝ) ∧ |R.d t i| ≤ Fintype.card V := by
  let P := R.prefix t ht
  have hi : ∀ k, P.d 0 k = 0 := hinit
  constructor
  · have hc := abs_cube_bound_expanding P hi i
    have hcount : (expandingCount P t : ℝ) ≤ t := by exact_mod_cast expandingCount_le P t
    change |R.d t i|^3 ≤ 64 * (expandingCount P t : ℝ) at hc
    linarith
  · have hp := position_le_card P (fun k => le_of_eq (hi k)) i
    have hn := position_le_card P.neg (by intro k; simp [Run.neg, hi]) i
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by simpa [P, Run.neg, Run.prefix] using neg_le_neg hn, hp⟩

end Carpooling

Carpooling.disjointCliques.source:
def disjointCliques : SimpleGraph (J × U) where
  Adj x y := x.1 = y.1 ∧ x.2 ≠ y.2
  symm := fun _ _ h => ⟨h.1.symm,h.2.symm⟩
  loopless := fun _ h => h.2 rfl

instance disjointCliques_decidableAdj : DecidableRel (disjointCliques (J := J) (U := U)).Adj :=
  fun _ _ => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ = _ ∧ _ ≠ _))

Carpooling.disjointCliques_regular.source:
theorem disjointCliques_regular :
    (disjointCliques (J := J) (U := U)).IsRegularOfDegree (Fintype.card U-1) := by
  intro ⟨j,u⟩
  let e : (disjointCliques (J := J) (U := U)).neighborSet (j,u) ≃ {v : U // v ≠ u} := {
    toFun := fun v => ⟨v.val.2,Ne.symm v.property.2⟩
    invFun := fun v => ⟨(j,v.val),⟨rfl,Ne.symm v.property⟩⟩
    left_inv := fun v => Subtype.ext (Prod.ext v.property.1 rfl)
    right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  rw [←SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree]
  calc
    _ = Fintype.card {v : U // v ≠ u} := Fintype.card_congr e
    _ = Fintype.card U-1 := by rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl]; simp

Carpooling.disjointCliqueEdgeMap.source:
noncomputable def disjointCliqueEdgeMap
    (p : J × (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet) : (disjointCliques (J := J) (U := U)).edgeSet := by
  refine ⟨p.2.val.map (fun u => (p.1,u)),?_⟩
  obtain ⟨⟨u,v⟩,he⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective p.2.val
  have huv : u ≠ v := by simpa [←he] using p.2.property
  rw [←he,Sym2.map_pair_eq,SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet]
  exact ⟨rfl,huv⟩

Carpooling.disjointCliqueEdgeMap_injecti.source:
lemma disjointCliqueEdgeMap_injective :
    Function.Injective (disjointCliqueEdgeMap (J := J) (U := U)) := by
  rintro ⟨j,e⟩ ⟨k,f⟩ h
  obtain ⟨⟨u,v⟩,he⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective e.val
  obtain ⟨⟨w,z⟩,hf⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective f.val
  have hh := congrArg Subtype.val h
  change e.val.map (fun u => (j,u)) = f.val.map (fun u => (k,u)) at hh
  rw [←he,←hf,Sym2.map_pair_eq,Sym2.map_pair_eq] at hh
  rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp hh with ⟨hu,hv⟩ | ⟨hu,hv⟩
  · refine Prod.ext (show j = k from congrArg Prod.fst hu) ?_
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [←he,←hf]
    exact Sym2.eq_iff.mpr (Or.inl ⟨congrArg Prod.snd hu,congrArg Prod.snd hv⟩)
  · refine Prod.ext (show j = k from congrArg Prod.fst hu) ?_
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [←he,←hf]
    exact Sym2.eq_iff.mpr (Or.inr ⟨congrArg Prod.snd hu,congrArg Prod.snd hv⟩)

Carpooling.disjointCliqueEdgeMap_surject.source:
lemma disjointCliqueEdgeMap_surjective :
    Function.Surjective (disjointCliqueEdgeMap (J := J) (U := U)) := by
  intro e
  obtain ⟨⟨⟨j,u⟩,⟨k,v⟩⟩,he⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective e.val
  have hadj : j = k ∧ u ≠ v := by
    have hm := e.property
    rw [←he,SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] at hm
    exact hm
  rcases hadj with ⟨hjk,huv⟩
  subst k
  refine ⟨(j,⟨s(u,v),by simpa using huv⟩),?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact he

Carpooling.disjointCliqueEdgeEquiv.source:
noncomputable def disjointCliqueEdgeEquiv :
    (J × (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet) ≃ (disjointCliques (J := J) (U := U)).edgeSet :=
  Equiv.ofBijective disjointCliqueEdgeMap
    ⟨disjointCliqueEdgeMap_injective,disjointCliqueEdgeMap_surjective⟩

Carpooling.disjointCliqueEdgeEquiv_val.source:
@[simp] lemma disjointCliqueEdgeEquiv_val (p : J × (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet) :
    (disjointCliqueEdgeEquiv p).val = p.2.val.map (fun u => (p.1,u)) := rfl

Carpooling.disjointCliques_edge_card.source:
theorem disjointCliques_edge_card :
    Fintype.card (disjointCliques (J := J) (U := U)).edgeSet =
      Fintype.card J*(Fintype.card U).choose 2 := by
  have hc := (Fintype.card_congr (disjointCliqueEdgeEquiv (J := J) (U := U))).symm
  rw [Fintype.card_prod] at hc
  have he : Fintype.card (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet = (Fintype.card U).choose 2 := by
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.edgeFinset_card] using
      (SimpleGraph.card_edgeFinset_top_eq_card_choose_two (V := U))
  rwa [he] at hc

/-- Splitting a uniform graph-edge word into independent uniform clique labels
and independent uniform local edges is an exact finite sample-space bijection. -/

Carpooling.cliqueSampleEquiv.source:
noncomputable def cliqueSampleEquiv (T : ℕ) :
    ((Fin T → J) × (Fin T → (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet)) ≃
      (Fin T → (disjointCliques (J := J) (U := U)).edgeSet) where
  toFun x t := disjointCliqueEdgeEquiv (x.1 t,x.2 t)
  invFun y := (fun t => (disjointCliqueEdgeEquiv.symm (y t)).1,
    fun t => (disjointCliqueEdgeEquiv.symm (y t)).2)
  left_inv x := by
    apply Prod.ext <;> funext t <;> simp
  right_inv y := by
    funext t
    simp

end Carpooling

Carpooling.topSum_mono.source:
lemma topSum_mono {x y : V → ℝ} (h : ∀ k, x k ≤ y k) {r : ℕ}
    (hr : r ≤ Fintype.card V) : topSum x r ≤ topSum y r := by
  exact (sum_le_sum fun k _ => h k).trans
    ((topSet_spec y hr).2 _ (topSet_spec x hr).1)

Carpooling.potential_mono.source:
lemma potential_mono {x y : V → ℝ} (h : ∀ k, x k ≤ y k) :
    potential x ≤ potential y := by
  apply sum_le_sum
  intro k _
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (le_max_right _ _) (max_le_max (h k) le_rfl) 2

/-- Spreadness survives arbitrary coordinate decreases after a legal move. -/

Carpooling.Move.topSum_dominated_step.source:
lemma Move.topSum_dominated_step {x z y : V → ℝ} (e : Move x z)
    (hy : ∀ k, y k ≤ z k) {r : ℕ} (hrn : r < Fintype.card V)
    (hinc : topSum x r < topSum y r) :
    2 * topSum y r - topSum y (r-1) - 2 ≤ topSum x (r+1) := by
  let A := topSet y r
  have hc : A.card = r := (topSet_spec y (Nat.le_of_lt hrn)).1
  have hs : (∑ k ∈ A, y k) = topSum y r := rfl
  have hbefore : (∑ k ∈ A, x k) ≤ topSum x r := by
    simpa [hc] using sum_le_topSum x A
  have hdom : (∑ k ∈ A, y k) ≤ ∑ k ∈ A, z k := sum_le_sum fun k _ => hy k
  have hchange := e.sum_update A
  have hu : e.u ∈ A := by
    by_contra h
    by_cases hv : e.v ∈ A
    · simp only [if_neg h, if_pos hv] at hchange
      linarith [e.weight_nonneg]
    · simp only [if_neg h, if_neg hv] at hchange
      linarith
  have hv : e.v ∉ A := by
    intro h
    simp only [if_pos hu, if_pos h] at hchange
    linarith
  have hrem : (A.erase e.u).card = r-1 := by simp [card_erase_of_mem hu, hc]
  have hsmall := sum_le_topSum y (A.erase e.u)
  rw [hrem, sum_erase_eq_sub hu] at hsmall
  have hgap : y e.u - z e.v ≤ 2 := by
    have h := hy e.u
    rw [e.at_u] at h
    rw [e.at_v]
    linarith [e.ordered, e.weight_le_one]
  have hcard : (insert e.v A).card = r+1 := by simp [hv, hc]
  have hlarge := sum_le_topSum x (insert e.v A)
  rw [hcard] at hlarge
  have hsame : (∑ k ∈ insert e.v A, z k) = ∑ k ∈ insert e.v A, x k := by
    simpa [hu] using e.sum_update (insert e.v A)
  rw [sum_insert hv] at hsame
  linarith

/-- A chip move followed by coordinate decreases, or decreases alone.
The boolean records a charged move; every expanding move must be charged. -/

Carpooling.DStep.source:
inductive DStep (x y : V → ℝ) (charged : Bool) : Prop
  | drop (h : ∀ k, y k ≤ x k)
  | move {z : V → ℝ} (e : Move x z) (h : ∀ k, y k ≤ z k)
      (charge : e.Expanding → charged = true)

Carpooling.DStep.potential_le.source:
lemma DStep.potential_le {x y : V → ℝ} {c : Bool} (h : DStep x y c) :
    potential y ≤ potential x + (if c then 2 else 0) := by
  cases h with
  | drop h => have hh := potential_mono h; cases c <;> simp_all <;> linarith
  | move e h hc =>
    have hmono := potential_mono h
    have he := e.potential_le
    by_cases hex : e.Expanding
    · rw [hc hex]; simpa [hex] using hmono.trans he
    · cases c <;> simp_all <;> linarith

Carpooling.DStep.total_le.source:
lemma DStep.total_le {x y : V → ℝ} {c : Bool} (h : DStep x y c) :
    (∑ k, y k) ≤ ∑ k, x k := by
  cases h with
  | drop h => exact sum_le_sum fun k _ => h k
  | move e h hc => exact (sum_le_sum fun k _ => h k).trans_eq e.sum_preserved

Carpooling.DStep.topSum_step.source:
lemma DStep.topSum_step {x y : V → ℝ} {c : Bool} (h : DStep x y c)
    {r : ℕ} (hrn : r < Fintype.card V) (hinc : topSum x r < topSum y r) :
    2 * topSum y r - topSum y (r-1) - 2 ≤ topSum x (r+1) := by
  cases h with
  | drop h => exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge (topSum_mono h (Nat.le_of_lt hrn))) hinc)
  | move e h hc => exact e.topSum_dominated_step h hrn hinc

Carpooling.DRun.source:
structure DRun (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (T : ℕ) where
  d : ℕ → V → ℝ
  charge : ℕ → Bool
  step : ∀ t, t < T → DStep (d t) (d (t+1)) (charge t)

Carpooling.DRun.count.source:
def DRun.count {T : ℕ} (R : DRun V T) (t : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((range t).filter fun s => R.charge s = true).card

Carpooling.DRun.count_mono.source:
lemma DRun.count_mono {T : ℕ} (R : DRun V T) {s t : ℕ} (h : s ≤ t) :
    R.count s ≤ R.count t := card_le_card (filter_subset_filter _ (range_mono h))

Carpooling.DRun.count_succ.source:
lemma DRun.count_succ {T : ℕ} (R : DRun V T) (t : ℕ) :
    R.count (t+1) = R.count t + if R.charge t then 1 else 0 := by
  simp only [DRun.count, range_add_one, filter_insert]
  cases hc : R.charge t <;> simp [hc]

Carpooling.DRun.potential_bound.source:
lemma DRun.potential_bound {T : ℕ} (R : DRun V T) (hi : ∀ k, R.d 0 k ≤ 0)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T) : potential (R.d t) ≤ 2 * (R.count t : ℝ) := by
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    have hz : potential (R.d 0) = 0 := by
      apply sum_eq_zero
      intro k _; simp [posSq, max_eq_right (hi k)]
    simp [hz, DRun.count]
  | succ t ih =>
    have hs := (R.step t (by omega)).potential_le
    have hp := ih (by omega)
    rw [R.count_succ, Nat.cast_add]
    cases hc : R.charge t <;> simp_all <;> linarith

Carpooling.DRun.total_nonpos.source:
lemma DRun.total_nonpos {T : ℕ} (R : DRun V T) (hi : ∀ k, R.d 0 k ≤ 0)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T) : (∑ k, R.d t k) ≤ 0 := by
  induction t with
  | zero => exact sum_nonpos fun k _ => hi k
  | succ t ih => exact (R.step t (by omega)).total_le.trans (ih (by omega))

Carpooling.DRun.spreadness.source:
lemma DRun.spreadness {T : ℕ} (R : DRun V T) (hi : ∀ k, R.d 0 k ≤ 0)
    {D : ℝ} {i : V} (hD : D ≤ R.d T i) {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hrn : r ≤ Fintype.card V) (hrD : (r : ℝ) ≤ D) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, (r : ℝ) * (D-r+1) ≤ topSum (R.d t) r := by
  apply threshold_crossing (S := fun t r => topSum (R.d t) r) hr hrD
  · intro t; exact topSum_zero _
  · intro s; exact topSum_nonpos hi s
  · intro t ht s hs hsr hinc
    exact (R.step t ht).topSum_step (lt_of_lt_of_le hsr hrn) hinc
  · exact hD.trans (le_topSum_one _ i)

Carpooling.DRun.position_le_card.source:
lemma DRun.position_le_card {T : ℕ} (R : DRun V T) (hi : ∀ k, R.d 0 k ≤ 0)
    (i : V) : R.d T i ≤ Fintype.card V := by
  by_contra hn
  have hnD : (Fintype.card V : ℝ) < R.d T i := lt_of_not_ge hn
  have hnpos : 1 ≤ Fintype.card V := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨i⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hs⟩ := R.spreadness hi (le_refl (R.d T i)) hnpos le_rfl hnD.le
  rw [topSum_all] at hs
  have hsum := R.total_nonpos hi ht
  have hcast : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card V := by exact_mod_cast hnpos
  have hprod : 0 < (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * (R.d T i - Fintype.card V + 1) :=
    mul_pos hcast (by linarith)
  linarith

Carpooling.DRun.positive_cube_bound.source:
theorem DRun.positive_cube_bound {T : ℕ} (R : DRun V T)
    (hinit : ∀ k, R.d 0 k ≤ 0) (i : V) :
    (max (R.d T i) 0)^3 ≤ 64 * (R.count T : ℝ) := by
  let D := R.d T i
  let p := R.count T
  change (max D 0)^3 ≤ 64 * (p : ℝ)
  have hp : (0 : ℝ) ≤ p := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  by_cases hD : D ≤ 0
  · simp only [max_eq_right hD, zero_pow (by decide : 3 ≠ 0)]
    positivity
  rw [max_eq_left (le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hD))]
  have hDpos : 0 < D := lt_of_not_ge hD
  have hpot := R.potential_bound hinit (le_refl T)
  have hone : posSq D ≤ potential (R.d T) :=
    single_le_sum (f := fun k => posSq (R.d T k)) (fun k _ => posSq_nonneg _) (mem_univ i)
  have hp_pos : 0 < p := by
    by_contra hn
    have hpzero : p = 0 := by omega
    have hs : posSq D = D^2 := by simp [posSq, max_eq_left (le_of_lt hDpos)]
    change potential (R.d T) ≤ 2 * (p : ℝ) at hpot
    rw [hpzero, Nat.cast_zero, mul_zero] at hpot
    nlinarith
  have hp_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp_pos
  by_cases hsmall : D < 2
  · have hDsq : D^2 < 4 := by nlinarith
    have hmul : D^2 * D < 4 * 2 :=
      mul_lt_mul hDsq hsmall.le hDpos (by norm_num)
    nlinarith
  have hDtwo : 2 ≤ D := le_of_not_gt hsmall
  let r := ⌊D/2⌋₊ + 1
  have hr : 1 ≤ r := by omega
  have hfloor := Nat.floor_le (by linarith : (0 : ℝ) ≤ D/2)
  have hfloorlt := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (D/2)
  have hrlo : D/2 ≤ (r : ℝ) := by exact le_of_lt (by simpa [r] using hfloorlt)
  have hrhi : (r : ℝ) ≤ D/2+1 := by dsimp [r]; push_cast; linarith
  have hrD : (r : ℝ) ≤ D := by linarith
  have hDn : D ≤ Fintype.card V := R.position_le_card hinit i
  have hrn : r ≤ Fintype.card V := by exact_mod_cast (le_trans hrD hDn)
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hspread⟩ := R.spreadness hinit (le_refl D) hr hrn hrD
  have hB : D/2 ≤ D - (r : ℝ) + 1 := by linarith
  have hSpos : 0 ≤ topSum (R.d t) r := by
    have : 0 ≤ (r : ℝ) * (D-r+1) := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by linarith)
    linarith
  have hcs := topSum_sq_le hrn hSpos
  have henergy := R.potential_bound hinit ht
  have hcount : (R.count t : ℝ) ≤ p := by
    exact_mod_cast R.count_mono ht
  have hrpos : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have hSsq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg r) (by linarith : 0 ≤ D-r+1)) hspread 2
  have hcancel : (r : ℝ) * (D-r+1)^2 ≤ 2*(p : ℝ) := by
    apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hrpos).mp
    nlinarith
  have hBsq : (D/2)^2 ≤ (D-(r : ℝ)+1)^2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (by linarith) hB 2
  have hlower : (D/2)*(D/2)^2 ≤ (r : ℝ)*(D-r+1)^2 :=
    mul_le_mul hrlo hBsq (sq_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  nlinarith

Carpooling.DRun.position_bound.source:
theorem DRun.position_bound {T : ℕ} (R : DRun V T) (hi : ∀ k, R.d 0 k ≤ 0)
    (i : V) : R.d T i ≤ 4 * (R.count T : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) :=
  (le_max_left _ _).trans (le_four_cuberoot (le_max_right _ _)
    (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (R.positive_cube_bound hi i))

end Carpooling

Carpooling.UnitMove.pullback.source:
def UnitMove.pullback {x y : V → ℤ} (e : UnitMove x y) (f : W ↪ V)
    (a b : W) (ha : f a = e.u) (hb : f b = e.v) :
    UnitMove (fun i => x (f i)) (fun i => y (f i)) where
  u := a
  v := b
  distinct := fun hab => e.distinct (ha.symm.trans ((congrArg f hab).trans hb))
  update := by
    intro k
    rw [e.update]
    simp only [←ha,←hb,f.injective.eq_iff]

Carpooling.IntegerRun.pullback.source:
noncomputable def IntegerRun.pullback {T : ℕ} (R : IntegerRun V T) (f : W ↪ V)
    (hends : ∀ t (ht : t < T), ∃ a b, f a = (R.step t ht).u ∧ f b = (R.step t ht).v) :
    IntegerRun W T where
  d := fun t i => R.d t (f i)
  step := fun t ht =>
    let a := (hends t ht).choose
    let b := (hends t ht).choose_spec.choose
    (R.step t ht).pullback f a b
      (hends t ht).choose_spec.choose_spec.1 (hends t ht).choose_spec.choose_spec.2

Carpooling.IntegerRun.pullback_u.source:
lemma IntegerRun.pullback_u {T : ℕ} (R : IntegerRun V T) (f : W ↪ V)
    (hends : ∀ t (ht : t < T), ∃ a b, f a = (R.step t ht).u ∧ f b = (R.step t ht).v)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t < T) : f ((R.pullback f hends).step t ht).u = (R.step t ht).u :=
  (hends t ht).choose_spec.choose_spec.1

Carpooling.IntegerRun.pullback_v.source:
lemma IntegerRun.pullback_v {T : ℕ} (R : IntegerRun V T) (f : W ↪ V)
    (hends : ∀ t (ht : t < T), ∃ a b, f a = (R.step t ht).u ∧ f b = (R.step t ht).v)
    (t : ℕ) (ht : t < T) : f ((R.pullback f hends).step t ht).v = (R.step t ht).v :=
  (hends t ht).choose_spec.choose_spec.2

Carpooling.embedded_equal_endpoint_lower.source:
theorem embedded_equal_endpoint_lower_bound {T h : ℕ} (R : IntegerRun V T)
    (f : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ V)
    (hends : ∀ t (ht : t < T), ∃ a b, f a = (R.step t ht).u ∧ f b = (R.step t ht).v)
    (hi : ∀ v, R.d 0 v = 0)
    (hequal : ∀ t (ht : t < T), (∀ i, |R.d t (f i)| < (h:ℤ)) →
      R.d t (R.step t ht).u = R.d t (R.step t ht).v)
    (hT : ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(T:ℤ)) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, ∃ v, (h:ℤ) ≤ |R.d t v| := by
  obtain ⟨t,ht,i,hi'⟩ := equal_endpoint_lower_bound (R.pullback f hends)
    (fun i => hi (f i)) (fun t ht hb => by
      change R.d t (f _) = R.d t (f _)
      rw [R.pullback_u f hends t ht,R.pullback_v f hends t ht]
      exact hequal t ht hb) (by simpa using hT)
  exact ⟨t,ht,f i,hi'⟩

section Probability
variable {E : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]

/-- Force only 2h+2 chosen vertices, while sampling uniformly from an arbitrary
larger edge alphabet. The probability cost uses the ambient alphabet size;
the cubic horizon depends only on the small forced set. -/

Carpooling.embedded_local_lower_probabil.source:
theorem embedded_local_lower_probability (h : ℕ) (f : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ V)
    (g : E → Sym2 V)
    (encode : (a b : Fin (2*h+2)) → a ≠ b → E)
    (hencode : ∀ a b hab, g (encode a b hab) = s(f a,f b))
    (T : ℕ) (hT : ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(T:ℤ))
    (R : (Fin T → E) → IntegerRun V T)
    (hi : ∀ x v, (R x).d 0 v = 0)
    (hrequest : ∀ x t (ht : t < T),
      s(((R x).step t ht).u,((R x).step t ht).v) = g (x ⟨t,ht⟩))
    (hcausal : ∀ (t : Fin T) (x y : Fin T → E),
      (∀ s : Fin t.val, x ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (R x).d t.val = (R y).d t.val) :
    1/(Fintype.card E:ℝ)^T ≤ uniformProb (integerDiscrepancyEvent R h) := by
  classical
  let P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E := fun t z =>
    let pos := fun i => (R (extendSamplePrefix t z)).d t.val (f i)
    encode (lowerPair h pos).1 (lowerPair h pos).2 (lowerPair_distinct h pos)
  rw [←adaptive_matching_probability P]
  apply uniformProb_mono
  intro x hx
  have hm := (mem_filter.mp hx).2
  have hedge : ∀ t (ht : t < T),
      s(((R x).step t ht).u,((R x).step t ht).v) =
        s(f (lowerPair h (fun i => (R x).d t (f i))).1,
          f (lowerPair h (fun i => (R x).d t (f i))).2) := by
    intro t ht
    let ti : Fin T := ⟨t,ht⟩
    let z : Fin ti.val → E := fun s => x ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt ti.isLt⟩
    have hstate : (R (extendSamplePrefix ti z)).d t = (R x).d t := by
      apply hcausal ti
      intro s
      simp [extendSamplePrefix,z,s.isLt]
    rw [hrequest x t ht,hm ti]
    change g (encode _ _ _) = _
    rw [hencode]
    change s(f (lowerPair h (fun i => (R (extendSamplePrefix ti z)).d t (f i))).1,
      f (lowerPair h (fun i => (R (extendSamplePrefix ti z)).d t (f i))).2) = _
    rw [hstate]
  have hends : ∀ t (ht : t < T), ∃ a b,
      f a = ((R x).step t ht).u ∧ f b = ((R x).step t ht).v := by
    intro t ht
    rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp (hedge t ht) with ⟨hu,hv⟩ | ⟨hu,hv⟩
    · exact ⟨_,_,hu.symm,hv.symm⟩
    · exact ⟨_,_,hu.symm,hv.symm⟩
  simp only [integerDiscrepancyEvent,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and]
  apply embedded_equal_endpoint_lower_bound (R x) f hends (hi x) _ hT
  intro t ht hb
  have hp := lowerPair_equal h (fun i => (R x).d t (f i)) hb
  rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp (hedge t ht) with ⟨hu,hv⟩ | ⟨hu,hv⟩
  · rw [hu,hv]; exact hp
  · rw [hu,hv]; exact hp.symm

end Probability
end Carpooling

Carpooling.theorem_1_3.source:
theorem theorem_1_3 (n d a : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hn : d < n)
    (heven : (n*d)%2 = 0) (ha48 : 48 ≤ a)
    (hscale : 6*Nat.log 2 n ≤ a*(d+1)) :
    ∃ (G : FiniteCarpoolGraph) (h : ℕ), StochasticLowerGuarantee n d a h G := by
  classical
  let N := d+1
  let M := n/N-1
  let r := N+n%N
  have hpar := padding_parameters hn heven
  change n = M*N+r ∧ N ≤ r ∧ r < 2*N ∧ (r*d)%2 = 0 at hpar
  rcases hpar with ⟨hsplit,hrlo,hrhi,hreven⟩
  have hN2 : 2 ≤ N := by dsimp [N]; omega
  have hNp : 0 < N := by omega
  have hrp : 0 < r := by omega
  have hdr : d < r := by dsimp [N] at hrlo; omega
  obtain ⟨H,hH⟩ := exists_regular_graph hdr hreven
  let V := (Fin M × Fin N) ⊕ Fin r
  let P : SimpleGraph V := paddedGraph (J := Fin M) (U := Fin N) H
  let G : FiniteCarpoolGraph := ⟨V,inferInstance,inferInstance,P⟩
  let q := Nat.log N M
  let h := cubicHeight a q
  have hap : 0 < a := by omega
  have hhp : 0 < h := cubicHeight_pos a q
  have hcard : Fintype.card V = n := by
    simp only [V,Fintype.card_sum,Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_fin]
    omega
  have hreg : P.IsRegularOfDegree d := by
    apply sum_regular _ H _ hH
    have hg := disjointCliques_regular (J := Fin M) (U := Fin N)
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin,N,Nat.add_sub_cancel] at hg
    convert hg using 1
  have hlogn : Nat.log N n ≤ 16*a*h^3 := by
    have hl := padding_log_compare hN2 (show 0 < n by omega)
      (show n < (M+2)*N by nlinarith)
    have hc := cubicHeight_covers (q := q) hap
    have hh3 : 1 ≤ h^3 := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hhp
    change q < 8*a*h^3 at hc
    change Nat.log N n ≤ q+3 at hl
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨G,h,hcard,hreg,hhp,?_,?_⟩
  · exact cubic_log_rate hd hn hap hhp hlogn
  · intro R
    by_cases he : h = 1
    · rw [he,first_discrepancy_probability (show 0 < Fintype.card G.Vertex by change 0 < Fintype.card V; omega)
        R.run R.initial]
      positivity
    · have hheight : a*h^3 ≤ q := by
        rcases cubicHeight_spec (q := q) hap with hh | hh
        · exact False.elim (he hh)
        · exact hh
      have hM : 0 < M := by
        by_contra hm
        have hzero : M = 0 := by omega
        have hqzero : q = 0 := by simp [q,hzero]
        have hp : 0 < a*h^3 := Nat.mul_pos hap (pow_pos hhp 3)
        omega
      have hMn : M ≤ n := by
        have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left M (show 1 ≤ N by omega)
        simp only [mul_one] at hm
        omega
      have hq2 : q ≤ Nat.log 2 n := by
        have hp : 2^q ≤ n := (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hN2 q).trans
          ((Nat.pow_log_le_self N hM.ne').trans hMn)
        exact Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by decide : 1 < 2) hp
      have hsize : 6*h^3 ≤ N := by
        have hm : a*(6*h^3) ≤ a*N := by dsimp [N]; nlinarith [hheight,hq2,hscale]
        by_contra hs
        have hgt := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (show N < 6*h^3 by omega) hap
        omega
      have hlog : 48*h^3 ≤ q := by
        have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (h^3) ha48
        omega
      letI : Nonempty (Fin M) := ⟨⟨0,hM⟩⟩
      letI : Nonempty (⊤ : SimpleGraph (Fin N)).edgeSet :=
        ⟨⟨s((⟨0,by omega⟩ : Fin N),(⟨1,by omega⟩ : Fin N)),by simp⟩⟩
      have hE : 0 < Fintype.card H.edgeSet := by
        have hb := regular_edge_balance H hH
        simp only [Fintype.card_fin] at hb
        have hp := Nat.mul_pos hrp (show 0 < d by omega)
        omega
      letI : Nonempty H.edgeSet := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp hE
      have hH' : H.IsRegularOfDegree (Fintype.card (Fin N)-1) := by
        simpa only [Fintype.card_fin,N,Nat.add_sub_cancel] using hH
      have hp := padded_graph_lower_logarithmic (J := Fin M) (U := Fin N) H hH' hhp
        (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using hsize)
        (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin] using le_of_lt hrhi)
        (by simpa only [Fintype.card_fin,q] using hlog)
        R.run R.initial R.request R.causal
      simpa only [Fintype.card_fin,N] using hp

end Carpooling

Carpooling.uniformProb_equiv_preimage.source:
lemma uniformProb_equiv_preimage (e : Ω ≃ Γ) (A : Finset Γ) :
    uniformProb (univ.filter fun x => e x ∈ A) = uniformProb A := by
  have he : (univ.filter fun x => e x ∈ A).map e.toEmbedding = A := by
    ext y
    simp
  have hc := congrArg Finset.card he
  rw [card_map] at hc
  simp only [uniformProb,hc,Fintype.card_congr e]

Carpooling.uniformProb_nonneg.source:
lemma uniformProb_nonneg (A : Finset Ω) : 0 ≤ uniformProb A := by
  unfold uniformProb
  positivity

Carpooling.uniformProb_le_one.source:
lemma uniformProb_le_one (A : Finset Ω) : uniformProb A ≤ 1 := by
  unfold uniformProb
  apply (div_le_one (by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card Ω)).mpr
  exact_mod_cast card_le_univ A

Carpooling.uniformMean_prod.source:
lemma uniformMean_prod (f : Ω → Γ → ℝ) :
    uniformMean (fun x : Ω × Γ => f x.1 x.2) =
      uniformMean (fun x : Ω => uniformMean (f x)) := by
  simp only [uniformMean,Fintype.sum_prod_type,Fintype.card_prod,Nat.cast_mul]
  rw [←sum_div,div_div,mul_comm (Fintype.card Γ:ℝ) (Fintype.card Ω:ℝ)]

Carpooling.eventFiber.source:
noncomputable def eventFiber (A : Finset (Ω × Γ)) (x : Ω) : Finset Γ :=
  univ.filter fun y => (x,y) ∈ A

Carpooling.uniformProb_prod_fibers.source:
lemma uniformProb_prod_fibers (A : Finset (Ω × Γ)) :
    uniformProb A = uniformMean (fun x => uniformProb (eventFiber A x)) := by
  rw [←uniformMean_indicator]
  change uniformMean (fun x : Ω × Γ => eventIndicator A (x.1,x.2)) = _
  rw [uniformMean_prod (fun x y => eventIndicator A (x,y))]
  congr 1
  funext x
  have he : (fun y => eventIndicator A (x,y)) = eventIndicator (eventFiber A x) := by
    funext y
    simp [eventIndicator,eventFiber]
  rw [he,uniformMean_indicator]

/-- Average a conditional estimate over a finite product sample space. -/

Carpooling.uniformProb_mixture_bound.source:
theorem uniformProb_mixture_bound (A : Finset (Ω × Γ)) (B : Finset Ω) {a : ℝ}
    (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hgood : ∀ x, x ∉ B → uniformProb (eventFiber A x) ≤ a) :
    uniformProb A ≤ uniformProb B+a := by
  rw [uniformProb_prod_fibers]
  have hpoint : ∀ x, uniformProb (eventFiber A x) ≤ eventIndicator B x+a := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ B
    · simp only [eventIndicator,if_pos hx]
      exact (uniformProb_le_one _).trans (by linarith)
    · simpa [eventIndicator,hx] using hgood x hx
  have hb := uniformMean_mono hpoint
  simpa only [uniformMean_add,uniformMean_indicator,uniformMean_const] using hb

end Carpooling

Carpooling.uniformProb.source:
noncomputable def uniformProb {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] (A : Finset Ω) : ℝ :=
  (A.card : ℝ) / Fintype.card Ω

Carpooling.uniformProb_mono.source:
lemma uniformProb_mono {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] {A B : Finset Ω} (h : A ⊆ B) :
    uniformProb A ≤ uniformProb B := by
  unfold uniformProb
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast card_le_card h) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

Carpooling.uniformProb_biUnion_le.source:
lemma uniformProb_biUnion_le {Ω W : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω]
    (S : Finset W) (A : W → Finset Ω) :
    uniformProb (S.biUnion A) ≤ ∑ w ∈ S, uniformProb (A w) := by
  unfold uniformProb
  rw [← sum_div]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  exact_mod_cast card_biUnion_le

section Samples
variable {E : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]

Carpooling.fixedEvent.source:
noncomputable def fixedEvent {T : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin T)) (b : Fin T → E) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  univ.filter fun x => ∀ i ∈ I, x i = b i

Carpooling.fixedEvent_card.source:
lemma fixedEvent_card {T : ℕ} (I : Finset (Fin T)) (b : Fin T → E) :
    (fixedEvent I b).card = Fintype.card E ^ (T-I.card) := by
  let equiv : {x : Fin T → E // ∀ i ∈ I, x i = b i} ≃ ({i : Fin T // i ∉ I} → E) := {
    toFun := fun x i => x.val i.val
    invFun := fun g => ⟨fun i => if h : i ∈ I then b i else g ⟨i,h⟩,
      by intro i hi; simp [hi]⟩
    left_inv := by
      intro x
      apply Subtype.ext
      funext i
      by_cases hi : i ∈ I
      · simp [hi, x.property i hi]
      · simp [hi]
    right_inv := by intro g; funext i; simp [i.property] }
  have h := Fintype.card_congr equiv
  rw [Fintype.card_fun] at h
  have hdom : Fintype.card {i : Fin T // i ∉ I} = T-I.card := by
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl]
    simp
  rw [hdom] at h
  simpa [fixedEvent, Fintype.card_subtype] using h

Carpooling.prescribedEvent.source:
noncomputable def prescribedEvent {T r : ℕ} (f : Fin r ↪ Fin T) (b : Fin r → E) :
    Finset (Fin T → E) := univ.filter fun x => ∀ j, x (f j) = b j

Carpooling.prescribedEvent_card.source:
lemma prescribedEvent_card {T r : ℕ} (f : Fin r ↪ Fin T) (b : Fin r → E) :
    (prescribedEvent f b).card = Fintype.card E ^ (T-r) := by
  let I : Finset (Fin T) := univ.image f
  let ext : Fin T → E := fun i => if h : ∃ j, f j = i then b h.choose else Classical.choice ‹Nonempty E›
  have hext : ∀ j, ext (f j) = b j := by
    intro j
    have h : ∃ k, f k = f j := ⟨j,rfl⟩
    simp only [ext, dif_pos h]
    exact congrArg b (f.injective h.choose_spec)
  have heq : prescribedEvent f b = fixedEvent I ext := by
    ext x
    simp only [prescribedEvent, fixedEvent, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · intro hx i hi
      obtain ⟨j, _, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hi
      rw [hext, hx]
    · intro hx j
      rw [← hext]
      exact hx (f j) (mem_image.mpr ⟨j,mem_univ _,rfl⟩)
  rw [heq, fixedEvent_card]
  have hI : I.card = r := by simp [I, card_image_of_injective _ f.injective]
  rw [hI]

Carpooling.prescribedEvent_probability.source:
lemma prescribedEvent_probability {T r : ℕ} (f : Fin r ↪ Fin T) (b : Fin r → E) :
    uniformProb (prescribedEvent f b) = (1 / (Fintype.card E : ℝ))^r := by
  have hM : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card E := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hr : r ≤ T := by simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f f.injective
  unfold uniformProb
  rw [prescribedEvent_card]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_pow, one_div_pow]
  have hT : (Fintype.card E : ℝ)^T = (Fintype.card E : ℝ)^(T-r) * (Fintype.card E : ℝ)^r := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel hr]
  rw [hT, div_mul_eq_div_div, div_self (pow_ne_zero _ hM.ne')]

/-- A pattern must use distinct sampling times, even if its edge labels repeat. -/

Carpooling.occurrenceEvent.source:
noncomputable def occurrenceEvent {T r : ℕ} (b : Fin r → E) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  univ.biUnion fun f : Fin r ↪ Fin T => prescribedEvent f b

/-- Equation (7): the occurrence bound for any fixed edge multiset/order. -/

Carpooling.occurrence_probability_bound.source:
theorem occurrence_probability_bound {T r : ℕ} (b : Fin r → E) :
    uniformProb (occurrenceEvent (T := T) b) ≤ ((T : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^r := by
  have hu := uniformProb_biUnion_le (univ : Finset (Fin r ↪ Fin T))
    (fun f => prescribedEvent f b)
  simp only [prescribedEvent_probability, sum_const, card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul] at hu
  have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin r ↪ Fin T) ≤ T^r := by
    have h := Fintype.card_le_of_injective (fun f : Fin r ↪ Fin T => (f : Fin r → Fin T))
      (by intro f g h; exact Function.Embedding.ext (congrFun h))
    simpa [Fintype.card_fun] using h
  have hc : (Fintype.card (Fin r ↪ Fin T) : ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ)^r := by exact_mod_cast hcard
  calc
    uniformProb (occurrenceEvent (T := T) b) ≤
        (Fintype.card (Fin r ↪ Fin T) : ℝ) * (1/(Fintype.card E : ℝ))^r := hu
    _ ≤ (T : ℝ)^r * (1/(Fintype.card E : ℝ))^r :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (by positivity)
    _ = ((T : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^r := by rw [← mul_pow]; congr 1; ring

end Samples

section MappedSamples
variable {E A : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E] [DecidableEq A]

Carpooling.mappedOccurrenceEvent.source:
noncomputable def mappedOccurrenceEvent {T r : ℕ} (g : E → A) (b : Fin r → A) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  univ.filter fun x => ∃ f : Fin r ↪ Fin T, ∀ j, g (x (f j)) = b j

Carpooling.mapped_occurrence_probability.source:
theorem mapped_occurrence_probability_bound {T r : ℕ} (g : E → A)
    (hg : Function.Injective g) (b : Fin r → A) :
    uniformProb (mappedOccurrenceEvent (T := T) g b) ≤ ((T : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^r := by
  by_cases hn : (mappedOccurrenceEvent (T := T) g b).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hn
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hx).2
    let c : Fin r → E := fun j => x (f j)
    have heq : mappedOccurrenceEvent (T := T) g b = occurrenceEvent (T := T) c := by
      ext y
      simp only [mappedOccurrenceEvent, mem_filter, mem_univ, true_and,
        occurrenceEvent, mem_biUnion, prescribedEvent]
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
        refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
        intro j; exact hg ((hh j).trans (hf j).symm)
      · rintro ⟨h, hh⟩
        refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
        intro j
        rw [hh j]
        exact hf j
    rw [heq]
    exact occurrence_probability_bound c
  · have he : mappedOccurrenceEvent (T := T) g b = ∅ := not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hn
    rw [he]
    unfold uniformProb
    simp only [card_empty, Nat.cast_zero, zero_div]
    positivity

/-- Multiset containment gives distinct matching sample times, including for repeated labels. -/

Carpooling.embedding_of_bag_le.source:
theorem embedding_of_bag_le {T r : ℕ} (b : Fin r → A) (x : Fin T → A)
    (h : (univ : Finset (Fin r)).val.map b ≤ (univ : Finset (Fin T)).val.map x) :
    ∃ f : Fin r ↪ Fin T, ∀ j, x (f j) = b j := by
  have hcard : ∀ a, Fintype.card {j : Fin r // b j = a} ≤ Fintype.card {i : Fin T // x i = a} := by
    intro a
    have hc := Multiset.le_iff_count.mp h a
    simpa only [Multiset.count_map, ← Finset.filter_val, Fintype.card_subtype, eq_comm] using hc
  let fiber : ∀ a, {j : Fin r // b j = a} ↪ {i : Fin T // x i = a} :=
    fun a => (Function.Embedding.nonempty_of_card_le (hcard a)).some
  let f : Fin r ↪ Fin T := (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv b).symm.toEmbedding.trans
    ((Function.Embedding.sigmaMap (Function.Embedding.refl A) fiber).trans
      (Equiv.sigmaFiberEquiv x).toEmbedding)
  refine ⟨f, ?_⟩
  intro j
  exact (fiber (b j) ⟨j,rfl⟩).property

end MappedSamples

section Evaluation
variable {Q : Type*} [Fintype Q] [DecidableEq Q] [Nonempty Q]

Carpooling.evaluationEvent.source:
noncomputable def evaluationEvent {K : ℕ} (S : Finset Q) (j : Fin K) : Finset (Fin K → Q) :=
  univ.filter fun x => x j ∈ S

Carpooling.evaluationEvent_card.source:
lemma evaluationEvent_card {K : ℕ} (S : Finset Q) (j : Fin K) :
    (evaluationEvent S j).card = S.card * Fintype.card Q^(K-1) := by
  let e : {x : Fin K → Q // x j ∈ S} ≃ S × ({i : Fin K // i ≠ j} → Q) := {
    toFun := fun x => (⟨x.val j,x.property⟩, fun i => x.val i.val)
    invFun := fun p => ⟨fun i => if h : i = j then p.1.val else p.2 ⟨i,h⟩, by simp⟩
    left_inv := by
      intro x
      apply Subtype.ext
      funext i
      by_cases h : i = j <;> simp [h]
    right_inv := by
      rintro ⟨q,g⟩
      apply Prod.ext
      · apply Subtype.ext; simp
      · funext i; simp [i.property] }
  have h := Fintype.card_congr e
  rw [Fintype.card_prod, Fintype.card_fun] at h
  have hdom : Fintype.card {i : Fin K // i ≠ j} = K-1 := by
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl]; simp
  rw [hdom] at h
  simpa [evaluationEvent, Fintype.card_subtype] using h

Carpooling.evaluation_probability.source:
lemma evaluation_probability {K : ℕ} (S : Finset Q) (j : Fin K) :
    uniformProb (evaluationEvent S j) = uniformProb S := by
  have hQ : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card Q := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hK : K-1+1 = K := by have hj := j.isLt; omega
  unfold uniformProb
  rw [evaluationEvent_card]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_pow]
  apply (div_eq_div_iff (pow_ne_zero _ hQ.ne') hQ.ne').mpr
  have hpow : (Fintype.card Q : ℝ)^K = (Fintype.card Q : ℝ)^(K-1) * Fintype.card Q := by
    calc
      _ = (Fintype.card Q : ℝ)^(K-1+1) := congrArg (fun n => (Fintype.card Q : ℝ)^n) hK.symm
      _ = _ := pow_succ _ _
  rw [hpow]
  ring

/-- A union bound over batches; independence between the bad events is unnecessary. -/

Carpooling.batch_failure_bound.source:
theorem batch_failure_bound {K : ℕ} (S : Finset Q) :
    uniformProb ((univ : Finset (Fin K)).biUnion fun j => evaluationEvent S j) ≤
      (K : ℝ) * uniformProb S := by
  have h := uniformProb_biUnion_le (univ : Finset (Fin K)) (fun j => evaluationEvent S j)
  simpa only [evaluation_probability, sum_const, card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] using h

end Evaluation
end Carpooling

Carpooling.evaluation_pair_probability.source:
lemma evaluation_pair_probability {T : ℕ} (S H : Finset A) (s t : Fin T) (hst : s ≠ t) :
    uniformProb (evaluationEvent S s ∩ evaluationEvent H t) = uniformProb S*uniformProb H := by
  let e : {x : Fin T → A // x s ∈ S ∧ x t ∈ H} ≃
      (S × H) × ({i : Fin T // i ∉ ({s,t} : Finset (Fin T))} → A) := {
    toFun := fun x => ((⟨x.val s,x.property.1⟩,⟨x.val t,x.property.2⟩),fun i => x.val i.val)
    invFun := fun p => ⟨fun i => if hs : i = s then p.1.1.val else
      if ht : i = t then p.1.2.val else p.2 ⟨i,by simp [hs,ht]⟩,
      by simp [hst,Ne.symm hst,p.1.1.property,p.1.2.property]⟩
    left_inv := by
      intro x
      apply Subtype.ext
      funext i
      by_cases hs : i = s <;> by_cases ht : i = t <;> simp [hs,ht,hst,Ne.symm hst]
    right_inv := by
      rintro ⟨⟨a,b⟩,z⟩
      apply Prod.ext
      · apply Prod.ext <;> apply Subtype.ext <;> simp [hst,Ne.symm hst]
      · funext i
        have hi := i.property
        simp only [mem_insert,mem_singleton,not_or] at hi
        simp [hi.1,hi.2] }
  have hd : Fintype.card {i : Fin T // i ∉ ({s,t} : Finset (Fin T))} = T-2 := by
    rw [Fintype.card_subtype_compl]
    simp only [Fintype.card_fin,Fintype.card_subtype]
    have he : (univ.filter fun i : Fin T => i ∈ ({s,t} : Finset (Fin T))) = {s,t} := by
      ext i; simp
    rw [he]
    simp [hst,Ne.symm hst]
  have hc : (evaluationEvent S s ∩ evaluationEvent H t).card =
      S.card*H.card*Fintype.card A^(T-2) := by
    have hc := Fintype.card_congr e
    rw [Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_fun,hd] at hc
    simpa [evaluationEvent,←filter_and,Fintype.card_subtype] using hc
  have hT : 2 ≤ T := by
    have hi := s.isLt
    have hj := t.isLt
    have hne : s.val ≠ t.val := fun he => hst (Fin.ext he)
    omega
  have hA : (Fintype.card A:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hp : (Fintype.card A:ℝ)^T = (Fintype.card A:ℝ)^(T-2)*(Fintype.card A:ℝ)^2 := by
    rw [←pow_add,Nat.sub_add_cancel hT]
  unfold uniformProb
  rw [hc]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fun,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_pow]
  rw [hp]
  field_simp

end Carpooling

Carpooling.sum_regular.source:
theorem sum_regular (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W)
    {d : ℕ} (hG : G.IsRegularOfDegree d) (hH : H.IsRegularOfDegree d) :
    (G ⊕g H).IsRegularOfDegree d := by
  intro x
  cases x with
  | inl v =>
    let e : (G ⊕g H).neighborSet (Sum.inl v) ≃ G.neighborSet v := {
      toFun := fun w => match w with
        | ⟨Sum.inl u,h⟩ => ⟨u,h⟩
        | ⟨Sum.inr _,h⟩ => False.elim (by simpa using h)
      invFun := fun u => ⟨Sum.inl u.val,u.property⟩
      left_inv := by
        rintro ⟨u,hu⟩
        cases u with
        | inl u => rfl
        | inr u => exact False.elim (by simpa using hu)
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
    rw [←SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree,←hG v,←SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree]
    exact Fintype.card_congr e
  | inr w =>
    let e : (G ⊕g H).neighborSet (Sum.inr w) ≃ H.neighborSet w := {
      toFun := fun v => match v with
        | ⟨Sum.inl _,h⟩ => False.elim (by simpa using h)
        | ⟨Sum.inr u,h⟩ => ⟨u,h⟩
      invFun := fun u => ⟨Sum.inr u.val,u.property⟩
      left_inv := by
        rintro ⟨u,hu⟩
        cases u with
        | inl u => exact False.elim (by simpa using hu)
        | inr u => rfl
      right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
    rw [←SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree,←hH w,←SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree]
    exact Fintype.card_congr e

Carpooling.sumEdgeMap.source:
noncomputable def sumEdgeMap (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    G.edgeSet ⊕ H.edgeSet → (G ⊕g H).edgeSet
  | Sum.inl e => ⟨e.val.map Sum.inl,by
      obtain ⟨⟨u,v⟩,he⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective e.val
      have hmem := e.property
      rw [←he,SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] at hmem
      rw [←he,Sym2.map_pair_eq,SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet]
      exact hmem⟩
  | Sum.inr e => ⟨e.val.map Sum.inr,by
      obtain ⟨⟨u,v⟩,he⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective e.val
      have hmem := e.property
      rw [←he,SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] at hmem
      rw [←he,Sym2.map_pair_eq,SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet]
      exact hmem⟩

Carpooling.sumEdgeMap_injective.source:
lemma sumEdgeMap_injective (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    Function.Injective (sumEdgeMap G H) := by
  intro a b hab
  have he := congrArg Subtype.val hab
  cases a with
  | inl a =>
    obtain ⟨⟨u,v⟩,ha⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective a.val
    cases b with
    | inl b =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w,z⟩,hb⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective b.val
      change a.val.map Sum.inl = b.val.map Sum.inl at he
      rw [←ha,←hb,Sym2.map_pair_eq,Sym2.map_pair_eq] at he
      apply congrArg Sum.inl
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [←ha,←hb]
      simpa only [Sym2.eq_iff,Sum.inl.injEq] using he
    | inr b =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w,z⟩,hb⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective b.val
      change a.val.map Sum.inl = b.val.map Sum.inr at he
      simpa [←ha,←hb,Sym2.map_pair_eq,Sym2.eq_iff] using he
  | inr a =>
    obtain ⟨⟨u,v⟩,ha⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective a.val
    cases b with
    | inl b =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w,z⟩,hb⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective b.val
      change a.val.map Sum.inr = b.val.map Sum.inl at he
      simpa [←ha,←hb,Sym2.map_pair_eq,Sym2.eq_iff] using he
    | inr b =>
      obtain ⟨⟨w,z⟩,hb⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective b.val
      change a.val.map Sum.inr = b.val.map Sum.inr at he
      rw [←ha,←hb,Sym2.map_pair_eq,Sym2.map_pair_eq] at he
      apply congrArg Sum.inr
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [←ha,←hb]
      simpa only [Sym2.eq_iff,Sum.inr.injEq] using he

Carpooling.sumEdgeMap_surjective.source:
lemma sumEdgeMap_surjective (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    Function.Surjective (sumEdgeMap G H) := by
  intro e
  obtain ⟨⟨u,v⟩,he⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective e.val
  have hm := e.property
  rw [←he,SimpleGraph.mem_edgeSet] at hm
  cases u with
  | inl u =>
    cases v with
    | inl v =>
      refine ⟨Sum.inl ⟨s(u,v),hm⟩,?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext; exact he
    | inr v => exact False.elim (by simpa using hm)
  | inr u =>
    cases v with
    | inl v => exact False.elim (by simpa using hm)
    | inr v =>
      refine ⟨Sum.inr ⟨s(u,v),hm⟩,?_⟩
      apply Subtype.ext; exact he

Carpooling.sumEdgeEquiv.source:
