noncomputable def sumEdgeEquiv (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    G.edgeSet ⊕ H.edgeSet ≃ (G ⊕g H).edgeSet :=
  Equiv.ofBijective (sumEdgeMap G H) ⟨sumEdgeMap_injective G H,sumEdgeMap_surjective G H⟩

end Carpooling

Carpooling.extendSamplePrefix.source:
noncomputable def extendSamplePrefix {T : ℕ} (t : Fin T)
    (past : Fin t.val → E) : Fin T → E :=
  fun s => if hs : s.val < t.val then past ⟨s.val,hs⟩ else Classical.choice ‹Nonempty E›

Carpooling.integerDiscrepancyEvent.source:
noncomputable def integerDiscrepancyEvent {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    {T : ℕ} (R : (Fin T → E) → IntegerRun V T) (h : ℕ) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  by
    classical
    exact univ.filter fun x => ∃ t ≤ T, ∃ v, (h:ℤ) ≤ |(R x).d t v|

/-- Local lower bound with explicit constants. The edge alphabet can be any
uniform finite encoding of all unordered pairs of 2h+2 vertices. The online
rule is arbitrary, subject only to unit-weight updates and prefix causality.
In particular its orientation is not required to be Greedy. -/

Carpooling.complete_graph_local_lower_pr.source:
theorem complete_graph_local_lower_probability (h : ℕ)
    (g : E → Sym2 (Fin (2*h+2)))
    (encode : (u v : Fin (2*h+2)) → u ≠ v → E)
    (hencode : ∀ u v huv, g (encode u v huv) = s(u,v))
    (T : ℕ) (hT : ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(T:ℤ))
    (R : (Fin T → E) → IntegerRun (Fin (2*h+2)) T)
    (hi : ∀ x v, (R x).d 0 v = 0)
    (hrequest : ∀ x t (ht : t < T),
      s(((R x).step t ht).u,((R x).step t ht).v) = g (x ⟨t,ht⟩))
    (hcausal : ∀ (t : Fin T) (x y : Fin T → E),
      (∀ s : Fin t.val, x ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (R x).d t.val = (R y).d t.val) :
    1/(Fintype.card E:ℝ)^T ≤ uniformProb (integerDiscrepancyEvent R h) := by
  classical
  let P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E := fun t z =>
    let pos := (R (extendSamplePrefix t z)).d t.val
    encode (lowerPair h pos).1 (lowerPair h pos).2 (lowerPair_distinct h pos)
  rw [←adaptive_matching_probability P]
  apply uniformProb_mono
  intro x hx
  have hm := (mem_filter.mp hx).2
  simp only [integerDiscrepancyEvent,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and]
  apply equal_endpoint_lower_bound (R x) (hi x) _ (by simpa using hT)
  intro t ht hb
  let ti : Fin T := ⟨t,ht⟩
  let z : Fin ti.val → E := fun s => x ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt ti.isLt⟩
  have hstate : (R (extendSamplePrefix ti z)).d t = (R x).d t := by
    apply hcausal ti
    intro s
    simp [extendSamplePrefix,z,s.isLt]
  have heq : g (x ti) =
      s((lowerPair h ((R x).d t)).1,(lowerPair h ((R x).d t)).2) := by
    rw [hm ti]
    change g (encode _ _ _) = _
    rw [hencode]
    change s((lowerPair h ((R (extendSamplePrefix ti z)).d t)).1,
      (lowerPair h ((R (extendSamplePrefix ti z)).d t)).2) = _
    rw [hstate]
  have he := (hrequest x t ht).trans heq
  have hlower := lowerPair_equal h ((R x).d t) hb
  rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp he with ⟨hu,hv⟩ | ⟨hu,hv⟩
  · rw [hu,hv]; exact hlower
  · rw [hu,hv]; exact hlower.symm

/-- Uniform edge alphabet of an actual complete simple graph. -/

Carpooling.cliqueEncode.source:
def cliqueEncode (h : ℕ) (u v : Fin (2*h+2)) (huv : u ≠ v) : CliqueEdge h :=
  ⟨s(u,v),by simpa using huv⟩

instance cliqueEdge_nonempty (h : ℕ) : Nonempty (CliqueEdge h) := by
  refine ⟨cliqueEncode h ⟨0,by omega⟩ ⟨1,by omega⟩ ?_⟩
  intro heq
  have he := congrArg Fin.val heq
  simp only [Fin.mk.injEq] at heq
  contradiction

Carpooling.cliqueEdge_card.source:
lemma cliqueEdge_card (h : ℕ) : Fintype.card (CliqueEdge h) = (2*h+2).choose 2 := by
  simpa only [SimpleGraph.edgeFinset_card,Fintype.card_fin] using
    (SimpleGraph.card_edgeFinset_top_eq_card_choose_two (V := Fin (2*h+2)))

/-- The local stochastic lower bound specialized to an actual complete graph:
at least (choose(2h+2,2))^(-T) chance of reaching discrepancy h. -/

Carpooling.clique_local_lower_probabilit.source:
theorem clique_local_lower_probability (h T : ℕ)
    (hT : ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(T:ℤ))
    (R : (Fin T → CliqueEdge h) → IntegerRun (Fin (2*h+2)) T)
    (hi : ∀ x v, (R x).d 0 v = 0)
    (hrequest : ∀ x t (ht : t < T),
      s(((R x).step t ht).u,((R x).step t ht).v) = (x ⟨t,ht⟩).val)
    (hcausal : ∀ (t : Fin T) (x y : Fin T → CliqueEdge h),
      (∀ s : Fin t.val, x ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (R x).d t.val = (R y).d t.val) :
    1/((2*h+2).choose 2:ℝ)^T ≤ uniformProb (integerDiscrepancyEvent R h) := by
  have hp := complete_graph_local_lower_probability h (fun e : CliqueEdge h => e.val)
    (cliqueEncode h) (fun _ _ _ => rfl) T hT R hi hrequest hcausal
  simpa only [cliqueEdge_card] using hp

end Carpooling

Carpooling.Clusters.partsOn.source: noncomputable def Clusters.partsOn (P : Clusters V) (C : Finset V) : Finset (Finset V) := C.image P.block

Carpooling.Clusters.partsOn_merge.source:
lemma Clusters.partsOn_merge (P : Clusters V) (C : Finset V) {u v : V} (hu : u ∈ C) (hv : v ∈ C) :
    (P.merge u v).partsOn C = insert (P.block u ∪ P.block v)
      (((P.partsOn C).erase (P.block u)).erase (P.block v)) := by
  ext S
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨k, hkC, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp h
    by_cases hk : k ∈ P.block u ∪ P.block v
    · exact mem_insert.mpr (Or.inl (by simp only [Clusters.merge, if_pos hk]))
    · apply mem_insert.mpr; right
      have ha : P.block k ≠ P.block u := by
        intro h; exact hk (mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (by rw [← h]; exact P.self_mem k)))
      have hb : P.block k ≠ P.block v := by
        intro h; exact hk (mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (by rw [← h]; exact P.self_mem k)))
      change (if k ∈ P.block u ∪ P.block v then P.block u ∪ P.block v else P.block k) ∈ _
      rw [if_neg hk]
      exact mem_erase.mpr ⟨hb, mem_erase.mpr ⟨ha, mem_image.mpr ⟨k,hkC,rfl⟩⟩⟩
  · intro h
    rcases mem_insert.mp h with h | h
    · subst S
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨u, hu, P.merge_at_u u v⟩
    · obtain ⟨hb, ha, hS⟩ := by simpa [mem_erase] using h
      obtain ⟨k, hkC, hk⟩ := mem_image.mp hS
      have hku : k ∉ P.block u := by intro h; exact ha (hk.symm.trans (P.coherent u k h))
      have hkv : k ∉ P.block v := by intro h; exact hb (hk.symm.trans (P.coherent v k h))
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨k, hkC, by simpa [Clusters.merge, hku, hkv] using hk⟩

Carpooling.Clusters.partsOn_merge_card.source:
lemma Clusters.partsOn_merge_card (P : Clusters V) (C : Finset V) {u v : V}
    (huC : u ∈ C) (hvC : v ∈ C) (h : P.block u ≠ P.block v) :
    ((P.merge u v).partsOn C).card + 1 = (P.partsOn C).card := by
  have hu : P.block u ∈ P.partsOn C := mem_image.mpr ⟨u,huC,rfl⟩
  have hv : P.block v ∈ P.partsOn C := mem_image.mpr ⟨v,hvC,rfl⟩
  have hunion : P.block u ∪ P.block v ∉ P.partsOn C := by
    intro hm
    obtain ⟨k, _, hk⟩ := mem_image.mp hm
    have hmu : u ∈ P.block k := by rw [hk]; simp [P.self_mem]
    have hmv : v ∈ P.block k := by rw [hk]; simp [P.self_mem]
    exact h ((P.coherent k u hmu).trans (P.coherent k v hmv).symm)
  rw [P.partsOn_merge C huC hvC]
  have hnot : P.block u ∪ P.block v ∉ ((P.partsOn C).erase (P.block u)).erase (P.block v) := by
    intro hh; exact hunion (mem_of_mem_erase (mem_of_mem_erase hh))
  rw [card_insert_of_notMem hnot, card_erase_of_mem (by simp [hv, Ne.symm h]), card_erase_of_mem hu]
  have htwo : 2 ≤ (P.partsOn C).card := by
    have hs : ({P.block u, P.block v} : Finset (Finset V)) ⊆ P.partsOn C := by
      intro S hS; rcases mem_insert.mp hS with rfl | hh
      · exact hu
      · have hh := mem_singleton.mp hh; subst S; exact hv
    simpa [h] using card_le_card hs
  omega

Carpooling.Clusters.partsOn_merge_outsid.source:
lemma Clusters.partsOn_merge_outside (P : Clusters V) (C : Finset V) {u v : V}
    (hC : ∀ k ∈ C, P.block k ⊆ C) (hu : u ∉ C) (hv : v ∉ C) :
    (P.merge u v).partsOn C = P.partsOn C := by
  apply image_congr
  intro k hk
  have hku : k ∉ P.block u := fun hh => hu (hC k hk (P.mem_symm hh))
  have hkv : k ∉ P.block v := fun hh => hv (hC k hk (P.mem_symm hh))
  simp [Clusters.merge, hku, hkv]

Carpooling.Run.localSurplus.source:
noncomputable def Run.localSurplus {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (C : Finset V) (t : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((range t).filter (R.LocalInternal C)).card

Carpooling.Run.localSurplus_succ.source:
lemma Run.localSurplus_succ {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (C : Finset V) (t : ℕ) :
    R.localSurplus C (t+1) = R.localSurplus C t + if R.LocalInternal C t then 1 else 0 := by
  simp only [Run.localSurplus, range_add_one, filter_insert]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

Carpooling.internalCount_succ.source:
lemma internalCount_succ {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (C : Finset V) {t : ℕ} (ht : t < T) :
    internalCount R C (t+1) = internalCount R C t + if (R.step t ht).u ∈ C then 1 else 0 := by
  simp only [internalCount, range_add_one, filter_insert]
  by_cases h : (R.step t ht).u ∈ C <;> simp [ht,h]

Carpooling.Run.terminal_block_subset.source:
lemma Run.terminal_block_subset {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (k : V) {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T)
    {j : V} (hj : j ∈ (R.clusters T).block k) :
    (R.clusters t).block j ⊆ (R.clusters T).block k := by
  rw [← (R.clusters T).coherent k j hj]
  exact R.clusters_subset ht j

/-- Local form of the Euler/surplus identity, for a single final component. -/

Carpooling.Run.local_surplus_identity.source:
theorem Run.local_surplus_identity {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (k : V) :
    R.localSurplus ((R.clusters T).block k) T =
      internalCount R ((R.clusters T).block k) T - (((R.clusters T).block k).card - 1) := by
  let C := (R.clusters T).block k
  have hC : R.Closed C := R.terminal_closed k
  have hinv : ∀ t ≤ T, R.localSurplus C t + C.card =
      internalCount R C t + ((R.clusters t).partsOn C).card := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero =>
      intro ht
      simp only [Run.localSurplus, internalCount, range_zero, filter_empty, card_empty, zero_add, Run.clusters]
      simpa only [Clusters.partsOn, Clusters.singletons] using
        (card_image_of_injective C (Finset.singleton_injective)).symm
    | succ t ih =>
      intro ht
      have ih := ih (by omega)
      have htT : t < T := by omega
      let e := R.step t htT
      let P := R.clusters t
      change R.localSurplus C t + C.card = internalCount R C t + (P.partsOn C).card at ih
      have hnext : R.clusters (t+1) = P.merge e.u e.v := by simp [Run.clusters,htT,P,e]
      rw [R.localSurplus_succ, internalCount_succ R C htT, hnext]
      by_cases hu : e.u ∈ C
      · have hv := (hC t htT).mp hu
        by_cases hint : P.block e.u = P.block e.v
        · have hlocal : R.LocalInternal C t := ⟨htT,hint,hu⟩
          rw [if_pos hlocal, if_pos hu, P.merge_same hint]
          omega
        · have hlocal : ¬R.LocalInternal C t := by rintro ⟨h,hh,_⟩; exact hint hh
          rw [if_neg hlocal, if_pos hu]
          have hp := P.partsOn_merge_card C hu hv hint
          rw [← hp] at ih
          dsimp [e,P] at ih ⊢
          omega
      · have hv : e.v ∉ C := fun hv => hu ((hC t htT).mpr hv)
        have hlocal : ¬R.LocalInternal C t := by rintro ⟨h,_,hh⟩; exact hu hh
        rw [if_neg hlocal, if_neg hu, P.partsOn_merge_outside C
          (fun j hj => R.terminal_block_subset k (by omega) hj) hu hv]
        exact ih
  have hfinal : (R.clusters T).partsOn C = {C} := by
    ext S
    constructor
    · intro hS
      obtain ⟨j,hj,rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hS
      exact mem_singleton.mpr ((R.clusters T).coherent k j hj)
    · intro hS
      rw [mem_singleton] at hS
      subst S
      exact mem_image.mpr ⟨k,(R.clusters T).self_mem k,rfl⟩
  have h := hinv T (le_refl T)
  rw [hfinal, card_singleton] at h
  have hpos : 1 ≤ C.card := card_pos.mpr ⟨k,(R.clusters T).self_mem k⟩
  change R.localSurplus C T = internalCount R C T - (C.card-1)
  omega

Carpooling.Run.clusters_mask.source:
lemma Run.clusters_mask {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (C : Finset V) (hC : R.Closed C) (t : ℕ) :
    (R.mask C hC).clusters t = R.clusters t := by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    simp only [Run.clusters]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [ih]; rfl
    · exact ih

Carpooling.Run.internal_mask.source:
lemma Run.internal_mask {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (C : Finset V) (hC : R.Closed C) (t : ℕ) :
    (R.mask C hC).IsInternal t ↔ R.IsInternal t := by
  unfold Run.IsInternal
  rw [R.clusters_mask]
  rfl

Carpooling.Run.locallyShifted.source:
noncomputable def Run.locallyShifted {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (C : Finset V)
    (hC : R.Closed C) : DRun V T where
  d := (R.mask C hC).shift
  charge := fun t => decide (R.LocalInternal C t)
  step := fun t ht => by
    let M := R.mask C hC
    by_cases hu : (R.step t ht).u ∈ C
    · have heq : M.IsInternal t ↔ R.LocalInternal C t := by
        rw [R.internal_mask C hC t]
        unfold Run.IsInternal Run.LocalInternal
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨h,hh⟩; exact ⟨h,hh,hu⟩
        · rintro ⟨h,hh,_⟩; exact ⟨h,hh⟩
      simpa only [decide_eq_decide.mpr heq] using M.shift_step ht
    · apply DStep.drop
      intro k
      have hv : (R.step t ht).v ∉ C := fun hv => hu ((hC t ht).mpr hv)
      have hw : (M.step t ht).weight = 0 := by simp [M, Run.mask, hu]
      have hd : M.d (t+1) k = M.d t k := by
        rw [(M.step t ht).update, hw]
        simp
      have hr : (M.rank t k : ℝ) ≤ M.rank (t+1) k := by exact_mod_cast M.rank_mono t k
      dsimp [Run.shift]
      rw [hd]
      linarith

Carpooling.Run.locallyShifted_count.source:
lemma Run.locallyShifted_count {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (C : Finset V) (hC : R.Closed C) (t : ℕ) :
    (R.locallyShifted C hC).count t = R.localSurplus C t := by
  simp [Run.locallyShifted, DRun.count, Run.localSurplus]

Carpooling.local_positive_tree_bound.source:
theorem local_positive_tree_bound {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (hi : ∀ k, R.d 0 k = 0)
    (C : Finset V) (hC : R.Closed C) {k : V} (hk : k ∈ C) :
    R.d T k ≤ 4*(R.localSurplus C T : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) + 2*(R.rank T k : ℝ) := by
  have hh := (R.locallyShifted C hC).position_bound
    (by intro k; simp [Run.locallyShifted, Run.shift, Run.rank, Run.clusters, Clusters.singletons, Run.mask,hi]) k
  rw [R.locallyShifted_count] at hh
  have hr : (R.mask C hC).rank T k = R.rank T k := by simp [Run.rank,R.clusters_mask]
  change (R.mask C hC).d T k - 2*((R.mask C hC).rank T k : ℝ) ≤ _ at hh
  rw [hr] at hh
  have hd : (R.mask C hC).d T k = R.d T k := by simp [Run.mask,hk]
  rw [hd] at hh
  linarith

Carpooling.Run.closed_neg.source:
lemma Run.closed_neg {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (C : Finset V) (hC : R.Closed C) : R.neg.Closed C := by
  intro t ht
  exact (hC t ht).symm

Carpooling.Run.localSurplus_neg.source:
lemma Run.localSurplus_neg {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (C : Finset V) (hC : R.Closed C) (t : ℕ) :
    R.neg.localSurplus C t = R.localSurplus C t := by
  unfold Run.localSurplus
  congr 1
  apply filter_congr
  intro s hs
  unfold Run.LocalInternal
  rw [R.clusters_neg]
  apply exists_congr
  intro h
  change ((R.clusters s).block (R.step s h).v = (R.clusters s).block (R.step s h).u ∧
      (R.step s h).v ∈ C) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨he,hm⟩; exact ⟨he.symm,(hC s h).mpr hm⟩
  · rintro ⟨he,hm⟩; exact ⟨he.symm,(hC s h).mp hm⟩

/-- The refined deterministic estimate localized to a single final component.
Here p is exactly its number of edges beyond a spanning tree. -/

Carpooling.local_tree_like_bound.source:
theorem local_tree_like_bound {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (hi : ∀ k, R.d 0 k = 0) (k : V) :
    |R.d T k| ≤
      4*((internalCount R ((R.clusters T).block k) T - (((R.clusters T).block k).card-1) : ℕ) : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) +
      2*(Nat.log 2 ((R.clusters T).block k).card : ℝ) := by
  let C := (R.clusters T).block k
  have hC : R.Closed C := R.terminal_closed k
  have hk : k ∈ C := (R.clusters T).self_mem k
  have hp := local_positive_tree_bound R hi C hC hk
  have hn := local_positive_tree_bound R.neg (by intro k; simp [Run.neg,hi]) C (R.closed_neg C hC) hk
  rw [R.localSurplus_neg C hC] at hn
  have hr : R.neg.rank T k = R.rank T k := by simp [Run.rank,R.clusters_neg]
  rw [hr] at hn
  change -R.d T k ≤ _ at hn
  rw [R.local_surplus_identity k] at hp hn
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor <;> dsimp [Run.rank,C] at * <;> linarith

end Carpooling

Carpooling.UnitMove.source:
structure UnitMove (x y : V → ℤ) where
  u : V
  v : V
  distinct : u ≠ v
  update : ∀ k, y k = x k + (if k = u then 1 else 0) - (if k = v then 1 else 0)

Carpooling.integerPotential.source: def integerPotential (x : V → ℤ) : ℤ := ∑ v, x v ^ 2

Carpooling.UnitMove.potential_change.source:
lemma UnitMove.potential_change {x y : V → ℤ} (e : UnitMove x y) :
    integerPotential y = integerPotential x + 2*(x e.u-x e.v) + 2 := by
  have hsq : ∀ k, y k ^ 2 = x k ^ 2 +
      (if k = e.u then 2*x e.u+1 else 0) +
      (if k = e.v then -2*x e.v+1 else 0) := by
    intro k
    rw [e.update]
    by_cases hu : k = e.u <;> by_cases hv : k = e.v
    · exact (e.distinct (hu.symm.trans hv)).elim
    · subst k; simp [hv]; ring
    · subst k; simp [hu]; ring
    · simp [hu,hv]
  unfold integerPotential
  simp_rw [hsq, sum_add_distrib]
  simp
  ring

Carpooling.equal_pair_of_bounded_integer.source:
lemma equal_pair_of_bounded_integer_positions (x : V → ℤ) (h : ℕ)
    (hcard : 2*h+1 < Fintype.card V) (hx : ∀ v, |x v| ≤ (h:ℤ)) :
    ∃ u v, u ≠ v ∧ x u = x v := by
  have hb : ∀ v, -(h:ℤ) ≤ x v ∧ x v ≤ (h:ℤ) := fun v => abs_le.mp (hx v)
  let f : V → Fin (2*h+1) := fun v => ⟨(x v + h).toNat, by
    have hv := hb v
    omega⟩
  obtain ⟨u,v,huv,heq⟩ := Fintype.exists_ne_map_eq_of_card_lt f (by simpa using hcard)
  refine ⟨u,v,huv,?_⟩
  have he := congrArg Fin.val heq
  have hu := hb u
  have hv := hb v
  dsimp [f] at he
  omega

Carpooling.IntegerRun.source:
structure IntegerRun (V : Type*) [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (T : ℕ) where
  d : ℕ → V → ℤ
  step : ∀ t, t < T → UnitMove (d t) (d (t+1))

/-- The pathwise lower-bound engine. When the adversary finds equal endpoints,
either orientation increases the full quadratic potential by exactly two. -/

Carpooling.equal_endpoint_lower_bound.source:
theorem equal_endpoint_lower_bound {T h : ℕ} (R : IntegerRun V T)
    (hi : ∀ v, R.d 0 v = 0)
    (hequal : ∀ t (ht : t < T),
      (∀ v, |R.d t v| < (h:ℤ)) → R.d t (R.step t ht).u = R.d t (R.step t ht).v)
    (horizon : (Fintype.card V:ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(T:ℤ)) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, ∃ v, (h:ℤ) ≤ |R.d t v| := by
  by_contra hn
  have hb : ∀ t, t ≤ T → ∀ v, |R.d t v| < (h:ℤ) := by
    intro t ht v
    by_contra hv
    exact hn ⟨t,ht,v,le_of_not_gt hv⟩
  have hp : ∀ t, t ≤ T → integerPotential (R.d t) = 2*(t:ℤ) := by
    intro t ht
    induction t with
    | zero => simp [integerPotential,hi]
    | succ t ih =>
      have hlt : t < T := by omega
      have he := (R.step t hlt).potential_change
      rw [hequal t hlt (hb t (by omega)), sub_self, mul_zero, add_zero] at he
      rw [he, ih (by omega)]
      push_cast
      ring
  have hsq : ∀ v, R.d T v ^ 2 ≤ (h:ℤ)^2 := by
    intro v
    have hv := le_of_lt (hb T (le_refl T) v)
    have habs := abs_nonneg (R.d T v)
    nlinarith [sq_abs (R.d T v)]
  have hsum := sum_le_sum (s := (univ : Finset V)) (fun v _ => hsq v)
  have hbound : integerPotential (R.d T) ≤ (Fintype.card V:ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 := by
    simpa [integerPotential] using hsum
  rw [hp T (le_refl T)] at hbound
  omega

/-- A causal adversary: choose an equal pair if one exists, otherwise use 0,1. -/

Carpooling.lowerPair_distinct.source:
lemma lowerPair_distinct (h : ℕ) (x : Fin (2*h+2) → ℤ) :
    (lowerPair h x).1 ≠ (lowerPair h x).2 := by
  unfold lowerPair
  split_ifs with he
  · exact he.choose_spec.choose_spec.1
  · simp

Carpooling.lowerPair_equal.source:
lemma lowerPair_equal (h : ℕ) (x : Fin (2*h+2) → ℤ)
    (hx : ∀ v, |x v| < (h:ℤ)) : x (lowerPair h x).1 = x (lowerPair h x).2 := by
  have he : ∃ u v, u ≠ v ∧ x u = x v :=
    equal_pair_of_bounded_integer_positions x h (by simp) (fun v => le_of_lt (hx v))
  simp only [lowerPair,dif_pos he]
  exact he.choose_spec.choose_spec.2

Carpooling.orientUnit.source:
def orientUnit (x : V → ℤ) (a b : V) (flip : Bool) : V → ℤ :=
  let u := if flip then b else a
  let v := if flip then a else b
  fun k => x k + (if k = u then 1 else 0) - (if k = v then 1 else 0)

Carpooling.orientUnit_move.source:
def orientUnit_move (x : V → ℤ) (a b : V) (hab : a ≠ b) (flip : Bool) :
    UnitMove x (orientUnit x a b flip) where
  u := if flip then b else a
  v := if flip then a else b
  distinct := by cases flip <;> simp [hab,Ne.symm hab]
  update := fun _ => rfl

/-- `directions` can be any realized sequence of the algorithm's choices,
including choices made with arbitrary internal randomness and memory. -/

Carpooling.lowerStates.source:
noncomputable def lowerStates (h : ℕ) (directions : ℕ → Bool) : ℕ → Fin (2*h+2) → ℤ
  | 0 => fun _ => 0
  | t+1 => let p := lowerPair h (lowerStates h directions t)
    orientUnit (lowerStates h directions t) p.1 p.2 (directions t)

Carpooling.lowerRun.source:
noncomputable def lowerRun (h : ℕ) (directions : ℕ → Bool) (T : ℕ) :
    IntegerRun (Fin (2*h+2)) T where
  d := lowerStates h directions
  step := fun t _ => orientUnit_move _ _ _ (lowerPair_distinct h _) (directions t)

/-- The adversary uses only previous orientation decisions. -/

Carpooling.lowerStates_prefix_congr.source:
lemma lowerStates_prefix_congr (h : ℕ) (directions directions' : ℕ → Bool) (t : ℕ)
    (heq : ∀ s < t, directions s = directions' s) :
    lowerStates h directions t = lowerStates h directions' t := by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    simp only [lowerStates]
    rw [heq t (Nat.lt_succ_self t), ih (fun s hs => heq s (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hs))]

/-- Explicit deterministic cube-root lower bound: on 2h+2 vertices, an adaptive
unit-weight adversary forces discrepancy at least h within (2h+2)h² requests,
for every sequence of orientation choices. -/

Carpooling.adversarial_cubic_lower_bound.source:
theorem adversarial_cubic_lower_bound (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h) (directions : ℕ → Bool) :
    ∃ t ≤ (2*h+2)*h^2, ∃ v, (h:ℤ) ≤ |lowerStates h directions t v| := by
  let T := (2*h+2)*h^2
  apply equal_endpoint_lower_bound (lowerRun h directions T) (fun _ => rfl)
  · intro t ht hb
    have he := lowerPair_equal h (lowerStates h directions t) hb
    change lowerStates h directions t _ = lowerStates h directions t _
    cases hd : directions t
    · simpa [lowerRun,orientUnit_move,hd] using he
    · simpa [lowerRun,orientUnit_move,hd] using he.symm
  · simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
    dsimp [T]
    push_cast
    have hpos : (0:ℤ) < h := by exact_mod_cast hh
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (h:ℤ)]

Carpooling.adversarial_lower_bound_four_.source:
theorem adversarial_lower_bound_four_cubes (h : ℕ) (hh : 0 < h)
    (directions : ℕ → Bool) :
    ∃ t ≤ 4*h^3, ∃ v, (h:ℤ) ≤ |lowerStates h directions t v| := by
  obtain ⟨t,ht,v,hv⟩ := adversarial_cubic_lower_bound h hh directions
  refine ⟨t,ht.trans ?_,v,hv⟩
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (h^2) (show 2*h+2 ≤ 4*h by omega)
  nlinarith

end Carpooling

Carpooling.theorem_1_3_with_error.source:
theorem theorem_1_3_with_error (n d a k : ℕ) (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hn : d < n)
    (heven : (n*d)%2 = 0) (ha48 : 48 ≤ a) (hscale : 6*Nat.log 2 n ≤ a*(d+1))
    (hk : 0 < k) (hlarge : 2^(2*a*k) ≤ n) :
    ∃ (G : FiniteCarpoolGraph) (h : ℕ), StochasticLowerGuarantee n d a h G ∧
      ∀ R : UnitOnlineRule G.graph (Fintype.card G.Vertex),
        uniformProb (univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R.run h) ≤ 1/(k:ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨G,h,hG⟩ := theorem_1_3 n d a hd hn heven ha48 hscale
  refine ⟨G,h,hG,?_⟩
  intro R
  have hb := hG.2.2.2.2 R
  have hl : 2*a*k ≤ Nat.log 2 n := Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by decide : 1 < 2) hlarge
  have hap : 0 < a := by omega
  have hN : 10*k ≤ d+1 := by
    have hm : a*(10*k) ≤ a*(d+1) := by nlinarith
    by_contra hbad
    have hgt := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (show d+1 < 10*k by omega) hap
    omega
  have hNR : (0:ℝ) < (d+1:ℕ) := by positivity
  have hkR : (0:ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  apply hb.trans
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hNR hkR).mpr
  simp only [one_mul]
  exact_mod_cast hN

/-- The lower bound remains valid after any finite, nonuniform distribution
over independent random seeds. Each seed can choose a different causal rule. -/

Carpooling.randomized_lower_bound.source:
theorem randomized_lower_bound {n d a h : ℕ} {G : FiniteCarpoolGraph}
    (hG : StochasticLowerGuarantee n d a h G)
    {S : Type*} [Fintype S] (w : S → ℝ) (hw : ∀ s, 0 ≤ w s) (hsum : ∑ s, w s = 1)
    (R : S → UnitOnlineRule G.graph (Fintype.card G.Vertex)) :
    (∑ s, w s*uniformProb (univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent (R s).run h)) ≤
      10/((d+1:ℕ):ℝ) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ s, w s*(10/((d+1:ℕ):ℝ)) :=
      sum_le_sum (fun s _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hG.2.2.2.2 (R s)) (hw s))
    _ = _ := by rw [←sum_mul,hsum,one_mul]

end Carpooling

Carpooling.lowerRequestThreshold_le.source:
lemma lowerRequestThreshold_le {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) : lowerRequestThreshold h ≤ 3*h^3 := by
  have h1 : 1 ≤ h^2 := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hh
  unfold lowerRequestThreshold
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (h^2) (show h+1 ≤ 2*h by omega)
  nlinarith

Carpooling.lowerRequestThreshold_horizon.source:
lemma lowerRequestThreshold_horizon (h : ℕ) :
    ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(lowerRequestThreshold h:ℤ) := by
  unfold lowerRequestThreshold
  push_cast
  nlinarith

/-- Finite logarithmic tradeoff: h³ ≤ (log_N M)/12 yields discrepancy h,
provided N ≥ 6h³. The failure probability is at most 10/N. -/

Carpooling.lower_failure_log_bound.source:
lemma lower_failure_log_bound {M N h : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hlog : 12*h^3 ≤ Nat.log N M) :
    8/(N:ℝ)+2*(N.choose 2:ℝ)^(lowerRequestThreshold h)/(M:ℝ) ≤ 10/(N:ℝ) := by
  let L := lowerRequestThreshold h
  let a := N^(2*L)
  have hL : L ≤ 3*h^3 := lowerRequestThreshold_le hh
  have hLp : 0 < L := by dsimp [L,lowerRequestThreshold]; omega
  have hpower : N^(4*L) ≤ M := by
    exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hN (show 4*L ≤ Nat.log N M by omega)).trans
      (Nat.pow_log_le_self N hM.ne')
  have haM : a^2 ≤ M := by simpa [a,←pow_mul,mul_comm,mul_left_comm,mul_assoc] using hpower
  have hq : (N.choose 2)^L ≤ a := by
    have he := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.choose_le_pow N 2) L
    simpa [a,←pow_mul,mul_comm] using he
  have hNa : N ≤ a := by
    calc
      N = N^1 := (pow_one _).symm
      _ ≤ N^(2*L) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hN (by omega)
  have hMR : (0:ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast hM
  have hNR : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have haR : (0:ℝ) < a := by exact_mod_cast pow_pos hN (2*L)
  have hqR : (N.choose 2:ℝ)^L ≤ a := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have haMR : (a:ℝ)^2 ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast haM
  have hNaR : (N:ℝ) ≤ a := by exact_mod_cast hNa
  have hratio : (N.choose 2:ℝ)^L/(M:ℝ) ≤ 1/(a:ℝ) := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hMR haR).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hinv : 1/(a:ℝ) ≤ 1/(N:ℝ) := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hNR hNaR
  calc
    _ = 8/(N:ℝ)+2*((N.choose 2:ℝ)^L/(M:ℝ)) := by ring
    _ ≤ 8/(N:ℝ)+2*(1/(N:ℝ)) := by linarith [hratio.trans hinv]
    _ = _ := by ring

variable {J U : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [Nonempty J]
  [Fintype U] [DecidableEq U] [Nonempty (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet]

/-- Explicit high-probability cube-root stochastic lower bound on a regular
disjoint-clique graph. Degree is N-1, vertices and iid arrivals both MN.
Every integer h with 6h³≤N and 12h³≤floor(log_N M) is attained with
probability at least 1-10/N by every causal orientation algorithm. -/

Carpooling.regular_cliques_lower_logarit.source:
theorem regular_cliques_lower_logarithmic {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hsize : 6*h^3 ≤ Fintype.card U)
    (hlog : 12*h^3 ≤ Nat.log (Fintype.card U) (Fintype.card J))
    (R : (Fin (Fintype.card J*Fintype.card U) →
      (disjointCliques (J := J) (U := U)).edgeSet) →
      IntegerRun (J × U) (Fintype.card J*Fintype.card U))
    (hi : ∀ x v, (R x).d 0 v = 0)
    (hrequest : ∀ x (t : Fin (Fintype.card J*Fintype.card U)),
      s(((R x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((R x).step t.val t.isLt).v) = (x t).val)
    (hcausal : ∀ (t : Fin (Fintype.card J*Fintype.card U)) x y,
      (∀ i : Fin t.val, x ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (R x).d t.val = (R y).d t.val) :
    uniformProb (univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R h) ≤ 10/(Fintype.card U:ℝ) := by
  have hcube : h ≤ h^3 := by simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right hh (by decide : 1 ≤ 3)
  have hsmall : 2*h+2 ≤ Fintype.card U := by omega
  let f : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ U := {
    toFun := fun i => (Fintype.equivFin U).symm ⟨i.val,lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hsmall⟩
    inj' := by
      intro a b he
      have he' := (Fintype.equivFin U).symm.injective he
      exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun v : Fin (Fintype.card U) => v.val) he') }
  have hN : 0 < Fintype.card U := by omega
  have hL := lowerRequestThreshold_le hh
  have hb := regular_cliques_stochastic_lower f (show 2*lowerRequestThreshold h ≤ Fintype.card U by omega)
    (lowerRequestThreshold_horizon h) R hi hrequest hcausal
  exact hb.trans (lower_failure_log_bound Fintype.card_pos hN hh hlog)

end Carpooling

Carpooling.mixedClass.source:
def mixedClass : (J × U) ⊕ W → Option J
  | Sum.inl p => some p.1
  | Sum.inr _ => none

Carpooling.mixedFrame.source:
def mixedFrame : ((J × U) ⊕ W) ↪ (Option J × (U ⊕ W)) where
  toFun
    | Sum.inl p => (some p.1,Sum.inl p.2)
    | Sum.inr w => (none,Sum.inr w)
  inj' := by
    rintro (⟨j,u⟩ | w) (⟨k,v⟩ | z) h <;> simp_all

Carpooling.mixedPairDecoder.source:
def mixedPairDecoder : ((J × U) ⊕ W) × (B × C) → (J × B) ⊕ C
  | (Sum.inl p,e) => Sum.inl (p.1,e.1)
  | (Sum.inr _,e) => Sum.inr e.2

Carpooling.mixedClass_fiber.source:
lemma mixedClass_fiber (j : J) :
    (univ.filter fun a : (J × U) ⊕ W => mixedClass a = some j).card = Fintype.card U := by
  have he : (univ.filter fun a : (J × U) ⊕ W => mixedClass a = some j).card =
      ∑ a : (J × U) ⊕ W, if mixedClass a = some j then 1 else 0 := by simp
  rw [he,Fintype.sum_sum_type]
  simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type,mixedClass]
  simp

Carpooling.mixedPairDecoder_fiber.source:
lemma mixedPairDecoder_fiber (z : (J × B) ⊕ C) :
    (univ.filter fun a : ((J × U) ⊕ W) × (B × C) => mixedPairDecoder a = z).card =
      match z with
      | Sum.inl _ => Fintype.card U*Fintype.card C
      | Sum.inr _ => Fintype.card W*Fintype.card B := by
  have he : (univ.filter fun a : ((J × U) ⊕ W) × (B × C) => mixedPairDecoder a = z).card =
      ∑ a : ((J × U) ⊕ W) × (B × C), if mixedPairDecoder a = z then 1 else 0 := by simp
  rw [he]
  cases z with
  | inl p =>
    rcases p with ⟨j,b⟩
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type,Fintype.sum_sum_type,mixedPairDecoder,Sum.inl.injEq,Sum.inr_ne_inl,ite_false,Prod.mk.injEq]
    simp [ite_and]
  | inr c =>
    simp only [Fintype.sum_prod_type,Fintype.sum_sum_type,mixedPairDecoder,Sum.inr.injEq,Sum.inl_ne_inr,ite_false]
    simp

Carpooling.mixedPairDecoder_constant_fib.source:
lemma mixedPairDecoder_constant_fiber
    (hbalance : Fintype.card U*Fintype.card C = Fintype.card W*Fintype.card B)
    (z : (J × B) ⊕ C) :
    (univ.filter fun a : ((J × U) ⊕ W) × (B × C) => mixedPairDecoder a = z).card =
      Fintype.card U*Fintype.card C := by
  rw [mixedPairDecoder_fiber]
  cases z <;> simp [hbalance]

Carpooling.pairWordEquiv.source:
noncomputable def pairWordEquiv (T : ℕ) {X Y : Type*} :
    ((Fin T → X) × (Fin T → Y)) ≃ (Fin T → X × Y) where
  toFun p t := (p.1 t,p.2 t)
  invFun x := (fun t => (x t).1,fun t => (x t).2)
  left_inv := fun _ => rfl
  right_inv := fun _ => rfl

end Carpooling

Carpooling.indicator_sum_variance.source:
lemma indicator_sum_variance (B : A → Finset Ω) (p : ℝ)
    (hfirst : ∀ a, uniformProb (B a) = p)
    (hsecond : ∀ a b, a ≠ b → uniformProb (B a ∩ B b) = p^2) :
    uniformMean (fun x => (∑ a, (eventIndicator (B a) x-p))^2) =
      (Fintype.card A:ℝ)*p*(1-p) := by
  have hmoment : ∀ a b,
      uniformMean (fun x => (eventIndicator (B a) x-p)*(eventIndicator (B b) x-p)) =
        if a = b then p*(1-p) else 0 := by
    intro a b
    have hexpand : (fun x => (eventIndicator (B a) x-p)*(eventIndicator (B b) x-p)) =
        (fun x => eventIndicator (B a) x*eventIndicator (B b) x -
          p*eventIndicator (B a) x - p*eventIndicator (B b) x + p*p) := by
      funext x; ring
    rw [hexpand]
    simp only [uniformMean_add,uniformMean_sub,uniformMean_const_mul,
      eventIndicator_mul,uniformMean_indicator,uniformMean_const,hfirst]
    by_cases hab : a = b
    · subst b; simp [hfirst] <;> ring
    · rw [if_neg hab,hsecond a b hab]; ring
  have he : (fun x => (∑ a, (eventIndicator (B a) x-p))^2) =
      (fun x => ∑ a, ∑ b, (eventIndicator (B a) x-p)*(eventIndicator (B b) x-p)) := by
    funext x
    simp only [pow_two,sum_mul_sum]
  rw [he,uniformMean_sum]
  simp_rw [uniformMean_sum,hmoment]
  simp [mul_assoc]

section Labels
variable {J : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [Nonempty J]

Carpooling.labelEvent.source:
noncomputable def labelEvent {T : ℕ} (j : J) (t : Fin T) : Finset (Fin T → J) :=
  univ.filter fun x => x t = j

Carpooling.labelEvent_eq_selected.source:
lemma labelEvent_eq_selected {T : ℕ} (j : J) (t : Fin T) :
    labelEvent j t = selectedMatchingEvent {t} (fun _ _ => j) := by
  ext x
  simp [labelEvent,selectedMatchingEvent]

Carpooling.labelEvent_probability.source:
lemma labelEvent_probability {T : ℕ} (j : J) (t : Fin T) :
    uniformProb (labelEvent j t) = 1/(Fintype.card J:ℝ) := by
  rw [labelEvent_eq_selected,selected_matching_probability]
  simp

Carpooling.labelEvent_pair_probability.source:
lemma labelEvent_pair_probability {T : ℕ} (j : J) (s t : Fin T) (hst : s ≠ t) :
    uniformProb (labelEvent j s ∩ labelEvent j t) = (1/(Fintype.card J:ℝ))^2 := by
  rw [labelEvent_eq_selected,labelEvent_eq_selected,←selectedMatchingEvent_union,
    selected_matching_probability]
  simp [hst,Ne.symm hst,div_pow]

Carpooling.occupancy.source:
noncomputable def occupancy {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → J) (j : J) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter fun t => x t = j).card

Carpooling.occupancy_eq_sum.source:
lemma occupancy_eq_sum {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → J) (j : J) :
    (occupancy x j:ℝ) = ∑ t, eventIndicator (labelEvent j t) x := by
  simp [occupancy,eventIndicator,labelEvent]

/-- With M labels and MN iid uniform samples, each label's count has variance
N(1-1/M), in particular at most N. -/

Carpooling.occupancy_variance.source:
theorem occupancy_variance (N : ℕ) (j : J) :
    uniformMean (fun x : Fin (Fintype.card J*N) → J =>
      ((occupancy x j:ℝ)-(N:ℝ))^2) ≤ (N:ℝ) := by
  have hM : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card J := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hcenter : ∀ x : Fin (Fintype.card J*N) → J,
      (occupancy x j:ℝ)-(N:ℝ) =
        ∑ t, (eventIndicator (labelEvent j t) x-1/(Fintype.card J:ℝ)) := by
    intro x
    rw [sum_sub_distrib,←occupancy_eq_sum]
    simp only [sum_const,card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul,Nat.cast_mul]
    field_simp
  simp_rw [hcenter]
  rw [indicator_sum_variance (labelEvent j) _ (labelEvent_probability j)
    (fun s t hst => labelEvent_pair_probability j s t hst)]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_mul]
  have heq : (Fintype.card J:ℝ)*N*(1/(Fintype.card J:ℝ)) = (N:ℝ) := by field_simp
  rw [heq]
  have hnonneg : (0:ℝ) ≤ N := Nat.cast_nonneg _
  have hfrac : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/(Fintype.card J:ℝ) := le_of_lt (one_div_pos.mpr hM)
  nlinarith

Carpooling.underfilledEvent.source:
noncomputable def underfilledEvent (N L : ℕ) (j : J) :
    Finset (Fin (Fintype.card J*N) → J) := univ.filter fun x => occupancy x j < L

/-- A weak Chebyshev bound is sufficient for the paper's high-probability
lower bound: a label receives fewer than L requests with probability ≤4/N. -/

Carpooling.underfilled_probability.source:
theorem underfilled_probability {N L : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hL : 2*L ≤ N) (j : J) :
    uniformProb (underfilledEvent N L j) ≤ 4/(N:ℝ) := by
  have hpoint : ∀ x : Fin (Fintype.card J*N) → J,
      eventIndicator (underfilledEvent N L j) x*(N:ℝ)^2 ≤
        4*((occupancy x j:ℝ)-(N:ℝ))^2 := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : occupancy x j < L
    · have hlow : 2*(occupancy x j:ℝ) ≤ (N:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 2*occupancy x j ≤ N)
      have hcount : (0:ℝ) ≤ occupancy x j := Nat.cast_nonneg _
      simp only [eventIndicator,underfilledEvent,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and,if_pos hx]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((N:ℝ)-2*(occupancy x j:ℝ))]
    · simp [eventIndicator,underfilledEvent,hx,sq_nonneg]
  have hb := uniformMean_mono hpoint
  rw [uniformMean_mul_const,uniformMean_indicator,uniformMean_const_mul] at hb
  have hv := occupancy_variance N j
  have hNR : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  apply (le_div_iff₀ hNR).mpr
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hNR).mp
  nlinarith

Carpooling.goodLabels.source:
noncomputable def goodLabels {T : ℕ} (x : Fin T → J) (L : ℕ) : Finset J :=
  univ.filter fun j => L ≤ occupancy x j

Carpooling.fewGoodLabelsEvent.source:
noncomputable def fewGoodLabelsEvent (N L : ℕ) : Finset (Fin (Fintype.card J*N) → J) :=
  univ.filter fun x => 2*(goodLabels x L).card < Fintype.card J

/-- With probability at least 1-8/N, at least half of all labels receive at
least L requests, provided 2L≤N. No independence across label counts is used. -/

Carpooling.few_good_labels_probability.source:
theorem few_good_labels_probability {N L : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hL : 2*L ≤ N) :
    uniformProb (fewGoodLabelsEvent (J := J) N L) ≤ 8/(N:ℝ) := by
  have hbadcount : ∀ x : Fin (Fintype.card J*N) → J,
      (∑ j, eventIndicator (underfilledEvent N L j) x) =
        (Fintype.card J:ℝ)-(goodLabels x L).card := by
    intro x
    have hcomp : (univ.filter fun j => occupancy x j < L) = univ \ goodLabels x L := by
      ext j
      simp [goodLabels,not_le]
    have hcard : (goodLabels x L).card ≤ Fintype.card J := card_le_univ _
    simp only [eventIndicator,underfilledEvent,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and]
    rw [sum_boole,hcomp,card_sdiff]
    simp [Nat.cast_sub hcard]
  have hpoint : ∀ x : Fin (Fintype.card J*N) → J,
      eventIndicator (fewGoodLabelsEvent N L) x*(Fintype.card J:ℝ) ≤
        2*∑ j, eventIndicator (underfilledEvent N L j) x := by
    intro x
    rw [hbadcount]
    by_cases hx : 2*(goodLabels x L).card < Fintype.card J
    · have hxR : 2*((goodLabels x L).card:ℝ) < (Fintype.card J:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hx
      simp only [eventIndicator,fewGoodLabelsEvent,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and,if_pos hx]
      linarith
    · have hcard : ((goodLabels x L).card:ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card J:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast card_le_univ (goodLabels x L)
      simp only [eventIndicator,fewGoodLabelsEvent,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and,if_neg hx,zero_mul]
      linarith
  have hb := uniformMean_mono hpoint
  rw [uniformMean_mul_const,uniformMean_indicator,uniformMean_const_mul,uniformMean_sum] at hb
  simp only [uniformMean_indicator] at hb
  have hs : (∑ j : J, uniformProb (underfilledEvent N L j)) ≤
      (Fintype.card J:ℝ)*(4/(N:ℝ)) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _j : J, (4/(N:ℝ)) := sum_le_sum (fun j _ => underfilled_probability hN hL j)
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hM : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card J := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hM).mp
  calc
    _ ≤ 2 * ∑ j : J, uniformProb (underfilledEvent N L j)  := by simpa only [mul_comm] using hb
    _ ≤ 2 * ((Fintype.card J:ℝ)*(4/(N:ℝ))) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (by norm_num)
    _ = _ := by ring

end Labels
end Carpooling

Carpooling.UnitOnlineRule.source:
structure UnitOnlineRule (G : SimpleGraph V) (T : ℕ) where
  run : (Fin T → G.edgeSet) → IntegerRun V T
  initial : ∀ x v, (run x).d 0 v = 0
  request : ∀ x (t : Fin T),
    s(((run x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((run x).step t.val t.isLt).v) = (x t).val
  causal : ∀ (t : Fin T) x y,
    (∀ i : Fin t.val, x ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩ = y ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩) →
      (run x).d t.val = (run y).d t.val

Carpooling.IntegerRun.first_discrepancy.source:
lemma IntegerRun.first_discrepancy {T : ℕ} (hT : 0 < T) (R : IntegerRun V T)
    (hi : ∀ v, R.d 0 v = 0) : ∃ t ≤ T, ∃ v, (1:ℤ) ≤ |R.d t v| := by
  let e := R.step 0 hT
  refine ⟨1,hT,e.u,?_⟩
  have he := e.update e.u
  have hu : R.d 1 e.u = 1 := by simpa [hi,e.distinct] using he
  simp [hu]

Carpooling.first_discrepancy_probability.source:
lemma first_discrepancy_probability {E : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E]
    {T : ℕ} (hT : 0 < T) (R : (Fin T → E) → IntegerRun V T)
    (hi : ∀ x v, (R x).d 0 v = 0) :
    uniformProb (univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R 1) = 0 := by
  have he : univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R 1 = ∅ := by
    ext x
    have hx : x ∈ integerDiscrepancyEvent R 1 := by
      simp only [integerDiscrepancyEvent,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and]
      exact (R x).first_discrepancy hT (hi x)
    simp [hx]
  simp [he,uniformProb]

Carpooling.FiniteCarpoolGraph.source:
structure FiniteCarpoolGraph where
  Vertex : Type
  finite : Fintype Vertex
  decideEq : DecidableEq Vertex
  graph : SimpleGraph Vertex

instance (G : FiniteCarpoolGraph) : Fintype G.Vertex := G.finite
instance (G : FiniteCarpoolGraph) : DecidableEq G.Vertex := G.decideEq

Carpooling.cubic_log_rate.source:
lemma cubic_log_rate {n d a h : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) (hn : d < n) (ha : 0 < a) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hcert : Nat.log (d+1) n ≤ 16*a*h^3) :
    (Real.log (n:ℝ)/Real.log (d:ℝ))^((1:ℝ)/3) ≤ (64*(a:ℝ))^((1:ℝ)/3)*(h:ℝ) := by
  have hnp : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 0 < n)
  have hdp : (1:ℝ) < d := by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < d)
  have hlogd : 0 < Real.log (d:ℝ) := Real.log_pos hdp
  have hN : (0:ℝ) < (d+1:ℕ) := by positivity
  have hpow := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (show 1 < d+1 by omega) n
  have hpowR : (n:ℝ) ≤ ((d+1:ℕ):ℝ)^(Nat.log (d+1) n+1) := by exact_mod_cast le_of_lt hpow
  have hl := Real.log_le_log hnp hpowR
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hl
  have hpowh : 1 ≤ h^3 := Nat.one_le_pow _ _ hh
  have hq : Nat.log (d+1) n+1 ≤ 17*a*h^3 := by nlinarith
  have hqR : ((Nat.log (d+1) n+1:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ 17*(a:ℝ)*(h:ℝ)^3 := by exact_mod_cast hq
  have hlogN : 0 ≤ Real.log ((d+1:ℕ):ℝ) := Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ d+1))
  have hNd : ((d+1:ℕ):ℝ) ≤ (d:ℝ)^2 := by exact_mod_cast (by nlinarith : d+1 ≤ d^2)
  have hld := Real.log_le_log hN hNd
  rw [Real.log_pow] at hld
  have hc : Real.log (n:ℝ) ≤ 64*(a:ℝ)*(h:ℝ)^3*Real.log (d:ℝ) := by
    have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hqR hlogN
    have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hld (show 0 ≤ 17*(a:ℝ)*(h:ℝ)^3 by positivity)
    calc
      _ ≤ 17*(a:ℝ)*(h:ℝ)^3*Real.log ((d+1:ℕ):ℝ) := hl.trans h1
      _ ≤ 17*(a:ℝ)*(h:ℝ)^3*(2*Real.log (d:ℝ)) := by simpa only [Nat.cast_ofNat] using h2
      _ = 34*(a:ℝ)*(h:ℝ)^3*Real.log (d:ℝ) := by ring
      _ ≤ _ := by nlinarith [show 0 ≤ (a:ℝ)*(h:ℝ)^3*Real.log (d:ℝ) by positivity]
  have hr : Real.log (n:ℝ)/Real.log (d:ℝ) ≤ 64*(a:ℝ)*(h:ℝ)^3 :=
    (div_le_iff₀ hlogd).mpr hc
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ Real.log (n:ℝ)/Real.log (d:ℝ) := by
    apply div_nonneg
    · exact Real.log_nonneg (by exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 ≤ n))
    · exact le_of_lt hlogd
  have hp := Real.rpow_le_rpow hnonneg hr (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/3)
  have he : (64*(a:ℝ)*(h:ℝ)^3)^((1:ℝ)/3) = (64*(a:ℝ))^((1:ℝ)/3)*(h:ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.mul_rpow (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    congr 1
    simpa only [one_div] using Real.pow_rpow_inv_natCast (Nat.cast_nonneg h) (by decide : (3:ℕ) ≠ 0)
  exact hp.trans_eq he

Carpooling.StochasticLowerGuarantee.source:
def StochasticLowerGuarantee (n d a h : ℕ) (G : FiniteCarpoolGraph) : Prop :=
  Fintype.card G.Vertex = n ∧ G.graph.IsRegularOfDegree d ∧ 0 < h ∧
    (Real.log (n:ℝ)/Real.log (d:ℝ))^((1:ℝ)/3) ≤ (64*(a:ℝ))^((1:ℝ)/3)*(h:ℝ) ∧
    ∀ R : UnitOnlineRule G.graph (Fintype.card G.Vertex),
      uniformProb (univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R.run h) ≤ 10/((d+1:ℕ):ℝ)

end Carpooling

Carpooling.paddedGraph.source: abbrev paddedGraph (H : SimpleGraph W) := (disjointCliques (J := J) (U := U)) ⊕g H

Carpooling.paddedEdgeEquiv.source:
noncomputable def paddedEdgeEquiv (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    ((J × (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet) ⊕ H.edgeSet) ≃ (paddedGraph (J := J) (U := U) H).edgeSet :=
  (Equiv.sumCongr disjointCliqueEdgeEquiv (Equiv.refl _)).trans (sumEdgeEquiv _ H)

Carpooling.paddedDecoder.source:
noncomputable def paddedDecoder (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    (((J × U) ⊕ W) × ((⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet × H.edgeSet)) →
      (paddedGraph (J := J) (U := U) H).edgeSet :=
  fun a => paddedEdgeEquiv H (mixedPairDecoder a)

Carpooling.paddedLocalEdge.source:
noncomputable def paddedLocalEdge (H : SimpleGraph W) :
    ((J × U) ⊕ W) → ((⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet × H.edgeSet) → Sym2 (U ⊕ W)
  | Sum.inl _,e => e.1.val.map Sum.inl
  | Sum.inr _,e => e.2.val.map Sum.inr

Carpooling.paddedDecoder_frame.source:
lemma paddedDecoder_frame (H : SimpleGraph W) (a : (J × U) ⊕ W)
    (e : (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet × H.edgeSet) :
    (paddedDecoder H (a,e)).val.map mixedFrame =
      (paddedLocalEdge H a e).map (fun u => (mixedClass a,u)) := by
  cases a with
  | inl p =>
    rcases p with ⟨j,u⟩
    change ((e.1.val.map (fun u => (j,u))).map Sum.inl).map mixedFrame = _
    simp only [Sym2.map_map,paddedLocalEdge,mixedClass]
    rfl
  | inr w =>
    change (e.2.val.map Sum.inr).map mixedFrame = _
    simp only [Sym2.map_map,paddedLocalEdge,mixedClass]
    rfl

Carpooling.paddedDecoder_constant_fiber.source:
lemma paddedDecoder_constant_fiber (H : SimpleGraph W) [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    (hH : H.IsRegularOfDegree (Fintype.card U-1))
    (e : (paddedGraph (J := J) (U := U) H).edgeSet) :
    (univ.filter fun a => paddedDecoder H a = e).card = Fintype.card U*Fintype.card H.edgeSet := by
  have hbal : Fintype.card U*Fintype.card H.edgeSet =
      Fintype.card W*Fintype.card (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet := by
    have h1 := regular_edge_balance H hH
    have h2 := regular_edge_balance (⊤ : SimpleGraph U) SimpleGraph.IsRegularOfDegree.top
    nlinarith [congrArg (Nat.mul (Fintype.card U)) h1,congrArg (Nat.mul (Fintype.card W)) h2]
  have hp : (fun a => paddedDecoder H a = e) =
      (fun a => mixedPairDecoder a = (paddedEdgeEquiv H).symm e) := by
    funext a
    apply propext
    constructor
    · intro ha
      have he := congrArg (paddedEdgeEquiv H).symm ha
      simpa only [paddedDecoder,Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using he
    · intro ha
      change paddedEdgeEquiv H (mixedPairDecoder a) = e
      rw [ha,Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  have hset : (univ.filter fun a => paddedDecoder H a = e) =
      (univ.filter fun a => mixedPairDecoder a = (paddedEdgeEquiv H).symm e) := by
    ext a
    simp only [mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and]
    exact Iff.of_eq (congrFun hp a)
  rw [hset]
  exact mixedPairDecoder_constant_fiber hbal _

variable [Nonempty J] [Nonempty (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet]

/-- Padding by any regular remainder preserves the stochastic lower bound.
The finite probability cost is intentionally loose: prescriptions include
an unused residual-edge coordinate. This keeps the sampler exactly uniform. -/

Carpooling.padded_graph_stochastic_lower.source:
theorem padded_graph_stochastic_lower (H : SimpleGraph W) [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    [Nonempty H.edgeSet] (hH : H.IsRegularOfDegree (Fintype.card U-1))
    {L h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (f : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ U)
    (hNL : 2*L ≤ Fintype.card U)
    (hL : ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(L:ℤ))
    (R : (Fin (Fintype.card ((J × U) ⊕ W)) → (paddedGraph (J := J) (U := U) H).edgeSet) →
      IntegerRun ((J × U) ⊕ W) (Fintype.card ((J × U) ⊕ W)))
    (hi : ∀ x v, (R x).d 0 v = 0)
    (hrequest : ∀ x (t : Fin (Fintype.card ((J × U) ⊕ W))),
      s(((R x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((R x).step t.val t.isLt).v) = (x t).val)
    (hcausal : ∀ (t : Fin (Fintype.card ((J × U) ⊕ W))) x y,
      (∀ i : Fin t.val, x ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (R x).d t.val = (R y).d t.val) :
    uniformProb (univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R h) ≤
      8/(Fintype.card U:ℝ)+2*(Fintype.card (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet*
        Fintype.card H.edgeSet:ℝ)^L/(Fintype.card J:ℝ) := by
  classical
  let A := (J × U) ⊕ W
  let E := (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet × H.edgeSet
  let T := Fintype.card A
  let words : (Fin T → A) → (Fin T → E) → Fin T → (paddedGraph H).edgeSet :=
    fun s x t => paddedDecoder H (s t,x t)
  let Q := fun s x => (R (words s x)).pushforward (mixedFrame (J := J) (U := U) (W := W))
  letI : Nonempty U := ⟨f ⟨0,by omega⟩⟩
  letI : Nonempty A := ⟨Sum.inl (Classical.choice ‹Nonempty J›,Classical.choice ‹Nonempty U›)⟩
  letI : Nonempty (paddedGraph (J := J) (U := U) H).edgeSet :=
    ⟨paddedDecoder H (Classical.choice ‹Nonempty A›,(Classical.choice ‹Nonempty (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet›,Classical.choice ‹Nonempty H.edgeSet›))⟩
  let f' : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ U ⊕ W := ⟨fun i => Sum.inl (f i),fun _ _ h => f.injective (Sum.inl.inj h)⟩
  let encode : Option J → (a b : Fin (2*h+2)) → a ≠ b → E :=
    fun _ a b hab => (⟨s(f a,f b),by simpa using f.injective.ne hab⟩,Classical.choice ‹Nonempty H.edgeSet›)
  have henc : ∀ (s : Fin T → A) (t : Fin T) j a b hab, mixedClass (s t) = some j →
      paddedLocalEdge H (s t) (encode (some j) a b hab) = s(f' a,f' b) := by
    intro s t j a b hab ht
    cases he : s t with
    | inl p => rfl
    | inr w => simp [he,mixedClass] at ht
  have hreq : ∀ s x (t : Fin T),
      s(((Q s x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((Q s x).step t.val t.isLt).v) =
        (paddedLocalEdge H (s t) (x t)).map (fun u => (mixedClass (s t),u)) := by
    intro s x t
    change s(mixedFrame _,mixedFrame _) = _
    rw [←Sym2.map_pair_eq,hrequest]
    exact paddedDecoder_frame H (s t) (x t)
  have hcaus : ∀ s (t : Fin T) x y,
      (∀ i : Fin t.val, x ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (Q s x).d t.val = (Q s y).d t.val := by
    intro s t x y hxy
    apply congrArg (extendPosition mixedFrame)
    apply hcausal t
    intro i
    change paddedDecoder H (s _,x _) = paddedDecoder H (s _,y _)
    rw [hxy i]
  have hp := weighted_cliques_lower_probability (J := J) (U := U ⊕ W)
    (show 0 < Fintype.card U from Fintype.card_pos) hNL mixedClass
    (fun j => mixedClass_fiber j) f' (fun s t => paddedLocalEdge H (s t)) encode henc hL Q
    (fun s x => (R (words s x)).pushforward_initial mixedFrame (hi (words s x))) hreq hcaus
  let fail := univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R h
  have hsplit : splitFailure Q h = univ.filter (fun p => words p.1 p.2 ∈ fail) := by
    ext p
    simp only [splitFailure,fail,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and,mem_sdiff]
    simp only [integerDiscrepancyEvent,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and]
    simpa only [Q,T] using not_congr (pushforward_discrepancy_iff hh (R (words p.1 p.2)) mixedFrame)
  have hprob : uniformProb (splitFailure Q h) = uniformProb fail := by
    rw [hsplit]
    let D := fun x : Fin T → A × E => fun t => paddedDecoder H (x t)
    have hpre : (univ.filter fun p => words p.1 p.2 ∈ fail) =
        univ.filter (fun p => (pairWordEquiv T p |> D) ∈ fail) := rfl
    rw [hpre]
    calc
      _ = uniformProb (univ.filter fun x => D x ∈ fail) := by
        simpa only [mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and] using
          (uniformProb_equiv_preimage (pairWordEquiv T) (univ.filter fun x => D x ∈ fail))
      _ = uniformProb fail := by
        convert uniformProb_constant_fiber D
          (pow_pos (Nat.mul_pos (Fintype.card_pos (α := U)) (Fintype.card_pos (α := H.edgeSet))) T)
          (word_fiber_card (paddedDecoder H) (paddedDecoder_constant_fiber H hH)) fail using 1
        congr 1
        ext x
        simp only [mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and]
  rw [hprob] at hp
  simpa only [Fintype.card_prod,Nat.cast_mul] using hp

end Carpooling

Carpooling.padded_failure_log_bound.source:
lemma padded_failure_log_bound {M N P h : ℕ} (hM : 0 < M) (hN : 0 < N) (hh : 0 < h)
    (hP : P ≤ N^4) (hlog : 48*h^3 ≤ Nat.log N M) :
    8/(N:ℝ)+2*(P:ℝ)^(lowerRequestThreshold h)/(M:ℝ) ≤ 10/(N:ℝ) := by
  let L := lowerRequestThreshold h
  let b := N^(4*L)
  have hL : L ≤ 3*h^3 := lowerRequestThreshold_le hh
  have hLp : 0 < L := by dsimp [L,lowerRequestThreshold]; omega
  have hp : N^(8*L) ≤ M := (Nat.pow_le_pow_right hN (show 8*L ≤ Nat.log N M by omega)).trans
    (Nat.pow_log_le_self N hM.ne')
  have hbM : b^2 ≤ M := by simpa [b,←pow_mul,mul_comm,mul_left_comm,mul_assoc] using hp
  have hPb : P^L ≤ b := by simpa [b,←pow_mul] using Nat.pow_le_pow_left hP L
  have hNb : N ≤ b := by
    calc
      N = N^1 := (pow_one _).symm
      _ ≤ N^(4*L) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hN (by omega)
  have hMR : (0:ℝ) < M := by exact_mod_cast hM
  have hNR : (0:ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hN
  have hbR : (0:ℝ) < b := by exact_mod_cast pow_pos hN (4*L)
  have hPR : (P:ℝ)^L ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hPb
  have hbMR : (b:ℝ)^2 ≤ M := by exact_mod_cast hbM
  have hNbR : (N:ℝ) ≤ b := by exact_mod_cast hNb
  have hr : (P:ℝ)^L/(M:ℝ) ≤ 1/(b:ℝ) := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hMR hbR).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hi := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hNR hNbR
  calc
    _ = 8/(N:ℝ)+2*((P:ℝ)^L/(M:ℝ)) := by ring
    _ ≤ 8/(N:ℝ)+2*(1/(N:ℝ)) := by linarith [hr.trans hi]
    _ = _ := by ring

variable {J U W : Type*} [Fintype J] [DecidableEq J] [Nonempty J]
 [Fintype U] [DecidableEq U] [Nonempty (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet]
 [Fintype W] [DecidableEq W]

Carpooling.padded_graph_lower_logarithmi.source:
theorem padded_graph_lower_logarithmic (H : SimpleGraph W) [DecidableRel H.Adj]
    [Nonempty H.edgeSet] (hH : H.IsRegularOfDegree (Fintype.card U-1))
    {h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (hsize : 6*h^3 ≤ Fintype.card U)
    (hrem : Fintype.card W ≤ 2*Fintype.card U)
    (hlog : 48*h^3 ≤ Nat.log (Fintype.card U) (Fintype.card J))
    (R : (Fin (Fintype.card ((J × U) ⊕ W)) → (paddedGraph (J := J) (U := U) H).edgeSet) →
      IntegerRun ((J × U) ⊕ W) (Fintype.card ((J × U) ⊕ W)))
    (hi : ∀ x v, (R x).d 0 v = 0)
    (hrequest : ∀ x (t : Fin (Fintype.card ((J × U) ⊕ W))),
      s(((R x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((R x).step t.val t.isLt).v) = (x t).val)
    (hcausal : ∀ (t : Fin (Fintype.card ((J × U) ⊕ W))) x y,
      (∀ i : Fin t.val, x ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (R x).d t.val = (R y).d t.val) :
    uniformProb (univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R h) ≤ 10/(Fintype.card U:ℝ) := by
  have hcube : h ≤ h^3 := by simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right hh (by decide : 1 ≤ 3)
  have hsmall : 2*h+2 ≤ Fintype.card U := by omega
  let f : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ U := {
    toFun := fun i => (Fintype.equivFin U).symm ⟨i.val,lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hsmall⟩
    inj' := by
      intro a b he
      have he' := (Fintype.equivFin U).symm.injective he
      exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun v : Fin (Fintype.card U) => v.val) he') }
  have hN : 0 < Fintype.card U := by omega
  have hL := lowerRequestThreshold_le hh
  have hb := padded_graph_stochastic_lower H hH hh f
    (show 2*lowerRequestThreshold h ≤ Fintype.card U by omega)
    (lowerRequestThreshold_horizon h) R hi hrequest hcausal
  have hq : Fintype.card (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet ≤ (Fintype.card U)^2 := by
    have he : Fintype.card (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet = (Fintype.card U).choose 2 := by
      simpa only [SimpleGraph.edgeFinset_card] using SimpleGraph.card_edgeFinset_top_eq_card_choose_two (V := U)
    rw [he]; exact Nat.choose_le_pow _ _
  have hp : Fintype.card H.edgeSet ≤ (Fintype.card U)^2 := by
    have he := regular_edge_balance H hH
    have hd : Fintype.card U-1 ≤ Fintype.card U := Nat.sub_le _ _
    have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul hrem hd
    nlinarith
  have hP : Fintype.card (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet*Fintype.card H.edgeSet ≤ (Fintype.card U)^4 := by
    have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul hq hp
    nlinarith
  apply hb.trans
  simpa only [Nat.cast_mul] using padded_failure_log_bound Fintype.card_pos hN hh hP hlog

end Carpooling

Carpooling.padding_parameters.source:
theorem padding_parameters {n d : ℕ} (hd : d < n) (heven : (n*d)%2 = 0) :
    let N := d+1
    let M := n/N-1
    let r := N+n%N
    n = M*N+r ∧ N ≤ r ∧ r < 2*N ∧ (r*d)%2 = 0 := by
  dsimp
  let N := d+1
  let M := n/N-1
  let r := N+n%N
  have hN : 0 < N := by dsimp [N]; omega
  have hq : 1 ≤ n/N := Nat.one_le_div_iff hN |>.mpr (by dsimp [N]; omega)
  have hq' : n/N = M+1 := by dsimp [M]; omega
  have hrem := Nat.mod_lt n hN
  have hsum := Nat.mod_add_div n N
  rw [hq'] at hsum
  have hsplit : n = M*N+r := by dsimp [r]; nlinarith
  have hNd : (N*d)%2 = 0 := by
    rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one d with he | he <;> simp [N,Nat.mul_mod,he,Nat.add_mod]
  have hMd : (M*N*d)%2 = 0 := by simp [Nat.mul_assoc,Nat.mul_mod,hNd]
  have hrEven : (r*d)%2 = 0 := by
    rw [hsplit,Nat.add_mul,Nat.add_mod,hMd,Nat.zero_add,Nat.mod_mod] at heven
    exact heven
  have hlow : N ≤ r := by dsimp [r]; omega
  have hhigh : r < 2*N := by dsimp [r]; omega
  exact ⟨hsplit,hlow,hhigh,hrEven⟩

Carpooling.cubicHeight.source: def cubicHeight (a q : ℕ) : ℕ := max 1 (Nat.findGreatest (fun h => h^3 ≤ q/a) (q/a))

Carpooling.cubicHeight_pos.source: lemma cubicHeight_pos (a q : ℕ) : 0 < cubicHeight a q := by unfold cubicHeight; omega

Carpooling.cubicHeight_spec.source:
lemma cubicHeight_spec {a q : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    cubicHeight a q = 1 ∨ a*(cubicHeight a q)^3 ≤ q := by
  let b := q/a
  let h := Nat.findGreatest (fun h => h^3 ≤ b) b
  have hh : h^3 ≤ b := Nat.findGreatest_spec (P := fun h => h^3 ≤ b) (Nat.zero_le b) (by simp)
  by_cases he : h ≤ 1
  · left; dsimp [cubicHeight,h,b] at *; omega
  · right
    have heq : cubicHeight a q = h := by dsimp [cubicHeight,h,b] at *; omega
    rw [heq]
    have hdiv := Nat.div_mul_le_self q a
    dsimp [b] at hh
    nlinarith [Nat.mul_le_mul_left a hh]

Carpooling.cubicHeight_covers.source:
lemma cubicHeight_covers {a q : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    q < 8*a*(cubicHeight a q)^3 := by
  let b := q/a
  let h := Nat.findGreatest (fun h => h^3 ≤ b) b
  have hroot : b < (h+1)^3 := by
    by_cases hb : h+1 ≤ b
    · exact lt_of_not_ge (Nat.findGreatest_is_greatest (P := fun h => h^3 ≤ b) (n := b) (k := h+1) (by omega : h < h+1) hb)
    · have hp : h+1 ≤ (h+1)^3 := by
        simpa using Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega : 0 < h+1) (by decide : 1 ≤ 3)
      omega
  have hH : h+1 ≤ 2*cubicHeight a q := by dsimp [cubicHeight,h,b] at *; omega
  have hp := Nat.pow_le_pow_left hH 3
  have hq : q < a*(b+1) := by
    have hr := Nat.mod_lt q ha
    have he := Nat.mod_add_div q a
    dsimp [b]
    nlinarith
  have hm := Nat.mul_le_mul_left a (show b+1 ≤ (h+1)^3 by omega)
  have hm' := Nat.mul_le_mul_left a hp
  nlinarith

Carpooling.padding_log_compare.source:
lemma padding_log_compare {n N M : ℕ} (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hsplit : n < (M+2)*N) : Nat.log N n ≤ Nat.log N M+3 := by
  let q := Nat.log N M
  have hp := Nat.lt_pow_succ_log_self (show 1 < N by omega) M
  have hMp : M+1 ≤ N^(q+1) := by simpa [q] using hp
  have hNN : 2*N ≤ N^2 := by nlinarith
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_left (N^(q+1)) hNN
  have hmp := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2*N) hMp
  have hpow : n < N^(q+3) := by
    have he : N^(q+3) = N^(q+1)*N^2 := by rw [←pow_add]
    rw [he]
    have hn2 : n < 2*(M+1)*N := by nlinarith
    nlinarith
  have hl := Nat.log_lt_of_lt_pow hn.ne' hpow
  dsimp [q] at hl
  omega

end Carpooling

Carpooling.potential.source: noncomputable def potential (x : V → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ k, posSq (x k)

Carpooling.posSq_nonneg.source: lemma posSq_nonneg (a : ℝ) : 0 ≤ posSq a := sq_nonneg _

Carpooling.posSq_add_le.source:
lemma posSq_add_le (a b : ℝ) :
    posSq (a+b) ≤ posSq a + 2 * max a 0 * b + b^2 := by
  unfold posSq
  simp only [max_def]
  split_ifs <;> nlinarith

Carpooling.posSq_contracting.source:
lemma posSq_contracting {a b w : ℝ} (_hab : a ≤ b)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hc : a+w ≤ b) :
    posSq (a+w) + posSq (b-w) ≤ posSq a + posSq b := by
  unfold posSq
  simp only [max_def]
  split_ifs <;> nlinarith

Carpooling.posSq_step_le.source:
lemma posSq_step_le {a b w : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (hw : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1) :
    posSq (a+w) + posSq (b-w) ≤ posSq a + posSq b + 2 := by
  have ha := posSq_add_le a w
  have hb := posSq_add_le b (-w)
  rw [← sub_eq_add_neg] at hb
  have hmax : max a 0 ≤ max b 0 := max_le_max hab (le_refl 0)
  have hprod : 0 ≤ (max b 0 - max a 0) * w := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hw
  have hsq : w^2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  nlinarith

Carpooling.Move.potential_change.source:
lemma Move.potential_change {x y : V → ℝ} (e : Move x y) :
    potential y = potential x - posSq (x e.u) - posSq (x e.v) +
      posSq (x e.u + e.weight) + posSq (x e.v - e.weight) := by
  have h : ∀ k, posSq (y k) = posSq (x k) +
      (if k = e.u then posSq (x e.u + e.weight) - posSq (x e.u) else 0) +
      (if k = e.v then posSq (x e.v - e.weight) - posSq (x e.v) else 0) := by
    intro k
    by_cases hu : k = e.u
    · subst k; rw [e.at_u]; simp [e.distinct]
    · by_cases hv : k = e.v
      · subst k; rw [e.at_v]; simp [Ne.symm e.distinct]
      · rw [e.update]; simp [hu, hv]
  unfold potential
  simp_rw [h, sum_add_distrib]
  simp; ring

Carpooling.Move.potential_le.source:
lemma Move.potential_le {x y : V → ℝ} (e : Move x y) :
    potential y ≤ potential x + (if e.Expanding then 2 else 0) := by
  classical
  rw [e.potential_change]
  by_cases h : e.Expanding
  · rw [if_pos h]
    linarith [posSq_step_le e.ordered e.weight_nonneg e.weight_le_one]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    have hc : x e.u + e.weight ≤ x e.v := le_of_not_gt h
    linarith [posSq_contracting e.ordered e.weight_nonneg hc]

Carpooling.expandingCount_succ.source:
lemma expandingCount_succ {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) {t : ℕ} (ht : t < T) :
    expandingCount R (t+1) = expandingCount R t +
      (if (R.step t ht).Expanding then 1 else 0) := by
  classical
  unfold expandingCount
  rw [range_add_one, filter_insert]
  by_cases h : (R.step t ht).Expanding
  · simp [ht, h]
  · simp [ht, h]

/-- Lemma 3.2 with the exact prefix count. -/

Carpooling.potential_bound.source:
theorem potential_bound {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (hinit : ∀ k, R.d 0 k ≤ 0)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T) : potential (R.d t) ≤ 2 * (expandingCount R t : ℝ) := by
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    have hz : potential (R.d 0) = 0 := by
      apply sum_eq_zero
      intro k _
      simp [posSq, max_eq_right (hinit k)]
    simp [hz, expandingCount]
  | succ t ih =>
    have hs := (R.step t (by omega)).potential_le
    have hp := ih (by omega)
    rw [expandingCount_succ R (by omega), Nat.cast_add]
    split_ifs at * <;> norm_num at * <;> linarith

end Carpooling

Carpooling.exists_prefix_cut.source:
theorem exists_prefix_cut {T L : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin T)) (hL : L ≤ S.card) :
    ∃ c ≤ T, (S.filter fun t => t.val < c).card = L := by
  by_cases hz : L = 0
  · exact ⟨0,Nat.zero_le _,by simp [hz]⟩
  have hex : ∃ c, L ≤ (S.filter fun t => t.val < c).card :=
    ⟨T,by simpa using hL⟩
  let c := Nat.find hex
  have hc : c ≤ T := Nat.find_min' hex (by simpa using hL)
  have hcL : L ≤ (S.filter fun t => t.val < c).card := Nat.find_spec hex
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by
    by_contra hn
    have he : c = 0 := by omega
    simp only [he,Nat.not_lt_zero,filter_false,card_empty] at hcL
    omega
  have hprev : ¬ L ≤ (S.filter fun t => t.val < c-1).card :=
    Nat.find_min hex (show c-1 < c by omega)
  have hi : c-1 < T := by omega
  have hset : (S.filter fun t => t.val < c) ⊆
      insert (⟨c-1,hi⟩ : Fin T) (S.filter fun t => t.val < c-1) := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨htS,htc⟩ := mem_filter.mp ht
    by_cases htp : t.val < c-1
    · exact mem_insert_of_mem (mem_filter.mpr ⟨htS,htp⟩)
    · apply mem_insert.mpr
      left
      apply Fin.ext
      change t.val = c-1
      omega
  have hcard := (card_le_card hset).trans (card_insert_le _ _)
  exact ⟨c,hc,by omega⟩

end Carpooling

Carpooling.extendPosition.source:
noncomputable def extendPosition (f : V ↪ W) (x : V → ℤ) (w : W) : ℤ :=
  if h : ∃ v, f v = w then x h.choose else 0

Carpooling.extendPosition_at.source:
@[simp] lemma extendPosition_at (f : V ↪ W) (x : V → ℤ) (v : V) :
    extendPosition f x (f v) = x v := by
  have h : ∃ a, f a = f v := ⟨v,rfl⟩
  simp only [extendPosition,dif_pos h]
  exact congrArg x (f.injective h.choose_spec)

Carpooling.UnitMove.pushforward.source:
noncomputable def UnitMove.pushforward {x y : V → ℤ} (e : UnitMove x y) (f : V ↪ W) :
    UnitMove (extendPosition f x) (extendPosition f y) where
  u := f e.u
  v := f e.v
  distinct := f.injective.ne e.distinct
  update := by
    intro w
    by_cases hw : ∃ v, f v = w
    · obtain ⟨v,rfl⟩ := hw
      simp only [extendPosition_at,f.injective.eq_iff]
      exact e.update v
    · have hu : w ≠ f e.u := fun he => hw ⟨e.u,he.symm⟩
      have hv : w ≠ f e.v := fun he => hw ⟨e.v,he.symm⟩
      simp [extendPosition,hw,hu,hv]

Carpooling.IntegerRun.pushforward.source:
noncomputable def IntegerRun.pushforward {T : ℕ} (R : IntegerRun V T) (f : V ↪ W) :
    IntegerRun W T where
  d := fun t => extendPosition f (R.d t)
  step := fun t ht => (R.step t ht).pushforward f

Carpooling.IntegerRun.pushforward_initia.source:
lemma IntegerRun.pushforward_initial {T : ℕ} (R : IntegerRun V T) (f : V ↪ W)
    (hi : ∀ v, R.d 0 v = 0) : ∀ w, (R.pushforward f).d 0 w = 0 := by
  intro w
  simp [IntegerRun.pushforward,extendPosition,hi]

Carpooling.pushforward_discrepancy_iff.source:
lemma pushforward_discrepancy_iff {T h : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (R : IntegerRun V T) (f : V ↪ W) :
    (∃ t ≤ T, ∃ w, (h:ℤ) ≤ |(R.pushforward f).d t w|) ↔
      ∃ t ≤ T, ∃ v, (h:ℤ) ≤ |R.d t v| := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t,ht,w,hw⟩
    by_cases hr : ∃ v, f v = w
    · obtain ⟨v,rfl⟩ := hr
      exact ⟨t,ht,v,by simpa [IntegerRun.pushforward] using hw⟩
    · have hn : (h:ℤ) ≤ 0 := by simpa [IntegerRun.pushforward,extendPosition,hr] using hw
      have hp : (0:ℤ) < h := by exact_mod_cast hh
      omega
  · rintro ⟨t,ht,v,hv⟩
    exact ⟨t,ht,f v,by simpa [IntegerRun.pushforward] using hv⟩

end Carpooling

Carpooling.badRefinedBatchEvent.source:
noncomputable def badRefinedBatchEvent (N : V → Finset V) (g : E → Sym2 V) (K B L p : ℕ) :
    Finset (Fin K → Fin B → E) :=
  univ.biUnion fun j => evaluationEvent (badRefinedEvent N g B L p) j

Carpooling.stochastic_refined_batched_pr.source:
theorem stochastic_refined_batched_probability (N : V → Finset V) {Δ : ℕ}
    (hΔ : ∀ v, (N v).card ≤ Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (hsymm : ∀ {u v}, v ∈ N u → u ∈ N v)
    (g : E → Sym2 V) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (hbalance : 2 * Fintype.card E = Fintype.card V * Δ)
    (K B : ℕ) (hB : 16*B ≤ Fintype.card V) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hlarge : 256 ≤ Δ) (hdegree : (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))^3 ≤ Δ) :
    uniformProb (badRefinedBatchEvent N g K B (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))
      (refinedThreshold (Fintype.card V) Δ)) ≤ 3*K/(Fintype.card V:ℝ) := by
  have h := batch_failure_bound (K := K)
    (badRefinedEvent N g B (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V)) (refinedThreshold (Fintype.card V) Δ))
  have hp := stochastic_refined_high_probability N hΔ hpos hsymm g hg hbalance B hB hn hlarge hdegree
  calc
    _ ≤ (K:ℝ)*uniformProb (badRefinedEvent N g B (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))
      (refinedThreshold (Fintype.card V) Δ)) := h
    _ ≤ (K:ℝ)*(3/(Fintype.card V:ℝ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

Carpooling.refined_bound_outside_bad_eve.source:
theorem refined_bound_outside_bad_event {T L p : ℕ} (N : V → Finset V) (g : E → Sym2 V)
    (x : Fin T → E) (hx : x ∉ badRefinedEvent N g T L p) (R : Run V T)
    (hi : ∀ k, R.d 0 k = 0)
    (hAdj : ∀ s (hs : s < T), (R.step s hs).v ∈ N (R.step s hs).u)
    (hbag : R.edgeBag T ≤ sampleBag g x) {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T) (k : V) :
    |R.d t k| ≤ 4*(p:ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) + 2*(Nat.log 2 L:ℝ) := by
  by_contra hn
  apply hx
  apply mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨mem_univ _,t,ht,R.prefix t ht,hi,?_,?_,k,lt_of_not_ge hn⟩
  · intro s hs; exact hAdj s (lt_of_lt_of_le hs ht)
  · rw [R.edgeBag_prefix ht (le_refl t)]
    exact (R.edgeBag_mono ht).trans hbag

/-- A deterministic certificate for every global prefix of the batched online algorithm. -/

Carpooling.refined_aggregate_bound.source:
theorem refined_aggregate_bound {K B L p : ℕ} (N : V → Finset V) (g : E → Sym2 V)
    (x : Fin K → Fin B → E) (hx : x ∉ badRefinedBatchEvent N g K B L p)
    (R : Fin K → Run V B) (hi : ∀ j k, (R j).d 0 k = 0)
    (hAdj : ∀ j s (hs : s < B), ((R j).step s hs).v ∈ N ((R j).step s hs).u)
    (hbag : ∀ j, (R j).edgeBag B = sampleBag g (x j))
    (cutoff : Fin K → ℕ) (hcut : ∀ j, cutoff j ≤ B) (k : V) :
    |∑ j, (R j).d (cutoff j) k| ≤ (K:ℝ)*(4*(p:ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3)+2*(Nat.log 2 L:ℝ)) := by
  have hlocal : ∀ j, |(R j).d (cutoff j) k| ≤ 4*(p:ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3)+2*(Nat.log 2 L:ℝ) := by
    intro j
    apply refined_bound_outside_bad_event N g (x j) _ (R j) (hi j) (hAdj j) (le_of_eq (hbag j)) (hcut j) k
    intro hj
    apply hx
    exact mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨j,mem_univ _,mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,hj⟩⟩
  calc
    |∑ j, (R j).d (cutoff j) k| ≤ ∑ j, |(R j).d (cutoff j) k| := abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _j : Fin K, (4*(p:ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3)+2*(Nat.log 2 L:ℝ)) := sum_le_sum fun j _ => hlocal j
    _ = _ := by simp only [sum_const,card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]

end Carpooling

Carpooling.refinedThreshold.source: def refinedThreshold (n Δ : ℕ) : ℕ := 24 * Nat.clog 2 n / Nat.log 2 Δ + 1

Carpooling.degreeRoot_fourth_le.source:
lemma degreeRoot_fourth_le {Δ : ℕ} (hΔ : 0 < Δ) : (degreeRoot Δ)^4 ≤ Δ := by
  unfold degreeRoot
  rw [← pow_mul]
  exact (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 0 < 2) (Nat.div_mul_le_self _ _)).trans
    (Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 hΔ.ne')

Carpooling.degreeRoot_pos.source: lemma degreeRoot_pos (Δ : ℕ) : 0 < degreeRoot Δ := by unfold degreeRoot; positivity

Carpooling.refinedThreshold_power.source:
lemma refinedThreshold_power {n Δ : ℕ} (hΔ : 256 ≤ Δ) :
    n^3 ≤ (degreeRoot Δ)^(refinedThreshold n Δ) := by
  let q := Nat.log 2 Δ
  let a := q/4
  let b := Nat.clog 2 n
  let p := refinedThreshold n Δ
  have hq : 8 ≤ q := Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by decide : 1 < 2) hΔ
  have hqa : q ≤ 8*a := by dsimp [a]; omega
  have hrem := Nat.mod_lt (24*b) (by omega : 0 < q)
  have hdiv := Nat.mod_add_div (24*b) q
  have hquot : 24*b < q*p := by dsimp [p,refinedThreshold,q,b] at *; nlinarith
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right p hqa
  have hab : 3*b ≤ a*p := by nlinarith
  calc
    n^3 ≤ (2^b)^3 := Nat.pow_le_pow_left (Nat.le_pow_clog (by decide : 1 < 2) n) 3
    _ = 2^(3*b) := by rw [← pow_mul]; congr 1; omega
    _ ≤ 2^(a*p) := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide : 0 < 2) hab
    _ = (degreeRoot Δ)^(refinedThreshold n Δ) := by simp [degreeRoot,a,q,p,pow_mul]

Carpooling.root_condition.source:
lemma root_condition {L Δ : ℕ} (hL : L^3 ≤ Δ) (hΔ : 0 < Δ) :
    L^2 * degreeRoot Δ ≤ 8*Δ := by
  let D := degreeRoot Δ
  have hD4 : D^4 ≤ Δ := degreeRoot_fourth_le hΔ
  have hDpos : 0 < D := degreeRoot_pos Δ
  have hh : L^2*D ≤ Δ := by
    by_cases hDL : D ≤ L
    · exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (L^2) hDL).trans (by nlinarith [hL])
    · have hLD : L ≤ D := by omega
      have hh := Nat.mul_le_mul_right D (Nat.pow_le_pow_left hLD 2)
      have h34 : D^3 ≤ D^4 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right hDpos (by decide : 3 ≤ 4)
      nlinarith
  change L^2*D ≤ 8*Δ
  omega

Carpooling.threshold_failure_bound.source:
lemma threshold_failure_bound {n : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n) :
    2*(n:ℝ)/(2:ℝ)^(stochasticThreshold n) ≤ 1/(n:ℝ) := by
  have hp : 2*(n:ℝ)^2 ≤ (2:ℝ)^(stochasticThreshold n) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.le_pow_clog (by decide : 1 < 2) (2*n^2)
  have hnR : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hnR).mpr
  nlinarith

variable {V E : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
  [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]

/-- The refined stochastic upper bound with explicit integer logarithms.
L = ceil(log_2(2 n^2)), p = floor(24 ceil(log_2 n)/floor(log_2 Δ)) + 1.
Outside an event of probability at most 3/n, every compatible subrun has
discrepancy at most 4 p^(1/3) + 2 floor(log_2 L). -/

Carpooling.stochastic_refined_high_proba.source:
theorem stochastic_refined_high_probability (N : V → Finset V) {Δ : ℕ}
    (hΔ : ∀ v, (N v).card ≤ Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (hsymm : ∀ {u v}, v ∈ N u → u ∈ N v)
    (g : E → Sym2 V) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (hbalance : 2 * Fintype.card E = Fintype.card V * Δ)
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 16*T ≤ Fintype.card V) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hlarge : 256 ≤ Δ) (hdegree : (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))^3 ≤ Δ) :
    uniformProb (badRefinedEvent N g T (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))
      (refinedThreshold (Fintype.card V) Δ)) ≤ 3/(Fintype.card V:ℝ) := by
  let n := Fintype.card V
  let L := stochasticThreshold n
  let p := refinedThreshold n Δ
  let D := degreeRoot Δ
  have hnR : (0:ℝ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hDR : (0:ℝ) < D := by exact_mod_cast degreeRoot_pos Δ
  have hΔR : (0:ℝ) < Δ := by exact_mod_cast hpos
  have hcondition : (L:ℝ)^2*D ≤ 8*Δ := by exact_mod_cast root_condition hdegree hpos
  have hratio : (L:ℝ)^2/(8*Δ) ≤ 1/(D:ℝ) :=
    (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hDR).mpr (by simpa using hcondition)
  have hpower : (n:ℝ)^3 ≤ (D:ℝ)^p := by exact_mod_cast refinedThreshold_power (n := n) hlarge
  have hinv : 1/(D:ℝ)^p ≤ 1/(n:ℝ)^3 := one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) hpower
  have hqpow : ((L:ℝ)^2/(8*Δ))^p ≤ 1/(n:ℝ)^3 := by
    exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hratio p).trans (by simpa [div_pow] using hinv)
  have hsmall : 2*(n:ℝ)*((L:ℝ)^2/(8*Δ))^p ≤ 2/(n:ℝ)^2 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ 2*(n:ℝ)*(1/(n:ℝ)^3) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqpow (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by field_simp
  have ht := stochastic_refined_tail N hΔ hpos hsymm g hg hbalance T L p hT
  have hfirst := threshold_failure_bound hn
  change 2*(n:ℝ)/(2:ℝ)^L ≤ 1/(n:ℝ) at hfirst
  change uniformProb (badRefinedEvent N g T L p) ≤
    2*(n:ℝ)/(2:ℝ)^L + 2*(n:ℝ)*((L:ℝ)^2/(8*Δ))^p at ht
  have hnone : (1:ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hinv2 : 1/(n:ℝ)^2 ≤ 1/(n:ℝ) := one_div_le_one_div_of_le hnR (by nlinarith)
  change uniformProb (badRefinedEvent N g T L p) ≤ 3/(n:ℝ)
  calc
    _ ≤ 2*(n:ℝ)/(2:ℝ)^L + 2*(n:ℝ)*((L:ℝ)^2/(8*Δ))^p := ht
    _ ≤ 1/(n:ℝ) + 2/(n:ℝ)^2 := add_le_add hfirst hsmall
    _ ≤ 1/(n:ℝ) + 2*(1/(n:ℝ)) := by
      apply add_le_add_left
      calc
        2/(n:ℝ)^2 = 2*(1/(n:ℝ)^2) := by ring
        _ ≤ 2*(1/(n:ℝ)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinv2 (by norm_num)
    _ = 3/(n:ℝ) := by ring

end Carpooling

Carpooling.Witness.nodeLabels.source:
def nodeLabels : Tree V → List V
  | .nil => []
  | .node v L R => v :: (nodeLabels L ++ nodeLabels R)

Carpooling.Witness.labels.source: def labels (root : V) (F : Tree V) : List V := root :: nodeLabels F

Carpooling.Witness.labels_length.source:
@[simp] lemma labels_length (root : V) (F : Tree V) : (labels root F).length = F.numNodes + 1 := by
  have h : (nodeLabels F).length = F.numNodes := by
    induction F with
    | nil => rfl
    | node v L R ihL ihR => simp [nodeLabels,Tree.numNodes,ihL,ihR]
  simp [labels,h]

Carpooling.Witness.vertices_labels.source:
lemma vertices_labels (root : V) (F : Tree V) : vertices root F = (labels root F).toFinset := by
  induction F generalizing root with
  | nil => simp [vertices,labels,nodeLabels]
  | node v L R ihL ihR =>
    rw [vertices,ihL,ihR]
    ext k
    simp [labels,nodeLabels,or_assoc,or_comm,or_left_comm]

Carpooling.Witness.labelAt.source:
noncomputable def labelAt (m : ℕ) (root : V) (F : Tree V) (i : Fin m) : V :=
  if h : i.val < (labels root F).length then (labels root F)[i.val] else root

Carpooling.Witness.exists_labelAt.source:
lemma exists_labelAt {m : ℕ} {root v : V} {F : Tree V}
    (hm : F.numNodes + 1 = m) (hv : v ∈ vertices root F) :
    ∃ i : Fin m, labelAt m root F i = v := by
  rw [vertices_labels, List.mem_toFinset] at hv
  obtain ⟨j,hj⟩ := List.mem_iff_get.mp hv
  have hlen : (labels root F).length = m := (labels_length root F).trans hm
  let i : Fin m := ⟨j.val, by rw [← hlen]; exact j.isLt⟩
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  change (if h : j.val < (labels root F).length then (labels root F)[j.val] else root) = v
  rw [dif_pos j.isLt]
  exact hj

Carpooling.Witness.extraBag.source:
noncomputable def extraBag {m p : ℕ} (root : V) (F : Tree V) (code : Fin p → Fin m × Fin m) : Multiset (Sym2 V) :=
  univ.val.map fun j => s(labelAt m root F (code j).1, labelAt m root F (code j).2)

Carpooling.Witness.extraBag_card.source:
@[simp] lemma extraBag_card {m p : ℕ} (root : V) (F : Tree V) (code : Fin p → Fin m × Fin m) :
    (extraBag root F code).card = p := by simp [extraBag]

Carpooling.Witness.edges_support.source:
lemma edges_support {root : V} {F : Tree V} {e : Sym2 V} (he : e ∈ edges root F)
    {v : V} (hv : v ∈ e) : v ∈ vertices root F := by
  induction F generalizing root e v with
  | nil => simp [edges] at he
  | node a L R ihL ihR =>
    simp only [edges,Multiset.mem_add,Multiset.mem_singleton] at he
    rcases he with (he | he) | he
    · subst e
      rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hv with hv | hv
      · rw [hv]; exact mem_union_right _ (root_mem root R)
      · rw [hv]; exact mem_union_left _ (root_mem a L)
    · exact mem_union_left _ (ihL he hv)
    · exact mem_union_right _ (ihR he hv)

/-- Encode p surplus edges using two indices among the m core-tree vertices. -/

Carpooling.Witness.encode_extras.source:
theorem encode_extras {m p : ℕ} {root : V} {F : Tree V} (hm : F.numNodes + 1 = m)
    (Q : Multiset (Sym2 V)) (hp : Q.card = p)
    (hs : ∀ e ∈ Q, ∀ v ∈ e, v ∈ vertices root F) :
    ∃ code : Fin p → Fin m × Fin m, extraBag root F code = Q := by
  have hlen : Q.toList.length = p := (Multiset.length_toList Q).trans hp
  clear hp
  subst p
  have hmem : ∀ j : Fin Q.toList.length, bagEnumeration Q j ∈ Q := by
    intro j
    simpa only [bagEnumeration, Multiset.mem_toList] using (List.get_mem Q.toList j)
  have hex : ∀ j : Fin Q.toList.length, ∃ ij : Fin m × Fin m,
      s(labelAt m root F ij.1,labelAt m root F ij.2) = bagEnumeration Q j := by
    intro j
    let e := bagEnumeration Q j
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := exists_labelAt hm (hs e (hmem j) e.out.1 (Sym2.out_fst_mem e))
    obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := exists_labelAt hm (hs e (hmem j) e.out.2 (Sym2.out_snd_mem e))
    refine ⟨(a,b), ?_⟩
    rw [ha,hb]
    exact e.out_eq
  choose code hcode using hex
  refine ⟨code, ?_⟩
  unfold extraBag
  have hmap : (fun j => s(labelAt m root F (code j).1,labelAt m root F (code j).2)) = bagEnumeration Q := funext hcode
  rw [hmap,bagEnumeration_bag]

Carpooling.Witness.refinedPattern.source:
noncomputable def refinedPattern {m p : ℕ} (w : V × Tree V) (code : Fin p → Fin m × Fin m) : Multiset (Sym2 V) :=
  edges w.1 w.2 + extraBag w.1 w.2 code

Carpooling.Witness.refinedPattern_card.source:
lemma refinedPattern_card {N : V → Finset V} {m p : ℕ} {w : V × Tree V}
    (hw : w ∈ families N (m-1)) (code : Fin p → Fin m × Fin m) :
    (refinedPattern w code).card = m-1+p := by
  simp only [refinedPattern,Multiset.card_add,edges_card,extraBag_card,families_nodes hw]

Carpooling.Witness.code_card.source:
lemma code_card (m p : ℕ) : Fintype.card (Fin p → Fin m × Fin m) = m^(2*p) := by
  simp only [Fintype.card_fun,Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_fin]
  rw [← pow_two,← pow_mul]

end Witness

section Probability
variable {E : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]

Carpooling.refinedWitnessEvent.source:
noncomputable def refinedWitnessEvent (N : V → Finset V) (g : E → Sym2 V) (T m p : ℕ) :
    Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  ((Witness.families N (m-1)) ×ˢ (univ : Finset (Fin p → Fin m × Fin m))).biUnion
    fun w => bagOccurrenceEvent g (Witness.refinedPattern w.1 w.2)

/-- The refined witness enumeration and occurrence estimate, before graph-specific simplification. -/

Carpooling.refined_witness_probability.source:
theorem refined_witness_probability (N : V → Finset V) {Δ : ℕ} (hΔ : ∀ v, (N v).card ≤ Δ)
    (g : E → Sym2 V) (hg : Function.Injective g) (T m p : ℕ) :
    uniformProb (refinedWitnessEvent N g T m p) ≤
      ((4:ℝ)^(m-1) * Fintype.card V * (Δ:ℝ)^(m-1) * (m:ℝ)^(2*p)) *
      ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)^(m-1+p) := by
  let S := (Witness.families N (m-1)) ×ˢ (univ : Finset (Fin p → Fin m × Fin m))
  have hu := uniformProb_biUnion_le S (fun w => bagOccurrenceEvent (T := T) g (Witness.refinedPattern w.1 w.2))
  have hs : (∑ w ∈ S, uniformProb (bagOccurrenceEvent (T := T) g (Witness.refinedPattern w.1 w.2))) ≤
      (S.card : ℝ) * ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)^(m-1+p) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _w ∈ S, ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)^(m-1+p) := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro w hw
        have hf := (mem_product.mp hw).1
        simpa only [Witness.refinedPattern_card hf] using bag_occurrence_probability (T := T) g hg (Witness.refinedPattern w.1 w.2)
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hcN : S.card ≤ 4^(m-1) * Fintype.card V * Δ^(m-1) * m^(2*p) := by
    rw [card_product,card_univ,Witness.code_card]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Witness.families_card_bound N hΔ (m-1))
  have hc : (S.card : ℝ) ≤ (4:ℝ)^(m-1) * Fintype.card V * (Δ:ℝ)^(m-1) * (m:ℝ)^(2*p) := by exact_mod_cast hcN
