  exact (hu.trans hs).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (by positivity))

end Probability
end Carpooling

Carpooling.jumpGraph.source:
def jumpGraph (S : Finset (Fin r)) (hzero : (0:Fin r) ∉ S)
    (hneg : ∀ x ∈ S, -x ∈ S) : SimpleGraph (Fin r) where
  Adj x y := y-x ∈ S
  symm := by intro x y h; simpa using hneg (y-x) h
  loopless := by intro x h; exact hzero (by simpa using h)

Carpooling.jumpGraph_regular.source:
theorem jumpGraph_regular (S : Finset (Fin r)) (hzero : (0:Fin r) ∉ S)
    (hneg : ∀ x ∈ S, -x ∈ S) :
    (jumpGraph S hzero hneg).IsRegularOfDegree S.card := by
  intro x
  let e : (jumpGraph S hzero hneg).neighborSet x ≃ S := {
    toFun := fun y => ⟨y.val-x,y.property⟩
    invFun := fun z => ⟨z.val+x,by simpa [jumpGraph] using z.property⟩
    left_inv := by intro y; apply Subtype.ext; simp
    right_inv := by intro z; apply Subtype.ext; simp }
  rw [←SimpleGraph.card_neighborSet_eq_degree]
  simpa using Fintype.card_congr e

Carpooling.positiveJump.source:
def positiveJump (k : ℕ) (hk : 2*k < r) (i : Fin k) : Fin r :=
  ⟨i.val+1,by omega⟩

Carpooling.positiveJump_injective.source:
lemma positiveJump_injective (k : ℕ) (hk : 2*k < r) :
    Function.Injective (positiveJump k hk) := by
  intro i j hij
  apply Fin.ext
  have he := congrArg (fun z : Fin r => z.val) hij
  dsimp [positiveJump] at he
  omega

Carpooling.positiveJump_ne_zero.source:
lemma positiveJump_ne_zero (k : ℕ) (hk : 2*k < r) (i : Fin k) :
    positiveJump k hk i ≠ 0 := by
  intro he
  have hv := congrArg (fun z : Fin r => z.val) he
  dsimp [positiveJump] at hv
  omega

Carpooling.neg_positiveJump_val.source:
lemma neg_positiveJump_val (k : ℕ) (hk : 2*k < r) (i : Fin k) :
    (-positiveJump k hk i).val = r-(i.val+1) := by
  change (r-(i.val+1))%r = r-(i.val+1)
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have hr : 0 < r := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (NeZero.ne r)
  omega

end Jumps

/-- Every admissible pair (r,d) has a d-regular simple graph on exactly r
vertices. The explicit construction uses paired positive/negative jumps,
and adds the antipodal jump when d is odd. -/

Carpooling.exists_regular_graph.source:
theorem exists_regular_graph {r d : ℕ} (hd : d < r) (heven : (r*d)%2 = 0) :
    ∃ G : SimpleGraph (Fin r), G.IsRegularOfDegree d := by
  classical
  have hr : 0 < r := by omega
  letI : NeZero r := ⟨hr.ne'⟩
  let k := d/2
  have hk : 2*k < r := by dsimp [k]; omega
  let S : Finset (Fin r) := univ.image (positiveJump k hk)
  let A := S ∪ S.image (fun x => -x)
  have hScard : S.card = k := by simp [S,card_image_of_injective _ (positiveJump_injective k hk)]
  have hSzero : (0:Fin r) ∉ S := by
    intro h
    obtain ⟨i,_,hi⟩ := mem_image.mp h
    exact positiveJump_ne_zero k hk i hi
  have hSdisjoint : Disjoint S (S.image (fun x => -x)) := by
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro z hz hn
    obtain ⟨i,_,hi⟩ := mem_image.mp hz
    obtain ⟨w,hw,hneg⟩ := mem_image.mp hn
    obtain ⟨j,_,hj⟩ := mem_image.mp hw
    have he : positiveJump k hk i = -positiveJump k hk j := by rw [hi,hj,hneg]
    have hv := congrArg (fun z : Fin r => z.val) he
    change (positiveJump k hk i).val = (-positiveJump k hk j).val at hv
    rw [neg_positiveJump_val] at hv
    dsimp [positiveJump] at hv
    omega
  have hAcard : A.card = 2*k := by
    dsimp [A]
    rw [card_union_of_disjoint hSdisjoint,card_image_of_injective _ neg_injective,hScard]
    omega
  have hAzero : (0:Fin r) ∉ A := by
    simp only [A,mem_union,mem_image]
    rintro (hz | ⟨x,hx,hneg⟩)
    · exact hSzero hz
    · have he : x = 0 := neg_eq_zero.mp hneg
      exact hSzero (he ▸ hx)
  have hAneg : ∀ x ∈ A, -x ∈ A := by
    intro x hx
    rcases mem_union.mp hx with hx | hx
    · exact mem_union_right _ (mem_image.mpr ⟨x,hx,rfl⟩)
    · obtain ⟨y,hy,he⟩ := mem_image.mp hx
      rw [←he,neg_neg]
      exact mem_union_left _ hy
  by_cases hodd : d%2 = 1
  · have hre : r%2 = 0 := by simpa [Nat.mul_mod,hodd] using heven
    have hr2 : 2 ≤ r := by omega
    let mid : Fin r := ⟨r/2,by omega⟩
    have hmidzero : mid ≠ 0 := by
      intro he
      have hv := congrArg (fun z : Fin r => z.val) he
      change r/2 = 0 at hv
      omega
    have hmidneg : -mid = mid := by
      apply Fin.ext
      change (r-r/2)%r = r/2
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : r-r/2 < r)]
      omega
    have hmidS : mid ∉ S := by
      intro h
      obtain ⟨i,_,hi⟩ := mem_image.mp h
      have hv := congrArg (fun z : Fin r => z.val) hi
      change i.val+1 = r/2 at hv
      dsimp [k] at *
      omega
    have hmidA : mid ∉ A := by
      intro h
      rcases mem_union.mp h with h | h
      · exact hmidS h
      · obtain ⟨x,hx,he⟩ := mem_image.mp h
        have hxmid : x = mid := by simpa [hmidneg] using congrArg Neg.neg he
        exact hmidS (hxmid ▸ hx)
    let B := insert mid A
    have hBzero : (0:Fin r) ∉ B := by simpa [B,hAzero] using Ne.symm hmidzero
    have hBneg : ∀ x ∈ B, -x ∈ B := by
      intro x hx
      rcases mem_insert.mp hx with hx | hx
      · subst x; rw [hmidneg]; exact mem_insert_self _ _
      · exact mem_insert_of_mem (hAneg x hx)
    refine ⟨jumpGraph B hBzero hBneg,?_⟩
    have hb := jumpGraph_regular B hBzero hBneg
    have hcard : B.card = d := by simp only [B,card_insert_of_notMem hmidA,hAcard]; dsimp [k]; omega
    rwa [hcard] at hb
  · refine ⟨jumpGraph A hAzero hAneg,?_⟩
    have hcard : A.card = d := by rw [hAcard]; dsimp [k]; omega
    have ha := jumpGraph_regular A hAzero hAneg
    rwa [hcard] at ha

end Carpooling

Carpooling.regular_cliques_stochastic_lo.source:
theorem regular_cliques_stochastic_lower {L h : ℕ}
    (f : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ U) (hNL : 2*L ≤ Fintype.card U)
    (hL : ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(L:ℤ))
    (R : (Fin (Fintype.card J*Fintype.card U) →
      (disjointCliques (J := J) (U := U)).edgeSet) →
      IntegerRun (J × U) (Fintype.card J*Fintype.card U))
    (hi : ∀ x v, (R x).d 0 v = 0)
    (hrequest : ∀ x (t : Fin (Fintype.card J*Fintype.card U)),
      s(((R x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((R x).step t.val t.isLt).v) = (x t).val)
    (hcausal : ∀ (t : Fin (Fintype.card J*Fintype.card U)) x y,
      (∀ i : Fin t.val, x ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (R x).d t.val = (R y).d t.val) :
    uniformProb (univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R h) ≤
      8/(Fintype.card U:ℝ)+2*((Fintype.card U).choose 2:ℝ)^L/(Fintype.card J:ℝ) := by
  classical
  let T := Fintype.card J*Fintype.card U
  let e := cliqueSampleEquiv (J := J) (U := U) T
  let Q := fun s x => R (e (s,x))
  letI : Nonempty U := ⟨f ⟨0,by omega⟩⟩
  letI : Nonempty (disjointCliques (J := J) (U := U)).edgeSet :=
    ⟨disjointCliqueEdgeEquiv (Classical.choice ‹Nonempty J›,
      Classical.choice ‹Nonempty (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet›)⟩
  let encode : (a b : Fin (2*h+2)) → a ≠ b → (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet :=
    fun a b hab => ⟨s(f a,f b),by simpa using f.injective.ne hab⟩
  have hreq : ∀ s x (t : Fin T),
      s(((Q s x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((Q s x).step t.val t.isLt).v) =
        ((x t).val).map (fun u => (s t,u)) := by
    intro s x t
    exact hrequest (e (s,x)) t
  have hcaus : ∀ s (t : Fin T) x y,
      (∀ i : Fin t.val, x ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (Q s x).d t.val = (Q s y).d t.val := by
    intro s t x y hxy
    apply hcausal t
    intro i
    change disjointCliqueEdgeEquiv (s _,x _) = disjointCliqueEdgeEquiv (s _,y _)
    rw [hxy i]
  have hp := iid_cliques_lower_probability (J := J) (N := Fintype.card U)
    Fintype.card_pos hNL f (fun edge : (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet => edge.val)
    encode (fun _ _ _ => rfl) hL Q (fun s x v => hi (e (s,x)) v) hreq hcaus
  let A := univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R h
  have hfailure : productLowerFailure Q h = univ.filter (fun p => e p ∈ A) := by
    ext p
    simp [productLowerFailure,A,integerDiscrepancyEvent,Q,T]
  rw [hfailure,uniformProb_equiv_preimage] at hp
  have hcard : Fintype.card (⊤ : SimpleGraph U).edgeSet = (Fintype.card U).choose 2 := by
    simpa only [SimpleGraph.edgeFinset_card] using
      (SimpleGraph.card_edgeFinset_top_eq_card_choose_two (V := U))
  simpa only [hcard] using hp

end Carpooling

Carpooling.regular_edge_balance.source:
lemma regular_edge_balance (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj]
    {Δ : ℕ} (hreg : G.IsRegularOfDegree Δ) :
    2 * Fintype.card G.edgeSet = Fintype.card V * Δ := by
  calc
    2 * Fintype.card G.edgeSet = ∑ v, G.degree v := by
      simpa only [G.edgeFinset_card] using G.sum_degrees_eq_twice_card_edges.symm
    _ = Fintype.card V * Δ := by
      calc
        (∑ v, G.degree v) = ∑ _v : V, Δ := sum_congr rfl (fun v _ => hreg v)
        _ = _ := by simp

/-- Basic stochastic upper bound on an actual regular simple graph, including repeated sampling.
No component, witness-cover, or probability estimate is a hypothesis. -/

Carpooling.regular_graph_stochastic_basi.source:
theorem regular_graph_stochastic_basic (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty G.edgeSet]
    {Δ : ℕ} (hreg : G.IsRegularOfDegree Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 16*T ≤ Fintype.card V) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card V) :
    uniformProb (badDiscrepancyEvent (fun v => G.neighborFinset v) (fun e : G.edgeSet => e.val) T
      (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))) ≤ 1 / (Fintype.card V : ℝ) := by
  apply stochastic_basic_high_probability (fun v => G.neighborFinset v)
    (fun v => by rw [G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hreg v]) hpos
    (fun {u v} hv => by simpa only [G.mem_neighborFinset] using G.symm ((G.mem_neighborFinset u v).mp hv))
    (fun e : G.edgeSet => e.val) Subtype.val_injective (regular_edge_balance G hreg) T hT hn

/-- Batched form for a linear total number of requests. The failure bound is K/n,
and the global discrepancy bound supplied by `aggregate_bound_outside_bad_event`
is `4*K*(clog 2 (2*n^2))^(1/3)`. -/

Carpooling.regular_graph_stochastic_batc.source:
theorem regular_graph_stochastic_batched (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty G.edgeSet]
    {Δ : ℕ} (hreg : G.IsRegularOfDegree Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (K B : ℕ) (hB : 16*B ≤ Fintype.card V) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card V) :
    uniformProb (badBatchEvent (fun v => G.neighborFinset v) (fun e : G.edgeSet => e.val) K B
      (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))) ≤ (K : ℝ) / Fintype.card V := by
  apply stochastic_batched_high_probability (fun v => G.neighborFinset v)
    (fun v => by rw [G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree, hreg v]) hpos
    (fun {u v} hv => by simpa only [G.mem_neighborFinset] using G.symm ((G.mem_neighborFinset u v).mp hv))
    (fun e : G.edgeSet => e.val) Subtype.val_injective (regular_edge_balance G hreg) K B hB hn

/-- Semantic reading of the bad-discrepancy event. Its complement certifies every prefix
for every compatible weighted Greedy run, uniformly over all weight assignments. -/

Carpooling.bound_outside_bad_discrepancy.source:
theorem bound_outside_bad_discrepancy {E : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]
    {T L : ℕ} (N : V → Finset V) (g : E → Sym2 V) (x : Fin T → E)
    (hx : x ∉ badDiscrepancyEvent N g T L) (R : Run V T)
    (hi : ∀ k, R.d 0 k = 0)
    (hAdj : ∀ s (hs : s < T), (R.step s hs).v ∈ N (R.step s hs).u)
    (hbag : R.edgeBag T = sampleBag g x) {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T) (k : V) :
    |R.d t k| ≤ 4*(L : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) := by
  by_contra hn
  apply hx
  exact mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _, R, hi, hAdj, hbag, t, ht, k, lt_of_not_ge hn⟩

/-- Refined degree-dependent stochastic bound on a regular simple graph.
The integer-log formulation fixes all constants and finite-size cutoffs. -/

Carpooling.regular_graph_stochastic_refi.source:
theorem regular_graph_stochastic_refined (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty G.edgeSet]
    {Δ : ℕ} (hreg : G.IsRegularOfDegree Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 16*T ≤ Fintype.card V) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hlarge : 256 ≤ Δ) (hdegree : (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))^3 ≤ Δ) :
    uniformProb (badRefinedEvent (fun v => G.neighborFinset v) (fun e : G.edgeSet => e.val) T
      (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V)) (refinedThreshold (Fintype.card V) Δ)) ≤
      3/(Fintype.card V:ℝ) := by
  exact stochastic_refined_high_probability (fun v => G.neighborFinset v)
    (fun v => by rw [G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree,hreg v]) hpos
    (fun {u v} hv => by simpa only [G.mem_neighborFinset] using G.symm ((G.mem_neighborFinset u v).mp hv))
    (fun e : G.edgeSet => e.val) Subtype.val_injective (regular_edge_balance G hreg) T hT hn hlarge hdegree

/-- Refined form for K batches, hence a linear total number of arrivals.
The failure probability is at most 3K/n. -/

theorem regular_graph_stochastic_refined_batched (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty G.edgeSet]
    {Δ : ℕ} (hreg : G.IsRegularOfDegree Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (K B : ℕ) (hB : 16*B ≤ Fintype.card V) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hlarge : 256 ≤ Δ) (hdegree : (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))^3 ≤ Δ) :
    uniformProb (badRefinedBatchEvent (fun v => G.neighborFinset v) (fun e : G.edgeSet => e.val) K B
      (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V)) (refinedThreshold (Fintype.card V) Δ)) ≤
      3*K/(Fintype.card V:ℝ) := by
  exact stochastic_refined_batched_probability (fun v => G.neighborFinset v)
    (fun v => by rw [G.card_neighborFinset_eq_degree,hreg v]) hpos
    (fun {u v} hv => by simpa only [G.mem_neighborFinset] using G.symm ((G.mem_neighborFinset u v).mp hv))
    (fun e : G.edgeSet => e.val) Subtype.val_injective (regular_edge_balance G hreg) K B hB hn hlarge hdegree

end Carpooling

Carpooling.Request.source:
structure Request (V : Type*) where
  a : V
  b : V
  distinct : a ≠ b
  weight : ℝ
  nonneg : 0 ≤ weight
  le_one : weight ≤ 1

Carpooling.Request.apply.source:
noncomputable def Request.apply (q : Request V) (x : V → ℝ) : V → ℝ :=
  if x q.a ≤ x q.b then
    fun k => x k + (if k = q.a then q.weight else 0) - (if k = q.b then q.weight else 0)
  else
    fun k => x k + (if k = q.b then q.weight else 0) - (if k = q.a then q.weight else 0)

Carpooling.Request.move.source:
noncomputable def Request.move (q : Request V) (x : V → ℝ) : Move x (q.apply x) := by
  by_cases h : x q.a ≤ x q.b
  · exact ⟨q.a, q.b, q.distinct, q.weight, q.nonneg, q.le_one, h,
      by intro k; simp [Request.apply, h]⟩
  · exact ⟨q.b, q.a, Ne.symm q.distinct, q.weight, q.nonneg, q.le_one,
      le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge h), by intro k; simp [Request.apply, h]⟩

Carpooling.states.source:
noncomputable def states (requests : ℕ → Request V) : ℕ → V → ℝ
  | 0 => fun _ => 0
  | t+1 => (requests t).apply (states requests t)

Carpooling.runRequests.source:
noncomputable def runRequests (requests : ℕ → Request V) (T : ℕ) : Run V T where
  d := states requests
  step := fun t _ => (requests t).move (states requests t)

/-- An end-to-end statement about the actual Greedy recurrence. -/

Carpooling.greedy_requests_upper_bound.source:
theorem greedy_requests_upper_bound (requests : ℕ → Request V) (t : ℕ) (i : V) :
    |states requests t i| ≤ min (4 * (t : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3)) (Fintype.card V) :=
  theorem_1_1 (runRequests requests t) (fun _ => rfl) (le_refl t) i

end Carpooling

Carpooling.cliqueTimes.source:
noncomputable def cliqueTimes {T : ℕ} (schedule : Fin T → J) (cut : J → ℕ)
    (j : J) : Finset (Fin T) := univ.filter fun t => schedule t = j ∧ t.val < cut j

Carpooling.UnitMove.other_component_unch.source:
lemma UnitMove.other_component_unchanged {x y : J × U → ℤ} (e : UnitMove x y)
    (edge : Sym2 U) (c j : J) (hne : c ≠ j)
    (hedge : s(e.u,e.v) = edge.map (fun u => (c,u))) (u : U) : y (j,u) = x (j,u) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨a,b⟩,he⟩ := Sym2.mk_surjective edge
  rw [←he,Sym2.map_pair_eq] at hedge
  rcases Sym2.eq_iff.mp hedge with ⟨hu,hv⟩ | ⟨hu,hv⟩
  · rw [e.update]
    simp [hu,hv,Ne.symm hne]
  · rw [e.update]
    simp [hu,hv,Ne.symm hne]

Carpooling.targetTimes.source:
noncomputable def targetTimes {K : Type*} {T : ℕ} (schedule : Fin T → J)
    (target : K ↪ J) (cut : K → ℕ) (k : K) : Finset (Fin T) :=
  univ.filter fun t => schedule t = target k ∧ t.val < cut k

variable {K : Type*} [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]

/-- Conditioned on any schedule with at least L arrivals in each of K cliques,
the chance of missing discrepancy h everywhere is at most |E|^L/K. Cuts
select exactly the first L local requests. Later requests may still be present
in the global run and influence the algorithm's other decisions. -/

Carpooling.scheduled_targets_lower_proba.source:
theorem scheduled_targets_lower_probability {T L h : ℕ}
    (hK : 0 < Fintype.card K) (target : K ↪ J) (f : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ U)
    (g : E → Sym2 U) (encode : (a b : Fin (2*h+2)) → a ≠ b → E)
    (hencode : ∀ a b hab, g (encode a b hab) = s(f a,f b))
    (schedule : Fin T → J) (cut : K → ℕ) (hcut : ∀ j, cut j ≤ T)
    (hsize : ∀ j, (targetTimes schedule target cut j).card = L)
    (hL : ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(L:ℤ))
    (R : (Fin T → E) → IntegerRun (J × U) T)
    (hi : ∀ x v, (R x).d 0 v = 0)
    (hrequest : ∀ x (t : Fin T),
      s(((R x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((R x).step t.val t.isLt).v) =
        (g (x t)).map (fun u => (schedule t,u)))
    (hcausal : ∀ (t : Fin T) (x y : Fin T → E),
      (∀ s : Fin t.val, x ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (R x).d t.val = (R y).d t.val) :
    uniformProb (univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R h) ≤
      (Fintype.card E:ℝ)^L/(Fintype.card K:ℝ) := by
  classical
  let I := targetTimes schedule target cut
  let P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E := fun t z =>
    let pos := fun i => (R (extendSamplePrefix t z)).d t.val (schedule t,f i)
    encode (lowerPair h pos).1 (lowerPair h pos).2 (lowerPair_distinct h pos)
  have hforce : ∀ j, selectedMatchingEvent (I j) P ⊆ integerDiscrepancyEvent R h := by
    intro j x hx
    have hm := (mem_filter.mp hx).2
    let d : ℕ → Fin (2*h+2) → ℤ := fun t i => (R x).d (min t (cut j)) (target j,f i)
    have hchange : ∀ t : Fin T, (∀ i, |d t.val i| < (h:ℤ)) →
        integerPotential (d (t.val+1))-integerPotential (d t.val) = if t ∈ I j then 2 else 0 := by
      intro t hb
      by_cases hbefore : t.val < cut j
      · have hmin : min t.val (cut j) = t.val := min_eq_left (le_of_lt hbefore)
        have hmin' : min (t.val+1) (cut j) = t.val+1 := min_eq_left (by omega)
        simp only [d,hmin] at hb
        simp only [d,hmin,hmin']
        by_cases hj : schedule t = target j
        · have htI : t ∈ I j := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,hj,hbefore⟩
          rw [if_pos htI]
          let z : Fin t.val → E := fun s => x ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩
          have hstate : (R (extendSamplePrefix t z)).d t.val = (R x).d t.val := by
            apply hcausal t
            intro s
            simp [extendSamplePrefix,z,s.isLt]
          have hedge : s(((R x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((R x).step t.val t.isLt).v) =
              s((target j,f (lowerPair h (fun i => (R x).d t.val (target j,f i))).1),
                (target j,f (lowerPair h (fun i => (R x).d t.val (target j,f i))).2)) := by
            rw [hrequest x t,hm t htI]
            change (g (encode _ _ _)).map _ = _
            rw [hencode,Sym2.map_pair_eq]
            change s((schedule t,f (lowerPair h (fun i =>
              (R (extendSamplePrefix t z)).d t.val (schedule t,f i))).1),
              (schedule t,f (lowerPair h (fun i =>
              (R (extendSamplePrefix t z)).d t.val (schedule t,f i))).2)) = _
            rw [hstate,hj]
          let fj : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ J × U := {
            toFun := fun i => (target j,f i)
            inj' := fun a b he => f.injective (congrArg Prod.snd he) }
          exact ((R x).step t.val t.isLt).embedded_potential_change fj _ _ hedge
            (lowerPair_equal h (fun i => (R x).d t.val (target j,f i)) hb)
        · have htI : t ∉ I j := by simp [I,targetTimes,hj]
          rw [if_neg htI]
          have hidle : (fun i => (R x).d (t.val+1) (target j,f i)) =
              (fun i => (R x).d t.val (target j,f i)) := by
            funext i
            exact ((R x).step t.val t.isLt).other_component_unchanged
              (g (x t)) (schedule t) (target j) hj (hrequest x t) (f i)
          rw [hidle,sub_self]
      · have hmin : min t.val (cut j) = cut j := min_eq_right (by omega)
        have hmin' : min (t.val+1) (cut j) = cut j := min_eq_right (by omega)
        have htI : t ∉ I j := by simp [I,targetTimes,hbefore]
        simp [d,hmin,hmin',htI]
    obtain ⟨t,ht,i,hlarge⟩ := charged_potential_lower_bound d (I j)
      (fun i => by simp [d,hi]) hchange (by simpa [I,hsize] using hL)
    simp only [integerDiscrepancyEvent,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and]
    exact ⟨min t (cut j),(min_le_left _ _).trans ht,(target j,f i),hlarge⟩
  have hdisjoint : ∀ j k, j ≠ k → Disjoint (I j) (I k) := by
    intro j k hjk
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro t htj htk
    exact hjk (target.injective ((mem_filter.mp htj).2.1.symm.trans (mem_filter.mp htk).2.1))
  have hb := adaptive_prescription_amplification I hK hdisjoint hsize P
  apply le_trans _ hb
  apply uniformProb_mono
  intro x hx
  apply mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨mem_univ _,?_⟩
  intro j hj
  exact (mem_sdiff.mp hx).2 (hforce j hj)


/-- Specialization targeting every clique in the schedule. -/

Carpooling.scheduled_cliques_lower_proba.source:
theorem scheduled_cliques_lower_probability {T L h : ℕ}
    (hJ : 0 < Fintype.card J) (f : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ U)
    (g : E → Sym2 U) (encode : (a b : Fin (2*h+2)) → a ≠ b → E)
    (hencode : ∀ a b hab, g (encode a b hab) = s(f a,f b))
    (schedule : Fin T → J) (cut : J → ℕ) (hcut : ∀ j, cut j ≤ T)
    (hsize : ∀ j, (cliqueTimes schedule cut j).card = L)
    (hL : ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(L:ℤ))
    (R : (Fin T → E) → IntegerRun (J × U) T)
    (hi : ∀ x v, (R x).d 0 v = 0)
    (hrequest : ∀ x (t : Fin T),
      s(((R x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((R x).step t.val t.isLt).v) =
        (g (x t)).map (fun u => (schedule t,u)))
    (hcausal : ∀ (t : Fin T) (x y : Fin T → E),
      (∀ s : Fin t.val, x ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (R x).d t.val = (R y).d t.val) :
    uniformProb (univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R h) ≤
      (Fintype.card E:ℝ)^L/(Fintype.card J:ℝ) := by
  apply scheduled_targets_lower_probability hJ (Function.Embedding.refl J) f g encode hencode
    schedule cut hcut _ hL R hi hrequest hcausal
  intro j
  simpa only [targetTimes,cliqueTimes,Function.Embedding.refl_apply] using hsize j

/-- A version requiring only local arrival counts; all first-L cutoffs are
constructed, and no forcing-event or probability estimate is a hypothesis. -/

Carpooling.scheduled_targets_lower_proba.source:
theorem scheduled_targets_lower_probability_of_counts {T L h : ℕ}
    (hK : 0 < Fintype.card K) (target : K ↪ J) (f : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ U)
    (g : E → Sym2 U) (encode : (a b : Fin (2*h+2)) → a ≠ b → E)
    (hencode : ∀ a b hab, g (encode a b hab) = s(f a,f b))
    (schedule : Fin T → J)
    (hcount : ∀ k, L ≤ (univ.filter fun t => schedule t = target k).card)
    (hL : ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(L:ℤ))
    (R : (Fin T → E) → IntegerRun (J × U) T)
    (hi : ∀ x v, (R x).d 0 v = 0)
    (hrequest : ∀ x (t : Fin T),
      s(((R x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((R x).step t.val t.isLt).v) =
        (g (x t)).map (fun u => (schedule t,u)))
    (hcausal : ∀ (t : Fin T) (x y : Fin T → E),
      (∀ s : Fin t.val, x ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (R x).d t.val = (R y).d t.val) :
    uniformProb (univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R h) ≤
      (Fintype.card E:ℝ)^L/(Fintype.card K:ℝ) := by
  have hex : ∀ k, ∃ c ≤ T,
      ((univ.filter fun t => schedule t = target k).filter fun t => t.val < c).card = L :=
    fun k => exists_prefix_cut _ (hcount k)
  let cut : K → ℕ := fun k => (hex k).choose
  apply scheduled_targets_lower_probability hK target f g encode hencode schedule cut
    (fun k => (hex k).choose_spec.1) _ hL R hi hrequest hcausal
  intro k
  have hset : targetTimes schedule target cut k =
      ((univ.filter fun t => schedule t = target k).filter fun t => t.val < cut k) := by
    ext t
    simp [targetTimes]
  rw [hset]
  exact (hex k).choose_spec.2

end Carpooling

Carpooling.threshold_crossing.source:
theorem threshold_crossing {S : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ} {T m : ℕ} {D : ℝ}
    (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmD : (m : ℝ) ≤ D)
    (hzero : ∀ t, S t 0 = 0)
    (hinit : ∀ r, S 0 r ≤ 0)
    (hstep : ∀ t < T, ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → r < m → S t r < S (t+1) r →
      2 * S (t+1) r - S (t+1) (r-1) - 2 ≤ S t (r+1))
    (hend : D ≤ S T 1) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, threshold D m ≤ S t m := by
  by_contra hn
  have hnever : ∀ t ≤ T, S t m < threshold D m := by
    intro t ht
    exact lt_of_not_ge fun h => hn ⟨t, ht, h⟩
  have hinv : ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ r, 1 ≤ r → r ≤ m → S t r < threshold D r := by
    intro t
    induction t with
    | zero =>
      intro ht r hr hrm
      have hrpos : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
      have hrD : (r : ℝ) ≤ D := le_trans (by exact_mod_cast hrm) hmD
      have hpos : 0 < threshold D r := by unfold threshold; nlinarith
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hinit r) hpos
    | succ t ih =>
      intro ht r
      induction r using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h r ihr =>
        intro hr hrm
        by_cases heq : r = m
        · subst r; exact hnever _ ht
        have hrlt : r < m := by omega
        by_contra hnlt
        have hcross : threshold D r ≤ S (t+1) r := le_of_not_gt hnlt
        have hold := ih (by omega) r hr hrm
        have hsmall : S (t+1) (r-1) ≤ threshold D (r-1) := by
          by_cases hone : r = 1
          · subst r; simp [hzero, threshold]
          · exact le_of_lt (ihr (r-1) (by omega) (by omega) (by omega))
        have hnext := hstep t (by omega) r hr hrlt (lt_of_lt_of_le hold hcross)
        have hprev := ih (by omega) (r+1) (by omega) (by omega)
        have hrsub : ((r-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (r : ℝ) - 1 := by
          rw [Nat.cast_sub hr]; norm_num
        have hrec : 2 * threshold D r - threshold D (r-1) - 2 =
            threshold D (r+1) := by
          unfold threshold
          rw [hrsub, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
          ring
        linarith
  have hlast := hinv T (le_refl T) 1 (le_refl 1) hm
  simp only [threshold, Nat.cast_one] at hlast
  linarith

variable {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]

/-- Lemma 3.3. A lower bound D on one chip suffices; D need not be the maximum. -/

Carpooling.spreadness.source:
theorem spreadness {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T)
    (hinit : ∀ k, R.d 0 k ≤ 0) {D : ℝ} {i : V}
    (hD : D ≤ R.d T i) {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hrn : r ≤ Fintype.card V) (hrD : (r : ℝ) ≤ D) :
    ∃ t ≤ T, (r : ℝ) * (D - r + 1) ≤ topSum (R.d t) r := by
  apply threshold_crossing (S := fun t r => topSum (R.d t) r) hr hrD
  · intro t; exact topSum_zero _
  · intro s; exact topSum_nonpos hinit s
  · intro t ht s hs hsr hinc
    exact topSum_step (R.step t ht) hs (lt_of_lt_of_le hsr hrn) hinc
  · exact le_trans hD (le_topSum_one _ i)

end Carpooling

Carpooling.bagEnumeration.source: noncomputable def bagEnumeration (m : Multiset A) : Fin m.toList.length → A := m.toList.get

Carpooling.bagEnumeration_bag.source:
lemma bagEnumeration_bag (m : Multiset A) :
    (univ : Finset (Fin m.toList.length)).val.map (bagEnumeration m) = m := by
  simp [-Multiset.length_toList, bagEnumeration, List.ofFn_getElem]

Carpooling.sampleBag.source:
noncomputable def sampleBag {T : ℕ} (g : E → A) (x : Fin T → E) : Multiset A :=
  (univ : Finset (Fin T)).val.map (fun i => g (x i))

Carpooling.sampleBag_card.source:
@[simp] lemma sampleBag_card {T : ℕ} (g : E → A) (x : Fin T → E) : (sampleBag g x).card = T := by
  simp [sampleBag]

Carpooling.bagOccurrenceEvent.source:
noncomputable def bagOccurrenceEvent {T : ℕ} (g : E → A) (m : Multiset A) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  mappedOccurrenceEvent g (bagEnumeration m)

Carpooling.bag_occurrence_probability.source:
lemma bag_occurrence_probability {T : ℕ} (g : E → A) (hg : Function.Injective g) (m : Multiset A) :
    uniformProb (bagOccurrenceEvent (T := T) g m) ≤ ((T : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^m.card := by
  simpa [bagOccurrenceEvent, Multiset.length_toList] using
    mapped_occurrence_probability_bound (T := T) g hg (bagEnumeration m)

Carpooling.mem_bagOccurrence.source:
lemma mem_bagOccurrence {T : ℕ} (g : E → A) (m : Multiset A) (x : Fin T → E)
    (h : m ≤ sampleBag g x) : x ∈ bagOccurrenceEvent g m := by
  apply mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨mem_univ _, ?_⟩
  apply embedding_of_bag_le (bagEnumeration m) (fun i => g (x i))
  rwa [bagEnumeration_bag]

end Bags

Carpooling.Witness.decorate_nodes.source:
lemma Witness.decorate_nodes {N : V → Finset V} {root : V} {S : Tree Unit} {F : Tree V}
    (h : F ∈ Witness.decorate N root S) : F.numNodes = S.numNodes := by
  induction S generalizing root F with
  | nil => have : F = .nil := mem_singleton.mp h; subst F; rfl
  | node a L R ihL ihR =>
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hF⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp h
    obtain ⟨⟨X,Y⟩, hXY, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hF
    simp only [mem_product] at hXY
    simp only [Tree.numNodes, ihL hXY.1, ihR hXY.2]

Carpooling.Witness.families_nodes.source:
lemma Witness.families_nodes {N : V → Finset V} {r : ℕ} {w : V × Tree V}
    (h : w ∈ Witness.families N r) : w.2.numNodes = r := by
  obtain ⟨root, _, hw⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp h
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hw⟩ := mem_biUnion.mp hw
  obtain ⟨F, hF, rfl⟩ := mem_image.mp hw
  exact (Witness.decorate_nodes hF).trans (Tree.mem_treesOfNumNodesEq.mp hS)

section Probability
variable {E : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]

Carpooling.witnessEvent.source:
noncomputable def witnessEvent (N : V → Finset V) (g : E → Sym2 V) (T r : ℕ) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  (Witness.families N r).biUnion fun w => bagOccurrenceEvent g (Witness.edges w.1 w.2)

/-- Equations (6) and (7) combined, without assuming the witness encoding. -/

Carpooling.witness_event_probability.source:
theorem witness_event_probability (N : V → Finset V) {Δ : ℕ}
    (hΔ : ∀ v, (N v).card ≤ Δ) (g : E → Sym2 V) (hg : Function.Injective g) (T r : ℕ) :
    uniformProb (witnessEvent N g T r) ≤
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * (4 * Δ * T / Fintype.card E)^r := by
  have hu := uniformProb_biUnion_le (Witness.families N r)
    (fun w => bagOccurrenceEvent (T := T) g (Witness.edges w.1 w.2))
  have hs : (∑ w ∈ Witness.families N r,
      uniformProb (bagOccurrenceEvent (T := T) g (Witness.edges w.1 w.2))) ≤
      (Witness.families N r).card * ((T : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^r := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ w ∈ Witness.families N r, ((T : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^r := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro w hw
        simpa only [Witness.edges_card, Witness.families_nodes hw] using bag_occurrence_probability (T := T) g hg (Witness.edges w.1 w.2)
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hc : ((Witness.families N r).card : ℝ) ≤ (4 : ℝ)^r * Fintype.card V * (Δ : ℝ)^r := by
    exact_mod_cast Witness.families_card_bound N hΔ r
  calc
    uniformProb (witnessEvent N g T r) ≤ (Witness.families N r).card * ((T : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^r := hu.trans hs
    _ ≤ ((4 : ℝ)^r * Fintype.card V * (Δ : ℝ)^r) * ((T : ℝ) / Fintype.card E)^r :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (by positivity)
    _ = (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * (4 * Δ * T / Fintype.card E)^r := by
      simp only [div_pow, mul_pow]
      ring

/-- Large-component event quantified over all legal weighted Greedy runs with the sampled bag.
The request order and all weights may be selected after the edge samples are known. -/

Carpooling.badComponentEvent.source:
noncomputable def badComponentEvent (N : V → Finset V) (g : E → Sym2 V) (T L : ℕ) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  univ.filter fun x => ∃ R : Run V T,
    (∀ s (hs : s < T), (R.step s hs).v ∈ N (R.step s hs).u) ∧
    R.edgeBag T = sampleBag g x ∧
    ∃ k, L ≤ (selected ((R.clusters T).block k) (R.edgeBag T)).card

Carpooling.bad_component_cover.source:
lemma bad_component_cover (N : V → Finset V)
    (hsymm : ∀ {u v}, v ∈ N u → u ∈ N v) (g : E → Sym2 V) (T L : ℕ) :
    badComponentEvent N g T L ⊆ (Ico L (T+1)).biUnion fun r => witnessEvent N g T r := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨R, hAdj, hbag, k, hL⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hx).2
  obtain ⟨F, hF, he, hv⟩ := R.component_witness (fun u v => v ∈ N u) hsymm hAdj (le_refl T) k
  let r := F.numNodes
  have hle : Witness.edges k F ≤ sampleBag g x := by
    rw [he, ← hbag]
    exact Multiset.filter_le _ _
  have hrle : r ≤ T := by simpa [r] using Multiset.card_le_card hle
  have hLr : L ≤ r := by simpa [← he] using hL
  apply mem_biUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨r, mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hLr, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
  apply mem_biUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨(k,F), Witness.mem_families hF rfl, ?_⟩
  exact mem_bagOccurrence g (Witness.edges k F) x hle

/-- Explicit high-probability component estimate for a subcritical batch.
`hbalance` is the degree-sum identity for a regular undirected sampling graph. -/

Carpooling.stochastic_component_tail.source:
theorem stochastic_component_tail (N : V → Finset V) {Δ : ℕ}
    (hΔ : ∀ v, (N v).card ≤ Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (hsymm : ∀ {u v}, v ∈ N u → u ∈ N v)
    (g : E → Sym2 V) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (hbalance : 2 * Fintype.card E = Fintype.card V * Δ)
    (T L : ℕ) (hT : 16*T ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    uniformProb (badComponentEvent N g T L) ≤ 2 * Fintype.card V / (2 : ℝ)^L := by
  have hM : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card E := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hbal : (2 : ℝ)*Fintype.card E = Fintype.card V * (Δ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hbalance
  have hTr : (16 : ℝ)*T ≤ Fintype.card V := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hq : 4*(Δ : ℝ)*T / Fintype.card E ≤ (1:ℝ)/2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hM).mpr
    have hd : 0 ≤ (Δ : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hTr hd
    nlinarith
  have hu := (uniformProb_mono (bad_component_cover N hsymm g T L)).trans
    (uniformProb_biUnion_le (Ico L (T+1)) (fun r => witnessEvent N g T r))
  have hs : (∑ r ∈ Ico L (T+1), uniformProb (witnessEvent N g T r)) ≤
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ∑ r ∈ Ico L (T+1), ((1:ℝ)/2)^r := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_le_sum
    intro r hr
    exact (witness_event_probability N hΔ g hg T r).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hq r) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  have hg := geom_sum_Ico_le_of_lt_one (m := L) (n := T+1)
    (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/2) (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)/2 < 1)
  have hgeom : (∑ r ∈ Ico L (T+1), ((1:ℝ)/2)^r) ≤ 2 / (2:ℝ)^L := by
    convert hg using 1 <;> simp [div_pow] <;> ring
  exact (hu.trans hs).trans (by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgeom (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card V))
    convert hh using 1 <;> ring)

Carpooling.badDiscrepancyEvent.source:
noncomputable def badDiscrepancyEvent (N : V → Finset V) (g : E → Sym2 V) (T L : ℕ) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  univ.filter fun x => ∃ R : Run V T,
    (∀ k, R.d 0 k = 0) ∧
    (∀ s (hs : s < T), (R.step s hs).v ∈ N (R.step s hs).u) ∧
    R.edgeBag T = sampleBag g x ∧
    ∃ t ≤ T, ∃ k, 4*(L : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) < |R.d t k|

Carpooling.bad_discrepancy_subset.source:
lemma bad_discrepancy_subset (N : V → Finset V) (g : E → Sym2 V) (T L : ℕ) :
    badDiscrepancyEvent N g T L ⊆ badComponentEvent N g T L := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨R, hi, hAdj, hbag, t, ht, k, hbad⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hx).2
  apply mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨mem_univ _, R, hAdj, hbag, k, ?_⟩
  by_contra hn
  have hL : internalCount R ((R.clusters T).block k) T ≤ L := by
    rw [← R.selected_card _ (R.terminal_closed k) (le_refl T)]
    omega
  have hgood := component_bound_all_prefixes R hi _ (R.terminal_closed k) hL ht
    ((R.clusters T).self_mem k)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hgood) hbad

/-- The basic stochastic upper bound, with explicit finite-sample failure probability.
It simultaneously controls every prefix, every legal tie rule, and every weight assignment. -/

Carpooling.stochastic_upper_tail.source:
theorem stochastic_upper_tail (N : V → Finset V) {Δ : ℕ}
    (hΔ : ∀ v, (N v).card ≤ Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (hsymm : ∀ {u v}, v ∈ N u → u ∈ N v)
    (g : E → Sym2 V) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (hbalance : 2 * Fintype.card E = Fintype.card V * Δ)
    (T L : ℕ) (hT : 16*T ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    uniformProb (badDiscrepancyEvent N g T L) ≤ 2 * Fintype.card V / (2 : ℝ)^L :=
  (uniformProb_mono (bad_discrepancy_subset N g T L)).trans
    (stochastic_component_tail N hΔ hpos hsymm g hg hbalance T L hT)

Carpooling.stochasticThreshold.source:
noncomputable def stochasticThreshold (n : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.clog 2 (2*n^2)

/-- A concrete form of the cube-root logarithmic stochastic bound for a batch:
discrepancy at most `4 * (clog 2 (2*n^2))^(1/3)`, except with probability at most 1/n. -/

Carpooling.stochastic_basic_high_probabi.source:
theorem stochastic_basic_high_probability (N : V → Finset V) {Δ : ℕ}
    (hΔ : ∀ v, (N v).card ≤ Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (hsymm : ∀ {u v}, v ∈ N u → u ∈ N v)
    (g : E → Sym2 V) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (hbalance : 2 * Fintype.card E = Fintype.card V * Δ)
    (T : ℕ) (hT : 16*T ≤ Fintype.card V) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card V) :
    uniformProb (badDiscrepancyEvent N g T (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))) ≤
      1 / (Fintype.card V : ℝ) := by
  have ht := stochastic_upper_tail N hΔ hpos hsymm g hg hbalance T
    (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V)) hT
  have hpow := Nat.le_pow_clog (by decide : 1 < 2) (2*(Fintype.card V)^2)
  have hp : 2*(Fintype.card V : ℝ)^2 ≤ (2:ℝ)^(stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V)) := by
    exact_mod_cast hpow
  have hnR : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card V := by exact_mod_cast hn
  apply ht.trans
  apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hnR).mpr
  nlinarith

end Probability
end Carpooling

Carpooling.productLowerFailure.source:
noncomputable def productLowerFailure {T : ℕ}
    (R : (Fin T → J) → (Fin T → E) → IntegerRun (J × U) T) (h : ℕ) :
    Finset ((Fin T → J) × (Fin T → E)) :=
  univ.filter fun x => x.2 ∉ integerDiscrepancyEvent (R x.1) h

/-- For MN iid uniform requests from M disjoint cliques, every causal
unit-weight orientation algorithm reaches discrepancy h except with
probability at most 8/N + 2q^L/M, where q is the local edge alphabet size.
No local count, schedule, or probability estimate is assumed. -/

Carpooling.iid_cliques_lower_probability.source:
theorem iid_cliques_lower_probability {N L h : ℕ} (hN : 0 < N) (hNL : 2*L ≤ N)
    (f : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ U) (g : E → Sym2 U)
    (encode : (a b : Fin (2*h+2)) → a ≠ b → E)
    (hencode : ∀ a b hab, g (encode a b hab) = s(f a,f b))
    (hL : ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(L:ℤ))
    (R : (Fin (Fintype.card J*N) → J) → (Fin (Fintype.card J*N) → E) →
      IntegerRun (J × U) (Fintype.card J*N))
    (hi : ∀ s x v, (R s x).d 0 v = 0)
    (hrequest : ∀ s x (t : Fin (Fintype.card J*N)),
      s(((R s x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((R s x).step t.val t.isLt).v) =
        (g (x t)).map (fun u => (s t,u)))
    (hcausal : ∀ s (t : Fin (Fintype.card J*N)) (x y : Fin (Fintype.card J*N) → E),
      (∀ i : Fin t.val, x ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (R s x).d t.val = (R s y).d t.val) :
    uniformProb (productLowerFailure R h) ≤
      8/(N:ℝ)+2*(Fintype.card E:ℝ)^L/(Fintype.card J:ℝ) := by
  classical
  let a : ℝ := 2*(Fintype.card E:ℝ)^L/(Fintype.card J:ℝ)
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
  have hgood : ∀ s, s ∉ fewGoodLabelsEvent (J := J) N L →
      uniformProb (eventFiber (productLowerFailure R h) s) ≤ a := by
    intro s hs
    let K := {j : J // j ∈ goodLabels s L}
    have hcard : Fintype.card J ≤ 2*Fintype.card K := by
      have he : Fintype.card K = (goodLabels s L).card := Fintype.card_coe _
      rw [he]
      simpa [fewGoodLabelsEvent] using hs
    have hK : 0 < Fintype.card K := by have := Fintype.card_pos (α := J); omega
    let target : K ↪ J := ⟨Subtype.val,Subtype.val_injective⟩
    have hcount : ∀ k : K, L ≤ (univ.filter fun t => s t = target k).card := by
      intro k
      exact (mem_filter.mp k.property).2
    have hb := scheduled_targets_lower_probability_of_counts hK target f g encode hencode
      s hcount hL (R s) (hi s) (hrequest s) (hcausal s)
    have hfiber : eventFiber (productLowerFailure R h) s =
        univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent (R s) h := by
      ext x
      simp [eventFiber,productLowerFailure]
    rw [hfiber]
    apply hb.trans
    have hMR : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card J := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
    have hKR : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card K := by exact_mod_cast hK
    have hcardR : (Fintype.card J:ℝ) ≤ 2*(Fintype.card K:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcard
    dsimp [a]
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hKR hMR).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card E)) L)
      (sub_nonneg.mpr hcardR)]
  have hb := uniformProb_mixture_bound (productLowerFailure R h) (fewGoodLabelsEvent N L) ha hgood
  have ho := few_good_labels_probability (J := J) hN hNL
  exact hb.trans (add_le_add_right ho a)

end Carpooling

Carpooling.multiset_choose_card.source:
lemma multiset_choose_card {A : Type*} (S : Multiset A) {p : ℕ} (hp : p ≤ S.card) :
    ∃ Q : Multiset A, Q ≤ S ∧ Q.card = p := by
  induction p generalizing S with
  | zero => exact ⟨0,zero_le _,rfl⟩
  | succ p ih =>
    have hne : S ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hp
    obtain ⟨a,ha⟩ := Multiset.exists_mem_of_ne_zero hne
    obtain ⟨W,rfl⟩ := Multiset.exists_cons_of_mem ha
    obtain ⟨Q,hQ,hcard⟩ := ih W (by simpa using hp)
    exact ⟨a ::ₘ Q, Multiset.cons_le_cons a hQ, by simp [hcard]⟩

section Samples
variable {E : Type*} [Fintype E] [DecidableEq E] [Nonempty E]

/-- The refined witness cover is constructed, not supplied as an assumption. -/

Carpooling.refined_cover_of_forest.source:
theorem refined_cover_of_forest {N : V → Finset V} {g : E → Sym2 V} {T p : ℕ}
    (x : Fin T → E) {root : V} {F : Tree V}
    (hF : Witness.Valid (fun u v => v ∈ N u) root F)
    (hbag : Witness.edges root F ≤ sampleBag g x)
    (hp : p ≤ F.numNodes - ((Witness.vertices root F).card-1)) :
    x ∈ refinedWitnessEvent N g T (Witness.vertices root F).card p := by
  let m := (Witness.vertices root F).card
  obtain ⟨G,hG,hcore,hverts,hnum⟩ := Witness.spanning hF
  have hnodes : G.numNodes = m-1 := by omega
  obtain ⟨W,hW⟩ := Multiset.le_iff_exists_add.mp hcore
  have hcard := congrArg Multiset.card hW
  simp only [Multiset.card_add,Witness.edges_card] at hcard
  have hpW : p ≤ W.card := by omega
  obtain ⟨Q,hQ,hQcard⟩ := multiset_choose_card W hpW
  have hQF : Q ≤ Witness.edges root F := by
    rw [hW]
    exact hQ.trans (Multiset.le_add_left _ _)
  have hsupport : ∀ e ∈ Q, ∀ v ∈ e, v ∈ Witness.vertices root G := by
    intro e he v hv
    rw [hverts]
    exact Witness.edges_support (Multiset.mem_of_le hQF he) hv
  obtain ⟨code,hcode⟩ := Witness.encode_extras (show G.numNodes+1=m from hnum) Q hQcard hsupport
  apply mem_biUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨((root,G),code), mem_product.mpr ⟨Witness.mem_families hG hnodes,mem_univ _⟩, ?_⟩
  apply mem_bagOccurrence
  change Witness.edges root G + Witness.extraBag root G code ≤ sampleBag g x
  rw [hcode]
  apply le_trans _ hbag
  rw [hW]
  exact add_le_add_left hQ _

Carpooling.badRefinedEvent.source:
noncomputable def badRefinedEvent (N : V → Finset V) (g : E → Sym2 V) (T L p : ℕ) : Finset (Fin T → E) :=
  univ.filter fun x => ∃ t ≤ T, ∃ R : Run V t,
    (∀ k, R.d 0 k = 0) ∧
    (∀ s (hs : s < t), (R.step s hs).v ∈ N (R.step s hs).u) ∧
    R.edgeBag t ≤ sampleBag g x ∧
    ∃ k, 4*(p : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) + 2*(Nat.log 2 L : ℝ) < |R.d t k|

Carpooling.refined_bad_event_cover.source:
theorem refined_bad_event_cover (N : V → Finset V)
    (hsymm : ∀ {u v}, v ∈ N u → u ∈ N v) (g : E → Sym2 V) (T L p : ℕ) :
    badRefinedEvent N g T L p ⊆
      ((Ico L (T+1)).biUnion fun r => witnessEvent N g T r) ∪
      ((Ico 1 (L+1)).biUnion fun m => refinedWitnessEvent N g T m p) := by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨t,ht,R,hi,hAdj,hbag,k,hbad⟩ := (mem_filter.mp hx).2
  obtain ⟨F,hF,he,hv⟩ := R.component_witness (fun u v => v ∈ N u) hsymm hAdj (le_refl t) k
  have hFbag : Witness.edges k F ≤ sampleBag g x := by
    rw [he]
    exact (Multiset.filter_le _ _).trans hbag
  have hrT : F.numNodes ≤ T := by simpa using Multiset.card_le_card hFbag
  by_cases hlarge : L ≤ F.numNodes
  · apply mem_union_left
    apply mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨F.numNodes,mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hlarge,by omega⟩,?_⟩
    apply mem_biUnion.mpr
    exact ⟨(k,F),Witness.mem_families hF rfl,mem_bagOccurrence g _ x hFbag⟩
  · let m := (Witness.vertices k F).card
    obtain ⟨G,hG,hcore,hvG,hnum⟩ := Witness.spanning hF
    have hGle : G.numNodes ≤ F.numNodes := by simpa using Multiset.card_le_card hcore
    have hmpos : 1 ≤ m := by omega
    have hmL : m ≤ L := by omega
    have hcnt : internalCount R ((R.clusters t).block k) t = F.numNodes := by
      rw [← R.selected_card _ (R.terminal_closed k) (le_refl t),← he,Witness.edges_card]
    have hmcard : ((R.clusters t).block k).card = m := by rw [← hv]
    have hp : p ≤ F.numNodes - (m-1) := by
      by_contra hn
      have hple : F.numNodes - (m-1) ≤ p := by omega
      have hc : ((F.numNodes-(m-1) : ℕ) : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) ≤ (p : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) :=
        Real.rpow_le_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (by exact_mod_cast hple) (by norm_num)
      have hl : (Nat.log 2 m : ℝ) ≤ Nat.log 2 L := by exact_mod_cast Nat.log_mono_right hmL
      have hbound := local_tree_like_bound R hi k
      rw [hcnt,hmcard] at hbound
      linarith
    apply mem_union_right
    apply mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨m,mem_Ico.mpr ⟨hmpos,by omega⟩,?_⟩
    exact refined_cover_of_forest x hF hFbag hp

Carpooling.large_witness_tail.source:
theorem large_witness_tail (N : V → Finset V) {Δ : ℕ}
    (hΔ : ∀ v, (N v).card ≤ Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (hsymm : ∀ {u v}, v ∈ N u → u ∈ N v)
    (g : E → Sym2 V) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (hbalance : 2 * Fintype.card E = Fintype.card V * Δ)
    (T L : ℕ) (hT : 16*T ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    uniformProb ((Ico L (T+1)).biUnion fun r => witnessEvent N g T r) ≤ 2 * Fintype.card V / (2 : ℝ)^L := by
  have hM : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card E := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hbal : (2 : ℝ)*Fintype.card E = Fintype.card V * (Δ : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hbalance
  have hTr : (16 : ℝ)*T ≤ Fintype.card V := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hq : 4*(Δ : ℝ)*T / Fintype.card E ≤ (1:ℝ)/2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hM).mpr
    have hd : 0 ≤ (Δ : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hTr hd
    nlinarith
  have hu := uniformProb_biUnion_le (Ico L (T+1)) (fun r => witnessEvent N g T r)
  have hs : (∑ r ∈ Ico L (T+1), uniformProb (witnessEvent N g T r)) ≤
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ∑ r ∈ Ico L (T+1), ((1:ℝ)/2)^r := by
    rw [mul_sum]
    apply sum_le_sum
    intro r hr
    exact (witness_event_probability N hΔ g hg T r).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hq r) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  have hg := geom_sum_Ico_le_of_lt_one (m := L) (n := T+1)
    (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/2) (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)/2 < 1)
  have hgeom : (∑ r ∈ Ico L (T+1), ((1:ℝ)/2)^r) ≤ 2 / (2:ℝ)^L := by
    convert hg using 1 <;> simp [div_pow] <;> ring
  exact (hu.trans hs).trans (by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hgeom (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card V))
    convert hh using 1 <;> ring)

Carpooling.uniformProb_union_le.source:
lemma uniformProb_union_le {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] (A B : Finset Ω) :
    uniformProb (A ∪ B) ≤ uniformProb A + uniformProb B := by
  unfold uniformProb
  rw [← add_div]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast card_union_le A B) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

Carpooling.refined_witness_regular_bound.source:
theorem refined_witness_regular_bound (N : V → Finset V) {Δ : ℕ}
    (hΔ : ∀ v, (N v).card ≤ Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (g : E → Sym2 V) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (hbalance : 2 * Fintype.card E = Fintype.card V * Δ)
    (T m p : ℕ) (hT : 16*T ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    uniformProb (refinedWitnessEvent N g T m p) ≤
      (Fintype.card V : ℝ) * ((1:ℝ)/2)^(m-1) * ((m:ℝ)^2/(8*Δ))^p := by
  have hM : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card E := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < Δ := by exact_mod_cast hpos
  have hbal : (2:ℝ)*Fintype.card E = Fintype.card V * (Δ:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hbalance
  have hTr : (16:ℝ)*T ≤ Fintype.card V := by exact_mod_cast hT
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hTr hD.le
  have hq1 : 4*(Δ:ℝ)*T/Fintype.card E ≤ (1:ℝ)/2 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hM).mpr
    nlinarith
  have hq2 : (m:ℝ)^2*T/Fintype.card E ≤ (m:ℝ)^2/(8*Δ) := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hM (by positivity)).mpr
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (show 8*(Δ:ℝ)*T ≤ Fintype.card E by nlinarith) (sq_nonneg (m:ℝ))
    nlinarith
  have heq : ((4:ℝ)^(m-1)*Fintype.card V*(Δ:ℝ)^(m-1)*(m:ℝ)^(2*p))*
      ((T:ℝ)/Fintype.card E)^(m-1+p) =
      (Fintype.card V:ℝ)*(4*(Δ:ℝ)*T/Fintype.card E)^(m-1)*
        ((m:ℝ)^2*T/Fintype.card E)^p := by
    simp only [pow_add,mul_pow,div_pow,pow_mul]
    ring
  have hh := refined_witness_probability N hΔ g hg T m p
  rw [heq] at hh
  exact hh.trans (mul_le_mul
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hq1 (m-1)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hq2 p) (by positivity) (by positivity))

/-- Full finite-sample refined stochastic bound. Both the large-component failure
and the surplus-edge failure are explicit; no witness estimate is assumed. -/

Carpooling.stochastic_refined_tail.source:
theorem stochastic_refined_tail (N : V → Finset V) {Δ : ℕ}
    (hΔ : ∀ v, (N v).card ≤ Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (hsymm : ∀ {u v}, v ∈ N u → u ∈ N v)
    (g : E → Sym2 V) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (hbalance : 2 * Fintype.card E = Fintype.card V * Δ)
    (T L p : ℕ) (hT : 16*T ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    uniformProb (badRefinedEvent N g T L p) ≤
      2*Fintype.card V/(2:ℝ)^L + 2*Fintype.card V*((L:ℝ)^2/(8*Δ))^p := by
  have hc := (uniformProb_mono (refined_bad_event_cover N hsymm g T L p)).trans
    (uniformProb_union_le _ _)
  have hlarge := large_witness_tail N hΔ hpos hsymm g hg hbalance T L hT
  have hsmallU := uniformProb_biUnion_le (Ico 1 (L+1)) (fun m => refinedWitnessEvent N g T m p)
  have hsmall : (∑ m ∈ Ico 1 (L+1), uniformProb (refinedWitnessEvent N g T m p)) ≤
      2*Fintype.card V*((L:ℝ)^2/(8*Δ))^p := by
    have hD : (0:ℝ) < Δ := by exact_mod_cast hpos
    have hsum : (∑ m ∈ Ico 1 (L+1), ((1:ℝ)/2)^(m-1)) ≤ 2 := by
      rw [sum_Ico_eq_sum_range]
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.add_sub_cancel_left]
      have hh := geom_sum_Ico_le_of_lt_one (m := 0) (n := L)
        (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/2) (by norm_num : (1:ℝ)/2 < 1)
      norm_num at hh
      simpa only [Nat.Ico_zero_eq_range] using hh
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Ico 1 (L+1), (Fintype.card V:ℝ)*((1:ℝ)/2)^(m-1)*((L:ℝ)^2/(8*Δ))^p := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro m hm
        have hml : (m:ℝ) ≤ L := by exact_mod_cast (show m ≤ L by have := (mem_Ico.mp hm).2; omega)
        have hratio : (m:ℝ)^2/(8*Δ) ≤ (L:ℝ)^2/(8*Δ) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hml 2) (by positivity)
        exact (refined_witness_regular_bound N hΔ hpos g hg hbalance T m p hT).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hratio p) (by positivity))
      _ = (Fintype.card V:ℝ)*((L:ℝ)^2/(8*Δ))^p * ∑ m ∈ Ico 1 (L+1), ((1:ℝ)/2)^(m-1) := by
        rw [mul_sum]
        apply sum_congr rfl
        intro m _; ring
      _ ≤ (Fintype.card V:ℝ)*((L:ℝ)^2/(8*Δ))^p * 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  exact hc.trans (add_le_add hlarge (hsmallU.trans hsmall))

end Samples
end Carpooling

Carpooling.batchCutoff.source: def batchCutoff (B t : ℕ) (j : ℕ) : ℕ := min B (t - j*B)

Carpooling.batchCutoff_le.source: lemma batchCutoff_le (B t j : ℕ) : batchCutoff B t j ≤ B := min_le_left _ _

Carpooling.batchCutoff_before.source:
lemma batchCutoff_before {B t j : ℕ} (h : t ≤ j*B) : batchCutoff B t j = 0 := by
  simp [batchCutoff, Nat.sub_eq_zero_of_le h]

Carpooling.batchCutoff_after.source:
lemma batchCutoff_after {B t j : ℕ} (h : (j+1)*B ≤ t) : batchCutoff B t j = B := by
  unfold batchCutoff
  apply min_eq_left
  rw [Nat.add_mul] at h
  omega

/-- Actual total signed discrepancy of the locally restarted Greedy policy.
Only the first `batchCutoff B t j` requests of batch j affect this state. -/

Carpooling.batchedGreedyState.source:
noncomputable def batchedGreedyState {K : ℕ} (B : ℕ)
    (q : Fin K → ℕ → Request V) (t : ℕ) (v : V) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, states (q j) (batchCutoff B t j.val) v

omit [Fintype V] in
/-- Causality: no request at time t or later affects the state at time t. -/

Carpooling.states_prefix_congr.source:
lemma states_prefix_congr (q q' : ℕ → Request V) (t : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ s < t, q s = q' s) : states q t = states q' t := by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    simp only [states]
    rw [h t (Nat.lt_succ_self t), ih (fun s hs => h s (Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hs))]

omit [Fintype V] in

Carpooling.Request.move_adj.source:
lemma Request.move_adj (G : SimpleGraph V) (q : Request V) (x : V → ℝ)
    (h : G.Adj q.a q.b) : G.Adj (q.move x).u (q.move x).v := by
  by_cases hx : x q.a ≤ x q.b
  · simpa [Request.move, hx] using h
  · simpa [Request.move, hx] using G.symm h

Carpooling.uniformProb_compl.source:
lemma uniformProb_compl {Ω : Type*} [Fintype Ω] [DecidableEq Ω] [Nonempty Ω]
    (A : Finset Ω) : uniformProb (univ \ A) = 1 - uniformProb A := by
  have hcard : (0 : ℝ) < Fintype.card Ω := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
  have hle : A.card ≤ Fintype.card Ω := card_le_univ A
  simp only [uniformProb, card_sdiff, inter_univ, card_univ]
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hle, sub_div, div_self (ne_of_gt hcard)]

/-- Basic Theorem 1.2 with explicit constants. The same good event works
simultaneously for all legal runs and every global time. -/

Carpooling.theorem_1_2_basic.source:
theorem theorem_1_2_basic (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty G.edgeSet]
    {Δ : ℕ} (hreg : G.IsRegularOfDegree Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (K B : ℕ) (hB : 16*B ≤ Fintype.card V) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ good : Finset (Fin K → Fin B → G.edgeSet),
      1 - (K:ℝ)/(Fintype.card V:ℝ) ≤ uniformProb good ∧
      ∀ x ∈ good, ∀ R : Fin K → Run V B,
        (∀ j v, (R j).d 0 v = 0) →
        (∀ j s (hs : s < B), G.Adj ((R j).step s hs).u ((R j).step s hs).v) →
        (∀ j, (R j).edgeBag B = sampleBag (fun e : G.edgeSet => e.val) (x j)) →
        ∀ t v, |∑ j, (R j).d (batchCutoff B t j.val) v| ≤
          (K:ℝ)*(4*(stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V):ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3)) := by
  let bad := badBatchEvent (fun v => G.neighborFinset v) (fun e : G.edgeSet => e.val)
    K B (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))
  refine ⟨univ \ bad, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [uniformProb_compl bad]
    have h := regular_graph_stochastic_batched G hreg hpos K B hB hn
    change uniformProb bad ≤ _ at h
    linarith
  · intro x hx R hi hAdj hbag t v
    exact aggregate_bound_outside_bad_event _ _ x (mem_sdiff.mp hx).2 R hi
      (fun j s hs => (G.mem_neighborFinset _ _).mpr (hAdj j s hs)) hbag
      (fun j => batchCutoff B t j.val) (fun j => batchCutoff_le _ _ _) v

/-- Refined Theorem 1.2, with the logarithmic thresholds and all finite-size
conditions explicit. No component or witness estimate is assumed. -/

Carpooling.theorem_1_2_refined.source:
theorem theorem_1_2_refined (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty G.edgeSet]
    {Δ : ℕ} (hreg : G.IsRegularOfDegree Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (K B : ℕ) (hB : 16*B ≤ Fintype.card V) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hlarge : 256 ≤ Δ) (hdegree : (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))^3 ≤ Δ) :
    ∃ good : Finset (Fin K → Fin B → G.edgeSet),
      1 - 3*(K:ℝ)/(Fintype.card V:ℝ) ≤ uniformProb good ∧
      ∀ x ∈ good, ∀ R : Fin K → Run V B,
        (∀ j v, (R j).d 0 v = 0) →
        (∀ j s (hs : s < B), G.Adj ((R j).step s hs).u ((R j).step s hs).v) →
        (∀ j, (R j).edgeBag B = sampleBag (fun e : G.edgeSet => e.val) (x j)) →
        ∀ t v, |∑ j, (R j).d (batchCutoff B t j.val) v| ≤
          (K:ℝ)*(4*(refinedThreshold (Fintype.card V) Δ:ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) +
            2*(Nat.log 2 (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V)):ℝ)) := by
  let bad := badRefinedBatchEvent (fun v => G.neighborFinset v) (fun e : G.edgeSet => e.val)
    K B (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V)) (refinedThreshold (Fintype.card V) Δ)
  refine ⟨univ \ bad, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [uniformProb_compl bad]
    have h := regular_graph_stochastic_refined_batched G hreg hpos K B hB hn hlarge hdegree
    change uniformProb bad ≤ _ at h
    linarith
  · intro x hx R hi hAdj hbag t v
    exact refined_aggregate_bound _ _ x (mem_sdiff.mp hx).2 R hi
      (fun j s hs => (G.mem_neighborFinset _ _).mpr (hAdj j s hs)) hbag
      (fun j => batchCutoff B t j.val) (fun j => batchCutoff_le _ _ _) v

/-- The basic result for the actual recursive online policy. -/

Carpooling.theorem_1_2_basic_greedy.source:
theorem theorem_1_2_basic_greedy (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty G.edgeSet]
    {Δ : ℕ} (hreg : G.IsRegularOfDegree Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (K B : ℕ) (hB : 16*B ≤ Fintype.card V) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ good : Finset (Fin K → Fin B → G.edgeSet),
      1 - (K:ℝ)/(Fintype.card V:ℝ) ≤ uniformProb good ∧
      ∀ x ∈ good, ∀ q : Fin K → ℕ → Request V,
        (∀ j s, s < B → G.Adj (q j s).a (q j s).b) →
        (∀ j, (runRequests (q j) B).edgeBag B =
          sampleBag (fun e : G.edgeSet => e.val) (x j)) →
        ∀ t v, |batchedGreedyState B q t v| ≤
          (K:ℝ)*(4*(stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V):ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3)) := by
  obtain ⟨good, hp, hb⟩ := theorem_1_2_basic G hreg hpos K B hB hn
  refine ⟨good, hp, ?_⟩
  intro x hx q hAdj hbag t v
  exact hb x hx (fun j => runRequests (q j) B) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    (fun j s hs => (q j s).move_adj G _ (hAdj j s hs)) hbag t v

/-- The refined result for the actual recursive online policy, rather than
an abstract run. The bag equality only identifies the arrivals with the
sampled edges; no probabilistic or discrepancy premise is supplied. -/

Carpooling.theorem_1_2_refined_greedy.source:
theorem theorem_1_2_refined_greedy (G : SimpleGraph V)
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] [Nonempty G.edgeSet]
    {Δ : ℕ} (hreg : G.IsRegularOfDegree Δ) (hpos : 0 < Δ)
    (K B : ℕ) (hB : 16*B ≤ Fintype.card V) (hn : 0 < Fintype.card V)
    (hlarge : 256 ≤ Δ) (hdegree : (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V))^3 ≤ Δ) :
    ∃ good : Finset (Fin K → Fin B → G.edgeSet),
      1 - 3*(K:ℝ)/(Fintype.card V:ℝ) ≤ uniformProb good ∧
      ∀ x ∈ good, ∀ q : Fin K → ℕ → Request V,
        (∀ j s, s < B → G.Adj (q j s).a (q j s).b) →
        (∀ j, (runRequests (q j) B).edgeBag B =
          sampleBag (fun e : G.edgeSet => e.val) (x j)) →
        ∀ t v, |batchedGreedyState B q t v| ≤
          (K:ℝ)*(4*(refinedThreshold (Fintype.card V) Δ:ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) +
            2*(Nat.log 2 (stochasticThreshold (Fintype.card V)):ℝ)) := by
  obtain ⟨good, hp, hb⟩ := theorem_1_2_refined G hreg hpos K B hB hn hlarge hdegree
  refine ⟨good, hp, ?_⟩
  intro x hx q hAdj hbag t v
  exact hb x hx (fun j => runRequests (q j) B) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    (fun j s hs => (q j s).move_adj G _ (hAdj j s hs)) hbag t v

end Carpooling

Carpooling.exists_top_set.source:
lemma exists_top_set (x : V → ℝ) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    ∃ R : Finset V, R.card = r ∧
      ∀ Q : Finset V, Q.card = r → (∑ k ∈ Q, x k) ≤ ∑ k ∈ R, x k := by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hc⟩ := exists_subset_card_eq (s := (univ : Finset V)) (by simpa using hr)
  have hn : ((univ : Finset V).powersetCard r).Nonempty := ⟨Q, by simp [hc]⟩
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hm⟩ := exists_max_image ((univ : Finset V).powersetCard r)
    (fun R => ∑ k ∈ R, x k) hn
  exact ⟨R, (mem_powersetCard.mp hR).2, fun Q hc => hm Q (by simp [hc])⟩

Carpooling.topSet.source:
noncomputable def topSet (x : V → ℝ) (r : ℕ) : Finset V :=
  if h : r ≤ Fintype.card V then (exists_top_set x h).choose else ∅

Carpooling.topSum.source: noncomputable def topSum (x : V → ℝ) (r : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ topSet x r, x k

Carpooling.topSet_spec.source:
lemma topSet_spec (x : V → ℝ) {r : ℕ} (hr : r ≤ Fintype.card V) :
    (topSet x r).card = r ∧ ∀ Q : Finset V, Q.card = r →
      (∑ k ∈ Q, x k) ≤ topSum x r := by
  simp only [topSum, topSet, dif_pos hr]
  exact (exists_top_set x hr).choose_spec

Carpooling.sum_le_topSum.source:
lemma sum_le_topSum (x : V → ℝ) (Q : Finset V) :
    (∑ k ∈ Q, x k) ≤ topSum x Q.card :=
  (topSet_spec x (card_le_univ Q)).2 Q rfl

Carpooling.topSum_zero.source:
@[simp] lemma topSum_zero (x : V → ℝ) : topSum x 0 = 0 := by
  have h := (topSet_spec x (Nat.zero_le (Fintype.card V))).1
  have : topSet x 0 = ∅ := card_eq_zero.mp h
  simp [topSum, this]

Carpooling.topSum_nonpos.source:
lemma topSum_nonpos {x : V → ℝ} (hx : ∀ k, x k ≤ 0) (r : ℕ) :
    topSum x r ≤ 0 := sum_nonpos fun k _ => hx k

Carpooling.topSum_all.source:
lemma topSum_all (x : V → ℝ) : topSum x (Fintype.card V) = ∑ k, x k := by
  have h := (topSet_spec x (le_refl (Fintype.card V))).1
  have : topSet x (Fintype.card V) = univ := eq_univ_of_card _ h
  simp [topSum, this]

Carpooling.le_topSum_one.source:
lemma le_topSum_one (x : V → ℝ) (k : V) : x k ≤ topSum x 1 := by
  simpa using sum_le_topSum x {k}

variable [DecidableEq V]

/-- Lemma 3.4, including the boundary rank r = n-1. -/

Carpooling.topSum_step.source:
theorem topSum_step {x y : V → ℝ} (e : Move x y) {r : ℕ}
    (_hr : 1 ≤ r) (hrn : r < Fintype.card V)
    (hinc : topSum x r < topSum y r) :
    2 * topSum y r - topSum y (r-1) - 2 ≤ topSum x (r+1) := by
  let R := topSet y r
  have hcard : R.card = r := (topSet_spec y (Nat.le_of_lt hrn)).1
  have hsum : (∑ k ∈ R, y k) = topSum y r := rfl
  have hbefore : (∑ k ∈ R, x k) ≤ topSum x r := by
    simpa [hcard] using sum_le_topSum x R
  have hchange := e.sum_update R
  have hu : e.u ∈ R := by
    by_contra h
    by_cases hv : e.v ∈ R
    · simp only [if_neg h, if_pos hv] at hchange
      linarith [e.weight_nonneg]
    · simp only [if_neg h, if_neg hv] at hchange
      linarith
  have hv : e.v ∉ R := by
    intro h
    simp only [if_pos hu, if_pos h] at hchange
    linarith
  have hrem : (R.erase e.u).card = r-1 := by simp [card_erase_of_mem hu, hcard]
  have hsmall := sum_le_topSum y (R.erase e.u)
  rw [hrem, sum_erase_eq_sub hu] at hsmall
  have huval : topSum y r - topSum y (r-1) ≤ y e.u := by linarith
  have hgap : y e.u - y e.v ≤ 2 := by
    rw [e.at_u, e.at_v]
    linarith [e.ordered, e.weight_le_one]
  have hunion : (insert e.v R).card = r+1 := by simp [hv, hcard]
  have hlarge := sum_le_topSum x (insert e.v R)
  rw [hunion] at hlarge
  have hsame : (∑ k ∈ insert e.v R, y k) = ∑ k ∈ insert e.v R, x k := by
    simpa [hu] using e.sum_update (insert e.v R)
  rw [sum_insert hv, hsum] at hsame
  linarith

end Carpooling

Carpooling.Run.clusters.source:
noncomputable def Run.clusters {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) : ℕ → Clusters V
  | 0 => Clusters.singletons
  | t+1 => if h : t < T then
      (R.clusters t).merge (R.step t h).u (R.step t h).v else R.clusters t

Carpooling.Run.IsInternal.source:
def Run.IsInternal {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (t : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ h : t < T, (R.clusters t).block (R.step t h).u = (R.clusters t).block (R.step t h).v

Carpooling.Run.surplus.source:
noncomputable def Run.surplus {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (t : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  ((range t).filter R.IsInternal).card

Carpooling.log_add_strict.source:
lemma log_add_strict {a b : ℕ} (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (h : Nat.log 2 (a+b) = Nat.log 2 a) : Nat.log 2 b < Nat.log 2 a := by
  by_contra hn
  have hba : Nat.log 2 a ≤ Nat.log 2 b := by omega
  have hpa := Nat.pow_log_le_self 2 ha.ne'
  have hpb := Nat.pow_le_of_le_log hb.ne' hba
  have hp : 2^(Nat.log 2 a + 1) ≤ a+b := by rw [pow_succ]; omega
  have hl := Nat.le_log_of_pow_le (by decide : 1 < 2) hp
  omega

Carpooling.Run.clusters_mono.source:
lemma Run.clusters_mono {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (t : ℕ) (k : V) :
    (R.clusters t).block k ⊆ (R.clusters (t+1)).block k := by
  rw [Run.clusters]
  split_ifs with h
  · exact Clusters.subset_merge _ _ _ _
  · exact subset_rfl

Carpooling.Run.rank.source:
noncomputable def Run.rank {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (t : ℕ) (k : V) : ℕ :=
  Nat.log 2 ((R.clusters t).block k).card

Carpooling.Run.rank_mono.source:
lemma Run.rank_mono {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (t : ℕ) (k : V) :
    R.rank t k ≤ R.rank (t+1) k := Nat.log_mono_right (card_le_card (R.clusters_mono t k))

Carpooling.Run.shift.source:
noncomputable def Run.shift {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (t : ℕ) (k : V) : ℝ :=
  R.d t k - 2 * (R.rank t k : ℝ)

Carpooling.Run.shift_step.source:
lemma Run.shift_step {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) {t : ℕ} (ht : t < T) :
    DStep (R.shift t) (R.shift (t+1)) (decide (R.IsInternal t)) := by
  let P := R.clusters t
  let e := R.step t ht
  have hnext : R.clusters (t+1) = P.merge e.u e.v := by simp [Run.clusters, ht, P, e]
  have hrmono : ∀ k, (R.rank t k : ℝ) ≤ R.rank (t+1) k := by
    intro k; exact_mod_cast R.rank_mono t k
  by_cases hint : P.block e.u = P.block e.v
  · have hsame : R.clusters (t+1) = P := hnext.trans (P.merge_same hint)
    have hruv : R.rank t e.u = R.rank t e.v := congrArg (fun S : Finset V => Nat.log 2 S.card) hint
    have hrs : ∀ k, R.rank (t+1) k = R.rank t k := by intro k; simp [Run.rank, hsame, P]
    let z : V → ℝ := R.shift (t+1)
    let em : Move (R.shift t) z := {
      u := e.u, v := e.v, distinct := e.distinct, weight := e.weight,
      weight_nonneg := e.weight_nonneg, weight_le_one := e.weight_le_one,
      ordered := by dsimp [Run.shift]; rw [hruv]; exact sub_le_sub_right e.ordered _,
      update := by
        intro k
        dsimp [z, Run.shift]
        rw [hrs, e.update]
        ring }
    exact DStep.move em (fun _ => le_rfl) (by intro _; apply decide_eq_true; exact ⟨ht, hint⟩)
  · have hnew : R.rank (t+1) e.u = R.rank (t+1) e.v := by
      simp [Run.rank, hnext]
    by_cases hgrow : R.rank t e.u < R.rank (t+1) e.u
    · apply DStep.drop
      intro k
      by_cases hku : k = e.u
      · subst k
        have hh : (R.rank t e.u : ℝ) + 1 ≤ R.rank (t+1) e.u := by exact_mod_cast hgrow
        dsimp [Run.shift]
        rw [e.at_u]
        linarith [e.weight_le_one]
      · by_cases hkv : k = e.v
        · subst k
          dsimp [Run.shift]
          rw [e.at_v]
          linarith [hrmono e.v, e.weight_nonneg]
        · dsimp [Run.shift]
          rw [e.update]
          simp only [if_neg hku, if_neg hkv, add_zero, sub_zero]
          linarith [hrmono k]
    · have heq : R.rank (t+1) e.u = R.rank t e.u := by
        have hh := R.rank_mono t e.u; omega
      have ha : 0 < (P.block e.u).card := card_pos.mpr ⟨e.u, P.self_mem _⟩
      have hb : 0 < (P.block e.v).card := card_pos.mpr ⟨e.v, P.self_mem _⟩
      have hlog : Nat.log 2 ((P.block e.u).card + (P.block e.v).card) = R.rank t e.u := by
        have hc : (P.block e.u ∪ P.block e.v).card = (P.block e.u).card + (P.block e.v).card :=
          card_union_of_disjoint (P.disjoint hint)
        simpa [Run.rank, hnext, hc] using heq
      have hlt : R.rank t e.v < R.rank t e.u := log_add_strict ha hb hlog
      have hltR : (R.rank t e.v : ℝ) + 1 ≤ R.rank t e.u := by exact_mod_cast hlt
      have hgap : R.shift t e.u + e.weight ≤ R.shift t e.v := by
        dsimp [Run.shift]
        linarith [e.ordered, e.weight_le_one]
      let z : V → ℝ := fun k => R.shift t k + (if k = e.u then e.weight else 0) -
        (if k = e.v then e.weight else 0)
      let em : Move (R.shift t) z := {
        u := e.u, v := e.v, distinct := e.distinct, weight := e.weight,
        weight_nonneg := e.weight_nonneg, weight_le_one := e.weight_le_one,
        ordered := by linarith [e.weight_nonneg], update := fun _ => rfl }
      apply DStep.move em
      · intro k
        dsimp [z, Run.shift]
        rw [e.update]
        linarith [hrmono k]
      · intro hex
        change R.shift t e.v < R.shift t e.u + e.weight at hex
        exact False.elim (not_lt_of_ge hgap hex)

Carpooling.Run.shifted.source:
noncomputable def Run.shifted {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) : DRun V T where
  d := R.shift
  charge := fun t => decide (R.IsInternal t)
  step := fun _ ht => R.shift_step ht

Carpooling.Run.shifted_count.source:
lemma Run.shifted_count {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (t : ℕ) :
    R.shifted.count t = R.surplus t := by simp [DRun.count, Run.shifted, Run.surplus]

Carpooling.Run.clusters_neg.source:
lemma Run.clusters_neg {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (t : ℕ) : R.neg.clusters t = R.clusters t := by
  induction t with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    simp only [Run.clusters]
    split_ifs with h
    · rw [ih]; exact Clusters.merge_comm _ _ _
    · exact ih

Carpooling.Run.surplus_neg.source:
lemma Run.surplus_neg {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (t : ℕ) : R.neg.surplus t = R.surplus t := by
  unfold Run.surplus
  congr 1
  apply filter_congr
  intro s _
  simp only [Run.IsInternal]
  apply exists_congr
  intro h
  rw [R.clusters_neg]
  change (R.clusters s).block (R.step s h).v = (R.clusters s).block (R.step s h).u ↔ _
  exact eq_comm

/-- A refined deterministic bound with only internal requests charged. -/

Carpooling.tree_like_surplus_bound.source:
theorem tree_like_surplus_bound {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (hi : ∀ k, R.d 0 k = 0) (i : V) :
    |R.d T i| ≤ 4 * (R.surplus T : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) +
      2 * (Nat.log 2 ((R.clusters T).block i).card : ℝ) := by
  have hpos := R.shifted.position_bound (by intro k; simp [Run.shifted, Run.shift, Run.rank, Run.clusters, Clusters.singletons, hi]) i
  have hneg := R.neg.shifted.position_bound (by intro k; simp [Run.shifted, Run.shift, Run.rank, Run.clusters, Clusters.singletons, Run.neg, hi]) i
  rw [R.shifted_count] at hpos
  rw [R.neg.shifted_count, R.surplus_neg] at hneg
  change R.d T i - 2*(R.rank T i : ℝ) ≤ _ at hpos
  change -R.d T i - 2*(R.neg.rank T i : ℝ) ≤ _ at hneg
  have hr : R.neg.rank T i = R.rank T i := by simp [Run.rank, R.clusters_neg]
  rw [hr] at hneg
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor <;> change _ ≤ _ <;> dsimp [Run.rank] at * <;> linarith

Carpooling.Run.surplus_succ.source:
lemma Run.surplus_succ {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (t : ℕ) :
    R.surplus (t+1) = R.surplus t + if R.IsInternal t then 1 else 0 := by
  simp only [Run.surplus, range_add_one, filter_insert]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all

Carpooling.Clusters.singletons_parts_car.source:
lemma Clusters.singletons_parts_card : (Clusters.singletons : Clusters V).parts.card = Fintype.card V := by
  rw [Clusters.parts, card_image_of_injective]
  · simp
  · intro i j h
    exact singleton_injective h

/-- The number of merging arrivals equals the drop in the number of blocks. -/

Carpooling.Run.surplus_identity.source:
theorem Run.surplus_identity {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T) :
    R.surplus t + Fintype.card V = t + (R.clusters t).parts.card := by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [Run.surplus, Run.clusters, Clusters.singletons_parts_card]
  | succ t ih =>
    have ih := ih (by omega)
    have hnext : R.clusters (t+1) = (R.clusters t).merge (R.step t (by omega)).u (R.step t (by omega)).v := by
      simp [Run.clusters, show t < T by omega]
    rw [R.surplus_succ]
    by_cases hint : R.IsInternal t
    · rw [if_pos hint]
      obtain ⟨h, hint⟩ := hint
      rw [hnext, Clusters.merge_same _ hint]
      omega
    · rw [if_neg hint, hnext]
      have hne : (R.clusters t).block (R.step t (by omega)).u ≠
          (R.clusters t).block (R.step t (by omega)).v := by
        intro hh; exact hint ⟨by omega, hh⟩
      have hc := (R.clusters t).parts_merge_card hne
      omega

/-- Lemma 4.2 in a finite union-find presentation of connectedness.
`hconn` says the requested multigraph has one component on V. -/

Carpooling.lemma_4_2.source:
theorem lemma_4_2 {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (hi : ∀ k, R.d 0 k = 0)
    (hconn : ∀ k, (R.clusters T).block k = univ) (i : V) :
    |R.d T i| ≤ 4 * ((T - (Fintype.card V - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) +
      2 * (Nat.log 2 (Fintype.card V) : ℝ) := by
  have hparts : (R.clusters T).parts = {univ} := by
    ext S
    simp only [Clusters.parts, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and, mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩; exact hk.symm.trans (hconn k)
    · intro h; exact ⟨i, (hconn i).trans h.symm⟩
  have hid := R.surplus_identity (le_refl T)
  rw [hparts, card_singleton] at hid
  have hn : 1 ≤ Fintype.card V := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mpr ⟨i⟩
  have hp : R.surplus T = T - (Fintype.card V - 1) := by omega
  simpa [hp, hconn] using tree_like_surplus_bound R hi i

end Carpooling

Carpooling.fiber_card_subtype.source:
lemma fiber_card_subtype (f : A → B) (b : B) :
    Fintype.card {a // f a = b} = (univ.filter fun a => f a = b).card := by
  simp [Fintype.card_subtype]

Carpooling.constant_fiber_card.source:
lemma constant_fiber_card (f : A → B) (k : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ b, (univ.filter fun a => f a = b).card = k) :
    Fintype.card A = Fintype.card B*k := by
  let e : A ≃ (b : B) × {a : A // f a = b} := {
    toFun := fun a => ⟨f a,⟨a,rfl⟩⟩
    invFun := fun p => p.2.val
    left_inv := fun _ => rfl
    right_inv := by rintro ⟨b,a,ha⟩; subst b; rfl }
  have hc := Fintype.card_congr e
  simpa only [Fintype.card_sigma,fiber_card_subtype,hf,sum_const,card_univ,nsmul_eq_mul] using hc

Carpooling.constant_fiber_preimage_card.source:
lemma constant_fiber_preimage_card (f : A → B) (k : ℕ)
    (hf : ∀ b, (univ.filter fun a => f a = b).card = k) (S : Finset B) :
    (univ.filter fun a => f a ∈ S).card = S.card*k := by
  let e : {a : A // f a ∈ S} ≃ (b : S) × {a : A // f a = b.val} := {
    toFun := fun a => ⟨⟨f a.val,a.property⟩,⟨a.val,rfl⟩⟩
    invFun := fun p => ⟨p.2.val,by rw [p.2.property]; exact p.1.property⟩
    left_inv := fun _ => rfl
    right_inv := by
      rintro ⟨⟨b,hb⟩,a,ha⟩
      change f a = b at ha
      subst b
      rfl }
  have hc := Fintype.card_congr e
  simpa [Fintype.card_subtype,Fintype.card_sigma,fiber_card_subtype,hf] using hc

Carpooling.uniformProb_constant_fiber.source:
theorem uniformProb_constant_fiber (f : A → B) {k : ℕ} (hk : 0 < k)
    (hf : ∀ b, (univ.filter fun a => f a = b).card = k) (S : Finset B) :
    uniformProb (univ.filter fun a => f a ∈ S) = uniformProb S := by
  unfold uniformProb
  rw [constant_fiber_preimage_card f k hf S,constant_fiber_card f k hf]
  push_cast
  exact mul_div_mul_right _ _ (by exact_mod_cast hk.ne' : (k:ℝ) ≠ 0)

Carpooling.word_fiber_card.source:
lemma word_fiber_card (f : A → B) {k T : ℕ}
    (hf : ∀ b, (univ.filter fun a => f a = b).card = k) (y : Fin T → B) :
    (univ.filter fun x : Fin T → A => (fun t => f (x t)) = y).card = k^T := by
  let e : {x : Fin T → A // (fun t => f (x t)) = y} ≃
      ((t : Fin T) → {a : A // f a = y t}) := {
    toFun := fun x t => ⟨x.val t,congrFun x.property t⟩
    invFun := fun z => ⟨fun t => (z t).val,funext fun t => (z t).property⟩
    left_inv := fun _ => rfl
    right_inv := fun _ => rfl }
  have hc := Fintype.card_congr e
  simpa only [Fintype.card_subtype,Fintype.card_pi,fiber_card_subtype,hf,prod_const,
    card_univ,Fintype.card_fin] using hc

end Carpooling

Carpooling.le_four_cuberoot.source:
lemma le_four_cuberoot {a p : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) (hp : 0 ≤ p)
    (h : a^3 ≤ 64*p) : a ≤ 4 * p^((1:ℝ)/3) := by
  have hroot : (p^((1:ℝ)/3))^3 = p := by
    simpa using Real.rpow_inv_natCast_pow hp (by decide : (3:ℕ) ≠ 0)
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ p^((1:ℝ)/3) := Real.rpow_nonneg hp _
  apply (pow_le_pow_iff_left₀ ha (by positivity) (by decide : (3:ℕ) ≠ 0)).mp
  nlinarith [hroot]

/-- Lemma 3.1, with the exact constant 4 and the n cutoff. -/

Carpooling.lemma_3_1.source:
theorem lemma_3_1 {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T)
    (hinit : ∀ k, R.d 0 k ≤ 0) (i : V) :
    R.d T i ≤ min (4 * (expandingCount R T : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3)) (Fintype.card V) := by
  apply le_min
  · exact le_trans (le_max_left _ _) (le_four_cuberoot (le_max_right _ _)
      (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (positive_cube_bound R hinit i))
  · exact position_le_card R hinit i

/-- Theorem 1.1, explicit pointwise version of the maximum-over-prefixes bound. -/

Carpooling.theorem_1_1.source:
theorem theorem_1_1 {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T)
    (hinit : ∀ k, R.d 0 k = 0) {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T) (i : V) :
    |R.d t i| ≤ min (4 * (t : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3)) (Fintype.card V) := by
  obtain ⟨hc, hn⟩ := deterministic_upper_bound R hinit ht i
  exact le_min (le_four_cuberoot (abs_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hc) hn

end Carpooling

Carpooling.scheduled_varying_targets_low.source:
theorem scheduled_varying_targets_lower_probability {T L h : ℕ}
    (hK : 0 < Fintype.card K) (target : K ↪ J) (f : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ U)
    (schedule : Fin T → J) (g : Fin T → E → Sym2 U)
    (encode : J → (a b : Fin (2*h+2)) → a ≠ b → E)
    (hencode : ∀ t k a b hab, schedule t = target k →
      g t (encode (target k) a b hab) = s(f a,f b)) (cut : K → ℕ) (hcut : ∀ j, cut j ≤ T)
    (hsize : ∀ j, (targetTimes schedule target cut j).card = L)
    (hL : ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(L:ℤ))
    (R : (Fin T → E) → IntegerRun (J × U) T)
    (hi : ∀ x v, (R x).d 0 v = 0)
    (hrequest : ∀ x (t : Fin T),
      s(((R x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((R x).step t.val t.isLt).v) =
        (g t (x t)).map (fun u => (schedule t,u)))
    (hcausal : ∀ (t : Fin T) (x y : Fin T → E),
      (∀ s : Fin t.val, x ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (R x).d t.val = (R y).d t.val) :
    uniformProb (univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R h) ≤
      (Fintype.card E:ℝ)^L/(Fintype.card K:ℝ) := by
  classical
  let I := targetTimes schedule target cut
  let P : (t : Fin T) → (Fin t.val → E) → E := fun t z =>
    let pos := fun i => (R (extendSamplePrefix t z)).d t.val (schedule t,f i)
    encode (schedule t) (lowerPair h pos).1 (lowerPair h pos).2 (lowerPair_distinct h pos)
  have hforce : ∀ j, selectedMatchingEvent (I j) P ⊆ integerDiscrepancyEvent R h := by
    intro j x hx
    have hm := (mem_filter.mp hx).2
    let d : ℕ → Fin (2*h+2) → ℤ := fun t i => (R x).d (min t (cut j)) (target j,f i)
    have hchange : ∀ t : Fin T, (∀ i, |d t.val i| < (h:ℤ)) →
        integerPotential (d (t.val+1))-integerPotential (d t.val) = if t ∈ I j then 2 else 0 := by
      intro t hb
      by_cases hbefore : t.val < cut j
      · have hmin : min t.val (cut j) = t.val := min_eq_left (le_of_lt hbefore)
        have hmin' : min (t.val+1) (cut j) = t.val+1 := min_eq_left (by omega)
        simp only [d,hmin] at hb
        simp only [d,hmin,hmin']
        by_cases hj : schedule t = target j
        · have htI : t ∈ I j := mem_filter.mpr ⟨mem_univ _,hj,hbefore⟩
          rw [if_pos htI]
          let z : Fin t.val → E := fun s => x ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩
          have hstate : (R (extendSamplePrefix t z)).d t.val = (R x).d t.val := by
            apply hcausal t
            intro s
            simp [extendSamplePrefix,z,s.isLt]
          have hedge : s(((R x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((R x).step t.val t.isLt).v) =
              s((target j,f (lowerPair h (fun i => (R x).d t.val (target j,f i))).1),
                (target j,f (lowerPair h (fun i => (R x).d t.val (target j,f i))).2)) := by
            rw [hrequest x t,hm t htI]
            change (g t (encode (schedule t) _ _ _)).map _ = _
            rw [hj,hencode t j _ _ _ hj,Sym2.map_pair_eq]
            change s((target j,f (lowerPair h (fun i =>
              (R (extendSamplePrefix t z)).d t.val (target j,f i))).1),
              (target j,f (lowerPair h (fun i =>
              (R (extendSamplePrefix t z)).d t.val (target j,f i))).2)) = _
            rw [hstate]
          let fj : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ J × U := {
            toFun := fun i => (target j,f i)
            inj' := fun a b he => f.injective (congrArg Prod.snd he) }
          exact ((R x).step t.val t.isLt).embedded_potential_change fj _ _ hedge
            (lowerPair_equal h (fun i => (R x).d t.val (target j,f i)) hb)
        · have htI : t ∉ I j := by simp [I,targetTimes,hj]
          rw [if_neg htI]
          have hidle : (fun i => (R x).d (t.val+1) (target j,f i)) =
              (fun i => (R x).d t.val (target j,f i)) := by
            funext i
            exact ((R x).step t.val t.isLt).other_component_unchanged
              (g t (x t)) (schedule t) (target j) hj (hrequest x t) (f i)
          rw [hidle,sub_self]
      · have hmin : min t.val (cut j) = cut j := min_eq_right (by omega)
        have hmin' : min (t.val+1) (cut j) = cut j := min_eq_right (by omega)
        have htI : t ∉ I j := by simp [I,targetTimes,hbefore]
        simp [d,hmin,hmin',htI]
    obtain ⟨t,ht,i,hlarge⟩ := charged_potential_lower_bound d (I j)
      (fun i => by simp [d,hi]) hchange (by simpa [I,hsize] using hL)
    simp only [integerDiscrepancyEvent,mem_filter,mem_univ,true_and]
    exact ⟨min t (cut j),(min_le_left _ _).trans ht,(target j,f i),hlarge⟩
  have hdisjoint : ∀ j k, j ≠ k → Disjoint (I j) (I k) := by
    intro j k hjk
    apply disjoint_left.mpr
    intro t htj htk
