    exact hjk (target.injective ((mem_filter.mp htj).2.1.symm.trans (mem_filter.mp htk).2.1))
  have hb := adaptive_prescription_amplification I hK hdisjoint hsize P
  apply le_trans _ hb
  apply uniformProb_mono
  intro x hx
  apply mem_filter.mpr
  refine ⟨mem_univ _,?_⟩
  intro j hj
  exact (mem_sdiff.mp hx).2 (hforce j hj)

Carpooling.scheduled_varying_targets_of_.source:
theorem scheduled_varying_targets_of_counts {T L h : ℕ}
    (hK : 0 < Fintype.card K) (target : K ↪ J) (f : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ U)
    (schedule : Fin T → J) (g : Fin T → E → Sym2 U)
    (encode : J → (a b : Fin (2*h+2)) → a ≠ b → E)
    (hencode : ∀ t k a b hab, schedule t = target k →
      g t (encode (target k) a b hab) = s(f a,f b))
    (hcount : ∀ k, L ≤ (univ.filter fun t => schedule t = target k).card)
    (hL : ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(L:ℤ))
    (R : (Fin T → E) → IntegerRun (J × U) T)
    (hi : ∀ x v, (R x).d 0 v = 0)
    (hrequest : ∀ x (t : Fin T),
      s(((R x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((R x).step t.val t.isLt).v) =
        (g t (x t)).map (fun u => (schedule t,u)))
    (hcausal : ∀ (t : Fin T) (x y : Fin T → E),
      (∀ s : Fin t.val, x ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨s.val,lt_trans s.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (R x).d t.val = (R y).d t.val) :
    uniformProb (univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent R h) ≤
      (Fintype.card E:ℝ)^L/(Fintype.card K:ℝ) := by
  have hex : ∀ k, ∃ c ≤ T,
      ((univ.filter fun t => schedule t = target k).filter fun t => t.val < c).card = L :=
    fun k => exists_prefix_cut _ (hcount k)
  let cut : K → ℕ := fun k => (hex k).choose
  apply scheduled_varying_targets_lower_probability hK target f schedule g encode hencode cut
    (fun k => (hex k).choose_spec.1) _ hL R hi hrequest hcausal
  intro k
  have hset : targetTimes schedule target cut k =
      ((univ.filter fun t => schedule t = target k).filter fun t => t.val < cut k) := by
    ext t
    simp [targetTimes]
  rw [hset]
  exact (hex k).choose_spec.2

end Carpooling

Carpooling.splitFailure.source:
noncomputable def splitFailure {T : ℕ} {V : Type*} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V]
    (R : (Fin T → A) → (Fin T → E) → IntegerRun V T) (h : ℕ) :
    Finset ((Fin T → A) × (Fin T → E)) :=
  univ.filter fun p => p.2 ∉ integerDiscrepancyEvent (R p.1) h

/-- Component probabilities may be nonuniform. Each targeted clique has N
vertices among the uniform label alphabet A; the remaining labels can select
an arbitrary padding component, whose edges are allowed a different decoder. -/

Carpooling.weighted_cliques_lower_probab.source:
theorem weighted_cliques_lower_probability {N L h : ℕ}
    (hN : 0 < N) (hNL : 2*L ≤ N) (cls : A → Option J)
    (hfiber : ∀ j, (univ.filter fun a => cls a = some j).card = N)
    (f : Fin (2*h+2) ↪ U)
    (g : (Fin (Fintype.card A) → A) → Fin (Fintype.card A) → E → Sym2 U)
    (encode : Option J → (a b : Fin (2*h+2)) → a ≠ b → E)
    (hencode : ∀ s t j a b hab, cls (s t) = some j →
      g s t (encode (some j) a b hab) = s(f a,f b))
    (hL : ((2*h+2:ℕ):ℤ)*(h:ℤ)^2 < 2*(L:ℤ))
    (R : (Fin (Fintype.card A) → A) → (Fin (Fintype.card A) → E) →
      IntegerRun (Option J × U) (Fintype.card A))
    (hi : ∀ s x v, (R s x).d 0 v = 0)
    (hrequest : ∀ s x (t : Fin (Fintype.card A)),
      s(((R s x).step t.val t.isLt).u,((R s x).step t.val t.isLt).v) =
        (g s t (x t)).map (fun u => (cls (s t),u)))
    (hcausal : ∀ s (t : Fin (Fintype.card A)) x y,
      (∀ i : Fin t.val, x ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩ =
        y ⟨i.val,lt_trans i.isLt t.isLt⟩) → (R s x).d t.val = (R s y).d t.val) :
    uniformProb (splitFailure R h) ≤
      8/(N:ℝ)+2*(Fintype.card E:ℝ)^L/(Fintype.card J:ℝ) := by
  classical
  let c : (Fin (Fintype.card A) → A) → J → ℕ := classCount cls
  let a : ℝ := 2*(Fintype.card E:ℝ)^L/(Fintype.card J:ℝ)
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := by dsimp [a]; positivity
  have hgood : ∀ s, s ∉ fewPopulated c L →
      uniformProb (eventFiber (splitFailure R h) s) ≤ a := by
    intro s hs
    let K := {j : J // j ∈ populated c L s}
    have hcard : Fintype.card J ≤ 2*Fintype.card K := by
      have he : Fintype.card K = (populated c L s).card := Fintype.card_coe _
      rw [he]
      simpa [fewPopulated] using hs
    have hK : 0 < Fintype.card K := by have := Fintype.card_pos (α := J); omega
    let target : K ↪ Option J := ⟨fun k => some k.val,fun _ _ h => Subtype.ext (Option.some.inj h)⟩
    have hcount : ∀ k : K, L ≤ (univ.filter fun t => cls (s t) = target k).card := by
      intro k
      exact (mem_filter.mp k.property).2
    have hb := scheduled_varying_targets_of_counts hK target f (fun t => cls (s t))
      (g s) encode (fun t k a b hab ht => hencode s t k.val a b hab ht)
      hcount hL (R s) (hi s) (hrequest s) (hcausal s)
    have he : eventFiber (splitFailure R h) s = univ \ integerDiscrepancyEvent (R s) h := by
      ext x; simp [eventFiber,splitFailure]
    rw [he]
    apply hb.trans
    have hMR : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card J := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_pos
    have hKR : (0:ℝ) < Fintype.card K := by exact_mod_cast hK
    have hcardR : (Fintype.card J:ℝ) ≤ 2*(Fintype.card K:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hcard
    dsimp [a]
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hKR hMR).mpr
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (Fintype.card E)) L)
      (sub_nonneg.mpr hcardR)]
  have hb := uniformProb_mixture_bound (splitFailure R h) (fewPopulated c L) ha hgood
  have ho := fewPopulated_probability c hN hNL (fun j => classCount_variance cls N hfiber j)
  exact hb.trans (add_le_add_right ho a)

end Carpooling

Carpooling.classCount.source:
noncomputable def classCount {T : ℕ} (cls : A → Option J) (x : Fin T → A) (j : J) : ℕ :=
  (univ.filter fun t => cls (x t) = some j).card

Carpooling.classCount_variance.source:
theorem classCount_variance (cls : A → Option J) (N : ℕ)
    (hfiber : ∀ j, (univ.filter fun a => cls a = some j).card = N) (j : J) :
    uniformMean (fun x : Fin (Fintype.card A) → A => ((classCount cls x j:ℝ)-N)^2) ≤ (N:ℝ) := by
  let S := univ.filter fun a => cls a = some j
  let B : Fin (Fintype.card A) → Finset (Fin (Fintype.card A) → A) := evaluationEvent S
  let p : ℝ := (N:ℝ)/(Fintype.card A:ℝ)
  have hA : (Fintype.card A:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hfirst : ∀ t, uniformProb (B t) = p := by
    intro t
    rw [evaluation_probability]
    simp only [uniformProb,S,hfiber,p]
  have hsecond : ∀ s t, s ≠ t → uniformProb (B s ∩ B t) = p^2 := by
    intro s t hst
    rw [evaluation_pair_probability S S s t hst]
    have hs : uniformProb S = p := by simp only [uniformProb,S,hfiber,p]
    rw [hs,pow_two]
  have hcount : ∀ x : Fin (Fintype.card A) → A,
      (classCount cls x j:ℝ)-N = ∑ t, (eventIndicator (B t) x-p) := by
    intro x
    have he : (∑ t, eventIndicator (B t) x) = (classCount cls x j:ℝ) := by
      simp [B,S,eventIndicator,evaluationEvent,classCount]
    rw [sum_sub_distrib,he]
    simp only [sum_const,card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul]
    dsimp [p]
    field_simp
  simp_rw [hcount]
  rw [indicator_sum_variance B p hfirst hsecond]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin]
  have hmul : (Fintype.card A:ℝ)*p = (N:ℝ) := by dsimp [p]; field_simp
  rw [hmul]
  have hp : 0 ≤ p := by dsimp [p]; positivity
  nlinarith [show (0:ℝ) ≤ N from Nat.cast_nonneg N]

end Carpooling

Carpooling.Witness.shape.source: def shape (F : Tree V) : Tree Unit := F.map fun _ => ()

Carpooling.Witness.shape_nodes.source:
@[simp] lemma shape_nodes (F : Tree V) : (shape F).numNodes = F.numNodes := by
  induction F with
  | nil => rfl
  | node v L R ihL ihR => simp [shape, Tree.map, Tree.numNodes] at *; omega

/-- All graph-respecting vertex labels for one rooted ordered tree shape. -/

Carpooling.Witness.decorate.source:
noncomputable def decorate (N : V → Finset V) (root : V) : Tree Unit → Finset (Tree V)
  | .nil => {.nil}
  | .node _ L R => (N root).biUnion fun v =>
      ((decorate N v L) ×ˢ (decorate N root R)).image fun p => .node v p.1 p.2

Carpooling.Witness.decorate_card_le.source:
lemma decorate_card_le (N : V → Finset V) {Δ : ℕ} (hΔ : ∀ v, (N v).card ≤ Δ)
    (root : V) (S : Tree Unit) : (decorate N root S).card ≤ Δ^S.numNodes := by
  induction S generalizing root with
  | nil => simp [decorate, Tree.numNodes]
  | node a L R ihL ihR =>
    calc
      (decorate N root (.node a L R)).card ≤
          ∑ v ∈ N root, (((decorate N v L) ×ˢ (decorate N root R)).image
            (fun p => Tree.node v p.1 p.2)).card := card_biUnion_le
      _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ N root, Δ^L.numNodes * Δ^R.numNodes := by
        apply sum_le_sum
        intro v hv
        exact (card_image_le).trans (by
          rw [card_product]
          exact Nat.mul_le_mul (ihL v) (ihR root))
      _ = (N root).card * (Δ^L.numNodes * Δ^R.numNodes) := by simp
      _ ≤ Δ * (Δ^L.numNodes * Δ^R.numNodes) := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (hΔ root)
      _ = Δ^(.node a L R : Tree Unit).numNodes := by
        simp only [Tree.numNodes, pow_add, pow_one]
        ring

Carpooling.Witness.mem_decorate.source:
lemma mem_decorate {N : V → Finset V} {root : V} {F : Tree V}
    (hF : Valid (fun u v => v ∈ N u) root F) : F ∈ decorate N root (shape F) := by
  induction F generalizing root with
  | nil => simp [shape, Tree.map, decorate]
  | node v L R ihL ihR =>
    apply mem_biUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨v, hF.1, mem_image.mpr ?_⟩
    exact ⟨(L,R), mem_product.mpr ⟨ihL hF.2.1, ihR hF.2.2⟩, rfl⟩

Carpooling.Witness.families.source:
noncomputable def families (N : V → Finset V) (r : ℕ) : Finset (V × Tree V) :=
  univ.biUnion fun root => (Tree.treesOfNumNodesEq r).biUnion fun S =>
    (decorate N root S).image fun F => (root,F)

Carpooling.Witness.mem_families.source:
lemma mem_families {N : V → Finset V} {root : V} {F : Tree V} {r : ℕ}
    (hF : Valid (fun u v => v ∈ N u) root F) (hr : F.numNodes = r) :
    (root,F) ∈ families N r := by
  apply mem_biUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨root, mem_univ _, mem_biUnion.mpr ?_⟩
  refine ⟨shape F, Tree.mem_treesOfNumNodesEq.mpr (by simpa using hr), ?_⟩
  exact mem_image.mpr ⟨F, mem_decorate hF, rfl⟩

Carpooling.Witness.families_card_le_cata.source:
lemma families_card_le_catalan (N : V → Finset V) {Δ : ℕ}
    (hΔ : ∀ v, (N v).card ≤ Δ) (r : ℕ) :
    (families N r).card ≤ Fintype.card V * catalan r * Δ^r := by
  calc
    (families N r).card ≤ ∑ root : V,
        ((Tree.treesOfNumNodesEq r).biUnion fun S =>
          (decorate N root S).image fun F => (root,F)).card := card_biUnion_le
    _ ≤ ∑ root : V, ∑ S ∈ Tree.treesOfNumNodesEq r, Δ^r := by
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro root _
      apply card_biUnion_le.trans
      apply sum_le_sum
      intro S hS
      have hrS := Tree.mem_treesOfNumNodesEq.mp hS
      exact card_image_le.trans (by simpa [hrS] using decorate_card_le N hΔ root S)
    _ = Fintype.card V * catalan r * Δ^r := by
      simp [Tree.treesOfNumNodesEq_card_eq_catalan, mul_assoc]

Carpooling.Witness.catalan_le_four_pow.source:
lemma catalan_le_four_pow (r : ℕ) : catalan r ≤ 4^r := by
  calc
    catalan r = Nat.centralBinom r / (r+1) := catalan_eq_centralBinom_div r
    _ ≤ Nat.centralBinom r := Nat.div_le_self _ _
    _ ≤ 2^(2*r) := Nat.choose_le_two_pow _ _
    _ = 4^r := by rw [pow_mul]; norm_num

/-- Equation (6), for all rooted graph-respecting witness forests. -/

Carpooling.Witness.families_card_bound.source:
theorem families_card_bound (N : V → Finset V) {Δ : ℕ}
    (hΔ : ∀ v, (N v).card ≤ Δ) (r : ℕ) :
    (families N r).card ≤ 4^r * Fintype.card V * Δ^r := by
  have h := families_card_le_catalan N hΔ r
  have hc := catalan_le_four_pow r
  calc
    (families N r).card ≤ Fintype.card V * catalan r * Δ^r := h
    _ ≤ Fintype.card V * 4^r * Δ^r := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hc)
    _ = 4^r * Fintype.card V * Δ^r := by ac_rfl

end Carpooling.Witness

Carpooling.Run.edgeBag.source:
noncomputable def Run.edgeBag {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) : ℕ → Multiset (Sym2 V)
  | 0 => 0
  | t+1 => if h : t < T then R.edgeBag t + {s((R.step t h).u,(R.step t h).v)} else R.edgeBag t

Carpooling.Run.edgeBag_mono.source:
lemma Run.edgeBag_mono {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) {s t : ℕ} (hst : s ≤ t) : R.edgeBag s ≤ R.edgeBag t := by
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    have hs : s = 0 := by omega
    subst s
    exact le_rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    by_cases heq : s = t+1
    · subst s; exact le_rfl
    · have hh := ih (by omega)
      rw [Run.edgeBag]
      split_ifs
      · exact hh.trans (Multiset.le_add_right _ _)
      · exact hh

Carpooling.Run.edgeBag_prefix.source:
lemma Run.edgeBag_prefix {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T) {s : ℕ} (hs : s ≤ t) :
    (R.prefix t ht).edgeBag s = R.edgeBag s := by
  induction s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ s ih =>
    have hst : s < t := by omega
    have hsT : s < T := by omega
    simp only [Run.edgeBag, dif_pos hst, dif_pos hsT]
    rw [ih (by omega)]
    rfl

Carpooling.inBlock.source: def inBlock (C : Finset V) (e : Sym2 V) : Prop := e.out.1 ∈ C

Carpooling.inBlock_pair.source:
lemma inBlock_pair {C : Finset V} {u v : V} (h : u ∈ C ↔ v ∈ C) :
    inBlock C s(u,v) ↔ u ∈ C := by
  have hm := Sym2.out_fst_mem s(u,v)
  rcases Sym2.mem_iff.mp hm with hm | hm
  · simp [inBlock, hm]
  · simpa [inBlock, hm] using h.symm

Carpooling.selected.source:
noncomputable def selected (C : Finset V) (B : Multiset (Sym2 V)) : Multiset (Sym2 V) :=
  B.filter (inBlock C)

Carpooling.selected_union.source:
lemma selected_union {A B : Finset V} (h : Disjoint A B) (S : Multiset (Sym2 V)) :
    selected (A ∪ B) S = selected A S + selected B S := by
  induction S using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp [selected]
  | cons e S ih =>
    simp only [selected, Multiset.filter_cons, inBlock, mem_union] at *
    by_cases ha : e.out.1 ∈ A <;> by_cases hb : e.out.1 ∈ B
    · exact False.elim (Finset.disjoint_left.mp h ha hb)
    · simp [ha, hb, ih]
    · simp [ha, hb, ih, Multiset.cons_add, Multiset.add_cons]
    · simp [ha, hb, ih]

/-- Every component's full edge multiset admits a graph-respecting witness forest.
Repeated requests are retained with their multiplicities. -/

Carpooling.Run.component_witness.source:
theorem Run.component_witness {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (Adj : V → V → Prop)
    (hsymm : ∀ {u v}, Adj u v → Adj v u)
    (hAdj : ∀ s (hs : s < T), Adj (R.step s hs).u (R.step s hs).v)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T) (k : V) :
    ∃ F : Tree V, Witness.Valid Adj k F ∧
      Witness.edges k F = selected ((R.clusters t).block k) (R.edgeBag t) ∧
      Witness.vertices k F = (R.clusters t).block k := by
  induction t generalizing k with
  | zero => exact ⟨.nil, trivial, rfl, rfl⟩
  | succ t ih =>
    have htT : t < T := by omega
    let P := R.clusters t
    let e := R.step t htT
    let U := P.block e.u ∪ P.block e.v
    have hnext : R.clusters (t+1) = P.merge e.u e.v := by simp [Run.clusters, htT, P, e]
    have hbag : R.edgeBag (t+1) = R.edgeBag t + {s(e.u,e.v)} := by simp [Run.edgeBag, htT, e]
    by_cases hk : k ∈ U
    · have hb : (R.clusters (t+1)).block k = U := by
        rw [hnext]
        change (if k ∈ U then U else P.block k) = U
        exact if_pos hk
      obtain ⟨F, hF, heF, hvF⟩ := ih (by omega) e.u
      by_cases hint : P.block e.u = P.block e.v
      · have hU : U = P.block e.u := by simp [U, ← hint]
        have hv : e.v ∈ P.block e.u := by rw [hint]; exact P.self_mem _
        let G := Tree.node e.v Tree.nil F
        have hG : Witness.Valid Adj e.u G := ⟨hAdj t htT, trivial, hF⟩
        have hvG : Witness.vertices e.u G = U := by
          dsimp [G, Witness.vertices]
          rw [hvF, hU]
          exact union_eq_right.mpr (singleton_subset_iff.mpr hv)
        have hkG : k ∈ Witness.vertices e.u G := by rw [hvG]; exact hk
        obtain ⟨H, hH, heH, hvH⟩ := Witness.reroot hsymm hkG hG
        refine ⟨H, hH, ?_, hvH.trans (hvG.trans hb.symm)⟩
        rw [heH, hb, hbag]
        have hnew : inBlock U s(e.u,e.v) :=
          (inBlock_pair (by simp [U, P.self_mem])).mpr (by simp [U, P.self_mem])
        simp only [selected, Multiset.filter_add, Multiset.filter_singleton, if_pos hnew]
        dsimp [G, Witness.edges]
        rw [heF, hU]
        change {s(e.u,e.v)} + selected (P.block e.u) (R.edgeBag t) =
          selected (P.block e.u) (R.edgeBag t) + {s(e.u,e.v)}
        ac_rfl
      · obtain ⟨G, hG, heG, hvG⟩ := ih (by omega) e.v
        let K := Tree.node e.v G F
        have hK : Witness.Valid Adj e.u K := ⟨hAdj t htT, hG, hF⟩
        have hvK : Witness.vertices e.u K = U := by
          dsimp [K, Witness.vertices]
          rw [hvF, hvG]
          exact union_comm _ _
        have hkK : k ∈ Witness.vertices e.u K := by rw [hvK]; exact hk
        obtain ⟨H, hH, heH, hvH⟩ := Witness.reroot hsymm hkK hK
        refine ⟨H, hH, ?_, hvH.trans (hvK.trans hb.symm)⟩
        rw [heH, hb, hbag]
        have hnew : inBlock U s(e.u,e.v) :=
          (inBlock_pair (by simp [U, P.self_mem])).mpr (by simp [U, P.self_mem])
        change Witness.edges e.u K = _
        simp only [selected, Multiset.filter_add, Multiset.filter_singleton, if_pos hnew]
        change Witness.edges e.u K = selected U (R.edgeBag t) + {s(e.u,e.v)}
        rw [selected_union (P.disjoint hint)]
        dsimp [K, Witness.edges]
        rw [heF, heG]
        change ({s(e.u,e.v)} + selected (P.block e.v) (R.edgeBag t)) +
          selected (P.block e.u) (R.edgeBag t) =
          (selected (P.block e.u) (R.edgeBag t) + selected (P.block e.v) (R.edgeBag t)) + {s(e.u,e.v)}
        ac_rfl
    · obtain ⟨F, hF, heF, hvF⟩ := ih (by omega) k
      have hb : (R.clusters (t+1)).block k = P.block k := by
        rw [hnext]
        change (if k ∈ U then U else P.block k) = P.block k
        exact if_neg hk
      refine ⟨F, hF, ?_, hvF.trans hb.symm⟩
      rw [hb, hbag]
      have hu : e.u ∉ P.block k := by
        intro hh
        exact hk (mem_union.mpr (Or.inl (P.mem_symm hh)))
      have hv : e.v ∉ P.block k := by
        intro hh
        exact hk (mem_union.mpr (Or.inr (P.mem_symm hh)))
      have hnew : ¬inBlock (P.block k) s(e.u,e.v) := by
        rw [inBlock_pair (by simp [hu,hv])]; exact hu
      simpa [selected, Multiset.filter_add, Multiset.filter_singleton, hnew] using heF

Carpooling.Run.clusters_subset.source:
lemma Run.clusters_subset {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) {s t : ℕ} (h : s ≤ t) (k : V) :
    (R.clusters s).block k ⊆ (R.clusters t).block k := by
  induction t with
  | zero =>
    have hs : s = 0 := by omega
    subst s
    exact subset_rfl
  | succ t ih =>
    by_cases heq : s = t+1
    · subst s; exact subset_rfl
    · exact (ih (by omega)).trans (R.clusters_mono t k)

Carpooling.Run.terminal_closed.source:
lemma Run.terminal_closed {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (k : V) : R.Closed ((R.clusters T).block k) := by
  intro t ht
  let e := R.step t ht
  have hm : e.v ∈ (R.clusters (t+1)).block e.u := by
    simp [Run.clusters, ht, e, Clusters.merge, Clusters.self_mem]
  have hmT := R.clusters_subset (by omega : t+1 ≤ T) e.u hm
  have heq : (R.clusters T).block e.v = (R.clusters T).block e.u :=
    (R.clusters T).coherent _ _ hmT
  simp only [Clusters.mem_iff]
  rw [heq]

Carpooling.Run.selected_card.source:
lemma Run.selected_card {T : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (C : Finset V) (hC : R.Closed C)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T) : (selected C (R.edgeBag t)).card = internalCount R C t := by
  induction t with
  | zero => simp [Run.edgeBag, selected, internalCount]
  | succ t ih =>
    have hlt : t < T := by omega
    rw [Run.edgeBag, dif_pos hlt]
    have hm := inBlock_pair (hC t hlt)
    simp only [selected, Multiset.filter_add, Multiset.card_add, Multiset.filter_singleton]
    rw [show ((R.edgeBag t).filter (inBlock C)).card = internalCount R C t from ih (by omega)]
    simp only [internalCount, range_add_one, filter_insert]
    by_cases hu : (R.step t hlt).u ∈ C
    · have he : inBlock C s((R.step t hlt).u,(R.step t hlt).v) := hm.mpr hu
      simp [he, hlt, hu]
    · have he : ¬inBlock C s((R.step t hlt).u,(R.step t hlt).v) := fun h => hu (hm.mp h)
      simp [he, hlt, hu]

/-- Every prefix is controlled by the total number of arrivals in its final component. -/

Carpooling.component_bound_all_prefixes.source:
theorem component_bound_all_prefixes {T L : ℕ} (R : Run V T) (hi : ∀ k, R.d 0 k = 0)
    (C : Finset V) (hC : R.Closed C) (hL : internalCount R C T ≤ L)
    {t : ℕ} (ht : t ≤ T) {k : V} (hk : k ∈ C) :
    |R.d t k| ≤ 4*(L : ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/3) := by
  let M := R.mask C hC
  let P := M.prefix t ht
  have hp : ∀ k, P.d 0 k = 0 := by intro k; simp [P, M, Run.prefix, Run.mask, hi]
  have hc := abs_cube_bound_expanding P hp k
  have hcount : expandingCount P t ≤ expandingCount M T := by
    apply card_le_card
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨hr, h, he⟩ := mem_filter.mp hs
    apply mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨mem_range.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le (mem_range.mp hr) ht), ?_⟩
    exact ⟨by omega, he⟩
  have hcounts : (expandingCount P t : ℝ) ≤ L := by
    exact_mod_cast hcount.trans ((mask_expandingCount_le R C hC T).trans hL)
  have hd : P.d t k = R.d t k := by simp [P, M, Run.prefix, Run.mask, hk]
  rw [hd] at hc
  apply le_four_cuberoot (abs_nonneg _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  linarith

end Carpooling

Carpooling.Witness.Valid.source:
def Valid (Adj : V → V → Prop) (root : V) : Tree V → Prop
  | .nil => True
  | .node v L R => Adj root v ∧ Valid Adj v L ∧ Valid Adj root R

Carpooling.Witness.root_mem.source:
@[simp] lemma root_mem (root : V) (F : Tree V) : root ∈ vertices root F := by
  induction F generalizing root with
  | nil => simp [vertices]
  | node v L R ihL ihR => exact mem_union_right _ (ihR root)

Carpooling.Witness.edges_card.source:
@[simp] lemma edges_card (root : V) (F : Tree V) : (edges root F).card = F.numNodes := by
  induction F generalizing root with
  | nil => simp [edges, Tree.numNodes]
  | node v L R ihL ihR => simp [edges, Tree.numNodes, ihL, ihR]

Carpooling.Witness.append.source:
def append : Tree V → Tree V → Tree V
  | .nil, G => G
  | .node v L R, G => .node v L (append R G)

Carpooling.Witness.edges_append.source:
@[simp] lemma edges_append (root : V) (F G : Tree V) :
    edges root (append F G) = edges root F + edges root G := by
  induction F generalizing root with
  | nil => simp [append, edges]
  | node v L R ihL ihR => simp [append, edges, ihR, add_assoc]

Carpooling.Witness.vertices_append.source:
@[simp] lemma vertices_append (root : V) (F G : Tree V) :
    vertices root (append F G) = vertices root F ∪ vertices root G := by
  induction F generalizing root with
  | nil => simp [append, vertices, insert_eq_of_mem (root_mem root G)]
  | node v L R ihL ihR => simp [append, vertices, ihR, union_assoc]

Carpooling.Witness.valid_append.source:
lemma valid_append {Adj : V → V → Prop} {root : V} {F G : Tree V}
    (hF : Valid Adj root F) (hG : Valid Adj root G) : Valid Adj root (append F G) := by
  induction F generalizing root with
  | nil => exact hG
  | node v L R ihL ihR => exact ⟨hF.1, hF.2.1, ihR hF.2.2 hG⟩

/-- Graft an arbitrary forest at any occurrence of its root label. -/

Carpooling.Witness.graft.source:
theorem graft {Adj : V → V → Prop} {root a : V} {F H : Tree V}
    (ha : a ∈ vertices root F) (hF : Valid Adj root F) (hH : Valid Adj a H) :
    ∃ G, Valid Adj root G ∧ edges root G = edges root F + edges a H ∧
      vertices root G = vertices root F ∪ vertices a H := by
  induction F generalizing root with
  | nil =>
    have har : a = root := mem_singleton.mp ha
    subst a
    exact ⟨H, hH, by simp [edges], by simp [vertices, insert_eq_of_mem (root_mem root H)]⟩
  | node v L R ihL ihR =>
    rcases mem_union.mp ha with ha | ha
    · obtain ⟨G, hG, he, hv⟩ := ihL ha hF.2.1
      refine ⟨.node v G R, ⟨hF.1, hG, hF.2.2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [edges, he]; ac_rfl
      · simp only [vertices, hv]; ac_rfl
    · obtain ⟨G, hG, he, hv⟩ := ihR ha hF.2.2
      refine ⟨.node v L G, ⟨hF.1, hF.2.1, hG⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [edges, he]; ac_rfl
      · simp only [vertices, hv]; ac_rfl

/-- Rerooting preserves the entire edge multiset, including repetitions. -/

Carpooling.Witness.reroot.source:
theorem reroot {Adj : V → V → Prop}
    (hsymm : ∀ {u v}, Adj u v → Adj v u) {root a : V} {F : Tree V}
    (ha : a ∈ vertices root F) (hF : Valid Adj root F) :
    ∃ G, Valid Adj a G ∧ edges a G = edges root F ∧ vertices a G = vertices root F := by
  induction F generalizing root with
  | nil =>
    have : a = root := mem_singleton.mp ha
    subst a
    exact ⟨.nil, trivial, rfl, rfl⟩
  | node v L R ihL ihR =>
    rcases mem_union.mp ha with ha | ha
    · obtain ⟨G, hG, he, hv⟩ := ihL ha hF.2.1
      have hvmem : v ∈ vertices a G := by rw [hv]; exact root_mem v L
      have hbranch : Valid Adj v (.node root R .nil) := ⟨hsymm hF.1, hF.2.2, trivial⟩
      obtain ⟨K, hK, hKe, hKv⟩ := graft hvmem hG hbranch
      refine ⟨K, hK, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hKe, he]
        simp only [edges, add_zero]
        rw [Sym2.eq_swap]
        ac_rfl
      · rw [hKv, hv]
        simp only [vertices]
        have : v ∈ vertices v L := root_mem v L
        ext k
        simp only [mem_union, mem_singleton]
        constructor
        · rintro (h | h | rfl)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr h
          · exact Or.inl this
        · rintro (h | h)
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
    · obtain ⟨G, hG, he, hv⟩ := ihR ha hF.2.2
      have hrmem : root ∈ vertices a G := by rw [hv]; exact root_mem root R
      have hbranch : Valid Adj root (.node v L .nil) := ⟨hF.1, hF.2.1, trivial⟩
      obtain ⟨K, hK, hKe, hKv⟩ := graft hrmem hG hbranch
      refine ⟨K, hK, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [hKe, he]
        simp only [edges, add_zero]
        ac_rfl
      · rw [hKv, hv]
        simp only [vertices]
        have : root ∈ vertices root R := root_mem root R
        ext k
        simp only [mem_union, mem_singleton]
        constructor
        · rintro (h | h | rfl)
          · exact Or.inr h
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr this
        · rintro (h | h)
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
          · exact Or.inl h

/-- Keep only edges that introduce a new vertex label. This constructs a spanning
tree inside a witness forest without assuming a separate graph traversal theorem. -/

Carpooling.Witness.extend_spanning.source:
theorem extend_spanning {Adj : V → V → Prop} {root base : V} {F H : Tree V}
    (hroot : root ∈ vertices base H) (hF : Valid Adj root F) (hH : Valid Adj base H) :
    ∃ G, Valid Adj base G ∧ edges base G ≤ edges base H + edges root F ∧
      vertices base G = vertices base H ∪ vertices root F ∧
      G.numNodes + (vertices base H).card = H.numNodes + (vertices base G).card := by
  induction F generalizing root H with
  | nil =>
    refine ⟨H, hH, by simp [edges], ?_, rfl⟩
    simp only [vertices]
    exact (union_eq_left.mpr (singleton_subset_iff.mpr hroot)).symm
  | node v L R ihL ihR =>
    have first : ∃ H1, Valid Adj base H1 ∧ edges base H1 ≤ edges base H + {s(root,v)} ∧
        vertices base H1 = insert v (vertices base H) ∧
        H1.numNodes + (vertices base H).card = H.numNodes + (vertices base H1).card := by
      by_cases hv : v ∈ vertices base H
      · refine ⟨H,hH,le_add_of_nonneg_right (by exact zero_le _),?_,rfl⟩
        exact (insert_eq_of_mem hv).symm
      · have hleaf : Valid Adj root (.node v .nil .nil) := ⟨hF.1,trivial,trivial⟩
        obtain ⟨H1,hH1,he,hv1⟩ := graft hroot hH hleaf
        have hverts : vertices base H1 = insert v (vertices base H) := by
          rw [hv1]
          simp only [vertices]
          ext k
          simp only [mem_union,mem_insert,mem_singleton]
          constructor
          · rintro (h | h | h)
            · exact Or.inr h
            · exact Or.inl h
            · subst k; exact Or.inr hroot
          · rintro (h | h)
            · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
            · exact Or.inl h
        have hnum : H1.numNodes = H.numNodes+1 := by
          have hh := congrArg Multiset.card he
          simpa [edges] using hh
        refine ⟨H1,hH1,?_,hverts,?_⟩
        · rw [he]; simp [edges]
        · rw [hverts,card_insert_of_notMem hv,hnum]; omega
    obtain ⟨H1,hH1,he1,hv1,hn1⟩ := first
    have hv : v ∈ vertices base H1 := by rw [hv1]; exact mem_insert_self _ _
    obtain ⟨H2,hH2,he2,hv2,hn2⟩ := ihL hv hF.2.1 hH1
    have hr : root ∈ vertices base H2 := by
      rw [hv2,hv1]
      exact mem_union_left _ (mem_insert_of_mem hroot)
    obtain ⟨G,hG,heG,hvG,hnG⟩ := ihR hr hF.2.2 hH2
    refine ⟨G,hG,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · calc
        edges base G ≤ edges base H2 + edges root R := heG
        _ ≤ (edges base H1 + edges v L) + edges root R := add_le_add_right he2 _
        _ ≤ ((edges base H + {s(root,v)}) + edges v L) + edges root R :=
          add_le_add_right (add_le_add_right he1 _) _
        _ = edges base H + edges root (.node v L R) := by simp only [edges]; ac_rfl
    · rw [hvG,hv2,hv1]
      simp only [vertices]
      have hvL := root_mem v L
      ext k
      simp only [mem_union,mem_insert]
      constructor
      · rintro (((h | h) | h) | h)
        · subst k; exact Or.inr (Or.inl hvL)
        · exact Or.inl h
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
        · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
      · rintro (h | h | h)
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inl (Or.inr h))
        · exact Or.inl (Or.inr h)
        · exact Or.inr h
    · omega

Carpooling.Witness.spanning.source:
theorem spanning {Adj : V → V → Prop} {root : V} {F : Tree V} (hF : Valid Adj root F) :
    ∃ G, Valid Adj root G ∧ edges root G ≤ edges root F ∧
      vertices root G = vertices root F ∧ G.numNodes + 1 = (vertices root F).card := by
  obtain ⟨G,hG,he,hv,hn⟩ := extend_spanning (root_mem root .nil) hF (show Valid Adj root .nil from trivial)
  have hvG : vertices root G = vertices root F := by
    simpa [vertices,insert_eq_of_mem (root_mem root F)] using hv
  refine ⟨G,hG,by simpa [edges] using he,hvG,?_⟩
  simpa [vertices,Tree.numNodes,hvG] using hn

end Carpooling.Witness
